<a id="lsdk-ibkr-catalog"></a>

### LSDK-IBKR-CATALOG：IBKR 原生 Contract/ContractDetails：身份、目录扩展与历史数据缺失

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/contract.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/contract.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/client/historical.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/client/historical.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- Contract 和 ContractDetails SDK 类跨越旧版 IBroker 边界。Contract 包含 conId、symbol/secType、expiry、strike/right、multiplier、exchange/primaryExchange、currency、localSymbol/tradingClass、sec IDs、issuerId、组合腿和 delta-neutral 数据；ContractDetails 还包含有效交易所、最小跳动/数量、交易/流动性时段、时区、市场规则、债券/基金字段和精度。
- searchContracts 去除点后缀，请求 reqMatchingSymbols，将 CASH family hub 展开为具体详情，直接传递 BOND issuer hub，并保留缺少 conId/issuer 的行可见。getContractDetails 仅返回首条详情。conId 查询丢弃受污染的路由输入，克隆规范详情，合并并发查询，并移除失败项以便重试。
- 仅含 STK symbol 时，采用 SMART/USD 便捷默认值。非 STK/无 conId 路由要求 secType、exchange、currency 和 symbol/localSymbol。expandContract 接受 issuer:&lt;id&gt;、数字 underlying 键、FUT/OPT 过滤器、expiry/right/strike 范围、limit 1..200，以及 contracts 或期权参数网格；limit 提示不是游标，也不是不存在的证明。
- 底层包提供历史数据请求/取消、含 WAP/barCount 的 bars、historicalDataEnd/update 和 news 方法。UTA IBKR 适配器没有 getHistorical/news/news-group 叶节点，也不声明 history。原生方法存在仅是能力证据。

**选定的抽象表达**

- NativeContractRecord 为适配器私有。Instrument 标识保留规范 provider 标识（conId 或 issuer/family）、作为显示/路由证据的 symbol/localSymbol、secType、expiry/strike/right、multiplier、currency、exchange/primaryExchange、tradingClass、jurisdiction 和来源修订。ContractDetailsExtension 保留 validExchanges、minTick、timeZoneId、tradingHours/liquidHours、marketRuleIds、债券/基金字段和精度；不使用开放字段袋。
- CatalogResult 为 TradeableLeaf、FamilyHub、IssuerDirectory、NoMatch、Partial/Truncated、Unavailable 或 Malformed。hub/directory 是可见参考数据，但在选定规范叶节点前不能进入效应计划。目录请求为 Public。
- ExpansionQuery 受 schema 约束：Directory 或 Underlying{InstrumentId,securityType,ExactExpiry/ExactRight/StrikeRange,PageRequest}；输出携带 venue/jurisdiction、multiplier、generation、total/coverage，并在无原生游标时携带重新发起的查询。
- resolver 和 descriptor 由同一组构造时绑定的 schema/Constraint 产物构建。运行时 decoder 验证已解析的 slot/binding；JSON 形状相同或原始转换不会使 binding 可互换。实时准入目录修订影响新调用；历史 observer/recovery 保留原有的精确 binding 和原生查询标识，且在 DispatchStarted 后不能重新准备。
- 当前 IBKR UTA 目录在结构上没有 History。未来的叶节点需要 Candle&lt;IBKRExtension&gt;，包含价格流、WAP/barCount、historicalDataEnd 覆盖、update/correction/finality、取消和缺口证据；不得从 reqHistoricalData 推断。
- Coverage 是内核级的 Complete|Partial|Unavailable 选择；截断、NoMatch 和格式错误的标识是已声明叶节点内的 payload/reason 字段，不是新的全局 coverage 变体。未来的 history 叶节点必须在 Candle payload 中保留 asOf/finality/correction 证据。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 conId 路由、边界克隆所有权、issuer/CASH hub、BOND callback family、期权/FUT 过滤和排序、multiplier/expiry/right/exchange 字段，以及暂时性查询失败后的重试。
- 保留搜索实体与可交易合约的区别；aliceId 仍为 UntrustedAlias。保留对不完整 CASH/非 STK 路由的不上线拒绝。
- 保留 UTA history/news 能力在结构上的缺失。

**具体替代与修正**

- 用版本化 codecs、InstrumentId/ContractDetailsExtension 和 coverage ADTs 替换原始 Contract/ContractDetails 及首行/null 约定。未知 expiry/exchange/jurisdiction 或格式错误的 conId 仍不可交易。
- 除明确命名的 STK 便捷读取外，不得从裸 symbol 推断 exchange/currency/jurisdiction；受控效应要求规范标识和作用域。
- 将 limit/source 数组视为有界观测，而非完整列表；保留截断/重新发起信息，并区分 NoMatch 与传输失败。
- 只有具备 provider 声明及 end/cancel/finality/replay 证据时，才添加 history/news 叶节点；缺少叶节点不等于实例不可用。

**副作用与状态归属**

- 原生 resolver 负责 SDK 克隆、request/callback 关联和 decoder 验证；目录投影存储观测/修订。
- 受控 compiler 可将所选 identity/details 指纹复制到已准备的 payload；不能持久化 SDK 实例，也不能将缓存视为权威。
- CLI/AI 仅描述已声明的叶节点；没有可交易叶节点的 hub 不是订单命令。

**失败与恢复**

- 字段格式错误、conId 不匹配、未知 secType/expiry/exchange 或详情冲突，均转为 ProtocolViolation/IdentityAssociationUnproven；不得默认按 STK/USD 派发。
- 传输失败、超时、过期 generation 和缺少结束标记属于 ObservationFailure/Partial/Unavailable，而非 NoMatch；失败的 promises 会被移除以便重试。
- 过期的目录修订/指纹使已准备的 binding 失效，新调用必须重新解析；绝不静默调用其他语义版本。

**原生证据边界**

- ConId-to-InstrumentId 和 issuer/family 的完整性、期权 expiry/exchange 编码、ContractDetails 覆盖及游标保证，仍属于 provider 证据。
- 原生 history decoder 仅证明 bar/WAP/barCount/end/update callbacks，不证明 UTA 暴露、finality、replay、entitlement 或缺口恢复。
- aliceId 与 conId、account 或 jurisdiction 没有已证实的关系。

**单一权威切换**

- 针对规范目录观测执行离线一致性校验/导入，再单一权威切换到类型化目录叶节点；不要添加推测性的双读或兼容垫片。
- 将 search/details/expand 调用方迁移到 Public 目录叶节点和 coverage 处理；单一权威生效后删除原始 SDK 收集器。
- 在符合性达标前，IBKR descriptor 继续不包含 history/news。

<a id="lsdk-lb-identity"></a>

### LSDK-LB-IDENTITY：Longbridge suffix/market 身份、账户 channel 与能力缺失

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-contracts.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-contracts.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- SUFFIX_TABLE 将 HK/US/SH/SZ/SG 映射到 exchange/currency。makeContract 将无后缀/未知 symbol 默认为 US/STK；resolveSymbol 从 localSymbol/aliceId 回退到 currency，并将 CNY/CNH 合并为 SH；marketToSuffix 将未知值映射为 US，将 CN 映射为 SH。
- staticInfo 含 symbol、数值型 stockDerivatives 和 lotSize；positions 在行外携带 channel，但 getPositions 丢弃它并创建 STK Contract。searchContracts 回显模式；getContractDetails 使用 staticInfo 并硬编码 orderTypes。
- 能力静态声明 STK/MKT/LMT/STP/STP LMT/TRAIL。不存在 Longbridge 历史叶节点；quote/depth 不能证明历史能力。

**选定的抽象表达**

- LongbridgeInstrumentId={ticker,suffix/market,native kind,venue,jurisdiction,currency,source,catalog revision}；未知 suffix/market 表示身份解析失败。无后缀 ticker 只有在唯一 catalog/static 证据支持后才成为身份。
- AccountScope 包含 AccountId，并在原生证据支持时包含显式 accountChannel/SubAccountId。公共 instrument/catalog/quote/session/FX 使用 Public/provider 作用域。
- StaticInfo/ContractDetails 是精确的补充信息叶节点；衍生品列表缺失不同于显式为空；lot/multiplier/venue 是与来源/时间/版本相关的事实。兼容 Contract 仅作投影。
- 身份/静态声明共同构建 schema、约束、descriptor 和 digest；不另设“支持的后缀”元数据。实时 catalog 准入不同于历史观察器；已启动的副作用保留旧身份/编译器。
- CapabilityDescriptor 仅发布真实叶节点：不包含不支持的 history/protection；cancel 是独立的 native-string-id leaf，availability 与 ack/not-found/outcome semantics 需要 Longbridge conformance；不得合成 Cancelled。已声明但断开连接的叶节点保留身份及 availability。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 AAPL.US/700.HK 往返转换、后缀表事实、原生 symbol、账户 channel、staticInfo/quote 方法，以及当前无历史适配器的状态。
- 保持公共身份与账户身份分离。

**具体替代与修正**

- 移除无后缀/未知→US、CNY→SH 和未知→US 的可执行回退；保留旧字符串作为证据/需操作员处理项。
- 在观察中保留 channel；跨 venue/channel 的相同 ticker 绝不按显示 symbol 去重。
- 用已声明叶节点及 availability 替换静态通用能力/回显搜索。
- 不根据方法名或 quote 添加 history/news。

**副作用与状态归属**

- 身份/静态 codec 负责解析/getter 校验；catalog 负责修订/覆盖范围；Contract 是只读投影。
- 作用域解析器独立；公共身份不设默认账户。
- 订单准备使用 InstrumentId/static 证据，而非歧义键。

**失败与恢复**

- 未知 suffix/market/kind、格式错误的 getter 或 symbol 不匹配会产生 IdentityUnavailable/ProtocolViolation。
- staticInfo 缺失为 Unresolved/Incomplete；显式为空仅在有字段存在证明时才为 EquityLike。
- 回显/无枚举为 Partial/Unavailable；过期修订使新计划失效。

**原生证据边界**

- 无后缀 ticker 的唯一性、SH/SZ 映射、staticInfo schema、channel/subaccount 语义、jurisdiction/timezone 均未经证实。
- 静态能力数组/默认值不能证明会被接受。
- 不存在 history 路径；未来 stream/history 需要 end/cursor/finality/replay 证据。

**单一权威切换**

- 先对身份/静态观察执行离线一致性检查/导入，再切换到以 InstrumentId/scope 为唯一权威的模式；不使用推测性双读/兼容层。
- 将 Public catalog 与账户叶节点分离；descriptor 发现成为权威后，移除全局能力数组/猜测性回显。
- 继续不包含不支持的 history/protection；保留独立 cancel leaf 的 native string order ID 与 availability/conformance gate；不得生成 synthetic Cancelled，native send 后未知结果必须进入 observation。

<a id="lvenue-alpaca-catalog"></a>

### LVENUE-ALPACA-CATALOG：Alpaca：Instrument catalog 与身份解析

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 旧适配器在 catalog 未加载时把任意非空字符串大写并伪造 STK Contract；refreshCatalog 通过 unknown cast 读取 assets、只过滤明确 false、用 mutable array/map 替换缓存；details 与 search 继续为任意 symbol 给出 SMART/NYSE/NASDAQ/ARCA 等静态能力。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `Instrument` unit 分离 native ticker、`InstrumentId`、display symbol 与已解析事实。catalog 是带 provider instance、network/mode、revision/checksum、source/as-of、coverage 的有限 Pull；结果为 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`。`resolveInstrument` 是 exact instrument-fact resolver/data query，不是 A5 的 historical interpretation resolver；live admission catalog 则独立决定当前可执行 binding；解析结果携带 construction-certified schema/constraint slot，不生成 Contract 或 action handler。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 Alpaca ticker 作为 native identity；只在明确 Public/provider context 下使用。
- 保留已验证资产的名称、exchange、currency、tradability 等 rich fields；未知 multiplier/currency/jurisdiction 不以 USD/1 捏造。
- 空结果、未加载、过期、解析冲突和权限隐藏均可观察，不互换为一个 undefined。

**具体替代与修正**

- 为 assets response 建 runtime schema，拒绝 malformed rows；保留每行 source/provider metadata，明确 partial 与 complete。
- 搜索先对 revisioned snapshot 做纯匹配/排序，未知 symbol 返回 typed NotFound/Unavailable；删除 uppercase synthetic Contract。
- `getContractDetails` 改为 contextual descriptor query；仅当前 catalog/permission evidence 支持的 order leaf 暴露给 CLI/AI。
- 把 native ticker、InstrumentId、AccountScope、BrokerOrderId 与 dispatch identity 分开，compat Contract 只能作显示/读取投影。

**副作用与状态归属**

- refresh 是公共 catalog data Effect；缓存 checkpoint 不进入 trading transaction。
- live admission catalog 的 current availability/authorization 变更只影响新调用；历史 resolver 继续用精确 revision 读已发出 effect。
- 配置/网络/asset discovery 属于资源与数据 requirements；permission witness 在调用时单独评估。

**失败与恢复**

- 无 catalog、malformed row、权限过滤、stale revision、scope conflict、network failure 是 typed query/availability outcomes。
- 任何 symbol lookup Unknown 都不能成为 close/open recovery case；只有 effect 已 DispatchStarted 后的 native lookup 才拥有 durable recovery。
- catalog revision 变化使 stale new-call binding 失败，不能让相同路径悄悄改语义，也不能 reprepare 已开始 effect。

**原生证据边界**

- 本地 static list 与 SDK asset shape 不证明完整市场、exchange/order limits、ticker 全局唯一性或 account tradability。
- 缺失 feed/session/permission evidence 时 capability 可 describable 但不可执行；不把 source compile-only interface 当 runtime catalog。

**单一权威切换**

- 在离线 parity/import 阶段检查 compat `Contract` 与 `InstrumentId`/descriptor query 的结果一致性；完成后一次切换到 descriptor authority，不部署 speculative dual-read/shim。
- 完成 runtime catalog codec、revision binding 与 typed search/details 后删除 fabricated fallback 和 mutable map authority。

### LVENUE-LEVERUP-CATALOG：Leverup：Pair/Instrument catalog 与网络隔离

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/pairs.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/pairs.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 静态 pair array 做 substring/exact lookup，含 500 placeholders；未知 symbol/pairBase 可被合成为 CRYPTO_PERP/LEVERUP Contract；testnet 直接 alias mainnet pair/feed IDs，缺失返回 undefined。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `LeverupPair` 解析为 versioned `InstrumentDescriptor`：branded `InstrumentId`、`PairBaseId`、`PythFeedId`、base/quote、collateral、field scales、network、session/leverage/fee facts 与 source/revision。catalog Pull 保留 20/23 与 placeholders 的 Partial/Unavailable evidence；live admission catalog 与 instrument-fact resolver 分离；A5 historical interpretation resolution 属于旧 effect compiler/observer 的独立机制。未知或冲突结果永不构造 executable Contract。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 已验证 canonical symbol、pairBase、Pyth feed 与 labels 可作为 adapter-native fields。
- 高杠杆/category 保留为 provider policy evidence，不变成全局 action flag。
- testnet/mainnet 作为不同 NetworkIdentity，不让测试网借用主网 pair。

**具体替代与修正**

- runtime decode pair/catalog，校验 address/feed/token/network 一致性；placeholders 只可查询其 evidence，不可交易。
- 实现 pure `resolveInstrument`（canonical/明确 alias policy）并返回 `Resolved|NotFound|Unavailable|Conflicting`；删除 synthetic fallback/undefined boundary。
- catalog revision/checksum 进入 selected effect plan；network mismatch 在 prepare 前拒绝。

**副作用与状态归属**

- catalog loading 是 data Effect；resolver pure，不开 WAL/approval。
- trading effect 只消费 Verified descriptor 与 current permission witness；普通 unknown lookup 不创建 RecoveryCase。

**失败与恢复**

- Partial catalog、unknown pair/feed、cross-network conflict、stale revision 是 typed availability/data results。
- 任何 testnet URL/catalog divergence 在 handler 前暴露 unavailable；已 dispatch effect 固定原 network/revision，恢复不可切换。

**原生证据边界**

- 本地 static list 未证明 23 pairs、testnet addresses、per-instrument deployment/schema、leverage/session/fee policy。
- category list 不是 tradability；resolved string 不是 permission 或 native capability。

**单一权威切换**

- 先输出 historical catalog evidence，再补 authoritative deployment/catalog probes；迁移 search/details/open/close callers 到 descriptor。
- 删除 `localSymbol||symbol` synthetic Contract 和 `TESTNET_PAIRS = MAINNET_PAIRS` 的执行含义。

<a id="lvenue-protocol-units"></a>

### LVENUE-PROTOCOL-UNITS：LeverupProtocols：精确单位、collateral 与 Instrument binding

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/decimals.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/decimals.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/pairs.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/pairs.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- decimals.ts 暴露全局 QTY_DECIMALS=10、PRICE_DECIMALS=18、USDC_DECIMALS=6；decimalToWei ROUND_DOWN 且不校验 sign/finite/width，weiToDecimal 返回无标签 Decimal；LeverupBroker 固定 USDC、1x 和 token scales，pairs/testnet 则缺少独立部署证据。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 定义 field-tagged `NativeIntegerSpec {scale,signedness,width,rounding,field}`，边界 `DecimalString` 解析与 exact bigint codec；输出只能是 `Quantity<InstrumentId>`、`Price<InstrumentId,QuoteCurrency>` 或 `Money<CurrencyCode>`。`InstrumentDescriptor`/`CollateralAsset` 带 NetworkIdentity、TokenAddress、TokenDecimals、revision/source/as-of；`Constraint` 在 construction 同时绑定 validator、descriptor、digest。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 已证实的 qty 10dp、price/SL/TP 18dp 与 USDC 6dp 保留为 provider facts，不扩散为全局 policy。
- valid integer round-trip 与 binary width remain exact；fees/PnL 继续逐字段保留。
- ROUND_DOWN 只作为 named compatibility policy，新的安全 effect 默认 RejectPrecisionLoss，除非 native evidence 允许舍入。

**具体替代与修正**

- 删除 unqualified Decimal 与 global constants 在 public/domain callers 的使用；所有 conversion 需 field/instrument/collateral descriptor。
- 校验 malformed decimal、negative/unsigned、finite、range（uint96/uint128/uint24）与 lost precision；失败在 prepare 前 typed reject。
- cash/margin/amountIn 通过 CurrencyMetadata 关联，读取 metadata/余额是 data Effects；只有 declared buying-power semantics 才组合。
- 保留 descriptor revision/rounding/evidence 在 observations 与 prepared effect 中；revision 变化不改写历史。

**副作用与状态归属**

- codec/scale/range/rounding 是 pure；RPC/catalog/token metadata effects 只供 data pulls。
- controlled effect plan 冻结 selected units/metadata/rounding; writer owns dispatch identity and permission witness。

**失败与恢复**

- missing descriptor/collateral, width/sign violation, precision loss, stale metadata, cross-network token mismatch 是 typed pre-dispatch failures。
- post-start recovery 使用已编码 integer/descriptor revision，不能按当前 decimals 重新解释或 regenerate transformed qty。

**原生证据边界**

- 非 USDC collateral、high-leverage pair scales、deployed rounding、fee units、actual USDC decimals 与 leverage semantics 都需 native/catalog evidence。
- 函数接受 tokenDecimals 或 arbitrary string 不是 authority；interface/constant existence 不证明 contract accepts it。

**单一权威切换**

- adapter-private codec 先取代 direct Decimal helpers，再让 Leverup open/close and reader decoders consume tagged values。
- 保留旧函数仅作 versioned historical decoder（若已有 records）；不再作为 public action construction API。

<a id="lvenue-protocol-schema"></a>

### LVENUE-PROTOCOL-SCHEMA：LeverupProtocols：EIP-712 schema、signing 与 native identity

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/eip712.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/eip712.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/index.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/index.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- eip712.ts 同时暴露 nested/flat Open schemas，SchemaVariant 可变且注释建议 relayer reject 后 fallback；sign functions 接收 raw chain/agent/message/PrivateKeyAccount；domain 只复制 caller values，salt 为 Date.now+Math.random；close 以任意 positionHash/deadline sign。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 每个 write leaf 有 immutable `SchemaDescriptor`（protocol/version、primary type、field tree、domain shape、semantic/schema digest、schema slot）。Nested/flat 是 distinct candidate/historical versions，不能 per-call switch。pure `compileOpen/compileClose` 输出 canonical encoded request + `RequestDigest`; scoped `SignerCapability` 只签 prepared effect，返回 `SignedNativeRequest {effectId,AttemptId,schemaVersion,digest,signatureRef,trader}`。

**保留的可观察契约**

- nested/flat field names、uint widths、OneClickAgent/version、trader/salt/deadline/positionHash 等 native fields 在被 deployment evidence 接受的 version 中保留。
- close schema 与 open schema 的事实差异保留；equal bytes 不推导 interchangeability。
- signature/Pyth update 仍可抵达 relayer，但只经过 typed prepared effect。

**具体替代与修正**

- 将 schema selection 从 mutable state 移到 construction-certified capability；动态 foreign document certification 绑定 full provider/capability/revision/digest/schema slot。
- Domain 必须绑定 VerifiedNetworkDescriptor（chain/RPC/agent/contract/deployment fingerprint），签名前检查 current permission witness。
- split compile/sign/POST；DispatchPlanned 与 exact request digest/salt/schema version 持久化在 signing 前，DispatchStarted 紧邻唯一 POST。
- raw `PrivateKeyAccount`/key/message/SchemaVariant 不出 adapter；CredentialRef、sealed signature/native bytes 只以 bounded opaque reference 进入 records。
- 任何 rejection/timeout/Unknown 不切 schema、不换 endpoint、不新 salt；historical version 只供 exact observer/recovery。
- 不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。
- controlled plan/contract/command 使用目标 canonicalization：RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、full 64-hex 与 domain-separated/versioned digest；本窄协议 fixture 只记录设计前提，不宣称已实现该持久 writer。

**副作用与状态归属**

- schema/codec/domain digest/compile pure；credential retrieval/signing/relayer HTTP 是 scoped Effects。
- R service provisioning 不能制造 permission witness；UTA writer 绑定 authorizer/policy/expiry/AccountScope 到 exact plan。
- 只有 fresh writer Start 可发出 process-bound one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 仅返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，persisted authorization 不可重放。

**失败与恢复**

- schema evidence unavailable、domain mismatch、credential/authorization error、input/width/signature error 在 dispatch 前 typed failure。
- sign exception、POST timeout、bad response after DispatchStarted 保留 original bytes/digest/identity，进入 Unknown/RecoveryRequired。
- sealed execution representation 与 redacted audit separate；redacted JSON 不能作为 replay payload。

**原生证据边界**

- 本地注释与 known vectors 不证明 live accepted primary type、zero protection semantics、domain deployment、contract finality、salt idempotency。
- PrivateKey conversion 成功只证明 syntax/address derivation，不证明 Trader Agent authorization。

**单一权威切换**

- 先隐藏 raw eip712 exports，加入 exact runtime codecs/known-vector evidence records；为每个 accepted schema 建独立 leaf。
- 迁移 LeverupBroker sign path 后删除 mutable variant setter、free signer functions 与 fallback branch。

<a id="lvenue-mock-catalog"></a>

### LVENUE-MOCK-CATALOG：MockBroker：Instrument、identity 与 Public data

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- Mock query 对任意输入给 generic AAPL/Contract，nativeKey/localSymbol map slot 可合并不同身份；Partial Contract cast/default secType/STK fallback，mark 缺失可变成 null/default 100，quote/bars synthesis 无 source/as-of/sequence。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Public `Instrument`/`Candle`/`MarketSnapshot` 使用 venue/instrument scope 与 exact schemas；AccountScope 不附着到 public catalog。`InstrumentMapping` 显式记录 native key、canonical InstrumentId、local symbol、source/revision 与 conflicts；`PriceObservation` 显式 source/freshness/quote shape。Unknown/NoMatch/Unavailable 不造 Contract 或默认 mark。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 Mock registry 的 native identity、localSymbol、multiplier/metadata 与 deterministic mark controls 作为 fixture facts。
- 保留 synthetic history 作为明确 `MockFixture` provider data，不将其当真实 market authority。
- quote/clock/capability 可作为 schema-driven public leaves；缺失字段不填 100/±0.01。

**具体替代与修正**

- Instrument resolver 采用 branded identity 与 conflict result；external key/localSymbol mismatch 写入 reconciliation evidence，不隐式合并/split。
- mark/quote/bars 都返回 source/as-of/sequence/coverage；missing mark 是 Unknown/Unavailable，不 fallback avgCost/default100。
- 删除 generic AAPL-like response、STK fallback、number-only alias；capability descriptor 由 declared leaves/availability 派生。
- public data layer 与 account/order layer scope 分开；CLI/AI discover 仅显示真实 declared leaves。

**副作用与状态归属**

- catalog/quote/history/session 是 finite data pulls；simulator mark fact 是 source evidence，不是 approval。
- selected price evidence 可被 effect plan 引用，但 data cache/read failures 不获得 order compensation。

**失败与恢复**

- NoMatch、identity conflict、missing mark、stale source、partial history、unknown coverage typed。
- 普通 Public read Unknown 不建立 RecoveryCase；effect dispatch 后仍按原 selected evidence/identity observe。

**原生证据边界**

- Mock defaults and matcher behavior do not prove real instrument uniqueness, feed quality, session/finality or native absence guarantees.

**单一权威切换**

- 先在离线 parity/import 阶段用 exact public schemas 对照 registry/fact records，再一次切换 quote/history/details callers。
- 删除 generic fallback/default mark and map-slot convergence as authority。

<a id="lcore-account-lifecycle"></a>

### LCORE-ACCOUNT-LIFECYCLE：账户外观、连接生命周期与健康观测

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 旧 UnifiedTradingAccount 把 broker、TradingGit、keyless/readOnly/asVendor、连接 Promise、健康计数器、恢复计时器、回调和关闭动作装进同一个可变对象；构造阶段立即读取账户/持仓/订单并乐观地标记连接，健康层以阈值、冷却和恢复回调驱动后续调用。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 把该对象降解为若干 schema-bound capability definition 与 scoped connection：公共读取、账户读取、受控交易、健康事件和生命周期分别拥有自己的输入/成功/失败/交付槽位。Effect Layer 只提供已声明的资源服务；当前 permission witness、AccountScope、provider descriptor certificate 与 policy revision 另行检查，健康观测永不自动授予 dispatch 权限。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 initial connect、connecting/offline/recovering/disabled 的可观察区别，以及成功重置失败计数、传输 alive/dead/restored、close 释放监听器和计时器的行为。
- 保留 keyless 只能到连接或公共读取、readOnly 可读但不可写、asVendor 影响聚合/搜索展示的正交语义；不能把它们折叠成一个 capability boolean。
- MAP-177DF827E5: Retain the vertical intent of constructing a real account around a mock interpreter.
- MAP-177DF827E5: Remove assertions that TradingGit status is authoritative or that SDK object identity is preserved.

- MAP-D3C71D3098: Change a successful market-clock read so it cannot falsely reset account-write capability evidence.

- MAP-A0FAA65E2D: Ensure close cannot convert a durable leased dispatch into done or blindly resubmit it.

- MAP-076B11499E: Delete mutable Git staging and transient wallet tracker as execution authority.

- MAP-00D45A7149: Preserve timestamps and diagnostics as structured observability, not message-only contract.
- MAP-70C8DB0025: Preserve immediate offline signal and restore nudge.

- MAP-463948E2EB: Preserve exponential retry intent and immediate nudge.

**副作用与状态归属**

- 连接、计时器、broker listener、读取和 pack 资源属于 Effect service/Layer；账户身份、scope revision、connection generation、健康快照和受控效果的持久状态属于各自 owner。纯 Decision/Evolution 只消费构造好的事实、显式 now 和 durable state，不在预期拒绝时突变 guard 状态。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-177DF827E5: effectBoundary=The harness may use MockBroker as an Effect service; pure assertions cover prepare/evolve/project. Journal, scheduler, and broker calls are the only effects and are injected per test. durability=A file-backed SQLite/journal fixture must atomically contain command receipt, transaction event, prepared step, and initial job; a simulated restart reopens the same store. DispatchStarted precedes MockBroker mutation, and observation/outcome plus projection checkpoint are persisted before the test reads the view.
MAP-7F92A5F120: effectBoundary=Authorization is pure after capability and actor facts are supplied. Application IO loads actor/session and capability evidence; BrokerInterpreter must never receive an unauthorized action. durability=Durable writer records the decision and receipt but creates no EffectJob for denied/read-only plans. If a review projection is allowed, its nonExecutable bit and policy version are persisted and cannot be upgraded by a later push call.
MAP-B047ACC95D: effectBoundary=Connection acquisition/retry/heartbeat are Effect services. Tests use a deterministic TestClock and MockBroker layer; pure health fold remains independent of scheduler implementation. durability=Persist the latest RuntimeHealth and scoped BrokerHealthView evidence/checkpoint per boot/generation for observability; durable transaction states/jobs are never inferred from health status. Closing scope interrupts and joins fibers.
MAP-C7ACDD9C7A: effectBoundary=Broker adapter emits typed transport events; effect runtime supervises retry. Application reads health projection and capability set; transaction kernel separately checks mutation availability. durability=Persist scheduler attempt identity if reconnect affects durable jobs; never infer old worker death from lease expiry. Health event stream is append-only/observable, with bounded retention as operations policy.

**失败与恢复**

- 将连接中、未连接、恢复中、永久配置/认证失败、临时网络失败、禁用和关闭分别编码；异常安全地映射为 typed availability/failure。恢复失败只更新健康与 recovery owner，不把 Unknown 交易结果误判为 offline 或拒绝。

**原生证据边界**

- provider 永久错误分类、连接环境证据、传输与私有读取的分离，以及恢复/重连后的 scope revision 仍由 adapter evidence 决定；本组不把 native guarantees 推广为主机保证。
- MAP-177DF827E5 future falsifiers: Prepare a BUY MarketOrder with Quantity 1, reopen the journal, and observe one revision/one DispatchIdentity; schema decoding exposes no SDK object or unknown field in the durable payload. | Crash after DispatchStarted, reopen the same journal, and verify the same dispatch identity is observed without a second forward mutation. | Crash after DispatchStarted with no interpreter evidence leaves one durable dispatch identity and one observe/recovery path; only an explicit DurableMockVenue evidence record may classify the result further.
- MAP-7F92A5F120 future falsifiers: A read-only draft may be queried and rejected, but an approval attempt yields AuthorizationDenied and zero jobs. | A keyless account can run market-data query while PlaceOrder prepare fails without a broker mutation. | An actor with stale capability evidence is denied at writer recheck even if prepare previously succeeded. | A body-supplied actor or allowAiTrading boolean cannot authorize a plan; only a verified Principal plus current policy binding can create ApprovalBound Queued work.
- MAP-B047ACC95D future falsifiers: Initial connect failure yields broker Offline/Degraded evidence and a supervised retry while RuntimeHealth remains in its correct startup/recovery variant; broker recovery yields Reachable without settling an Unknown transaction. | A connected transport with private-read failure yields BrokerHealthView Degraded and account capability unavailable, not process Ready-as-writable.
- MAP-C7ACDD9C7A future falsifiers: A dead event blocks mutation immediately; restored schedules a probe, and health becomes Reachable only after target evidence. | Three account-read failures degrade only the account-read capability while public market data remains reachable; six failures apply the explicit compatibility offline threshold for that capability.
- MAP-D3C71D3098 future falsifiers: Offline push returns typed failure and zero dispatch; a successful quote does not reopen trading admission if private-write capability is absent.
- MAP-A0FAA65E2D future falsifiers: Close interrupts retry and joins it; restart sees an unfinished dispatch and schedules observation according to evidence.
- MAP-AB9C95B763 future falsifiers: Account read remains degraded after a successful public clock read; a private-read success clears only its own failure streak.
- MAP-58BE22469E future falsifiers: Slow init causes a typed Connecting query failure with zero failure-counter increment; after settle, query succeeds. | Mutation during Connecting is rejected before job creation, then can be prepared after capability/recovery readiness.
- MAP-DC4D7B4995 future falsifiers: Compile a place action from JSON, run the exact journal schema encoder, and reopen/decode it: no SDK prototype/function/secret is accepted in the durable payload. | Replay an event in a process without a broker adapter and obtain the same transaction state; native compilation is unavailable but replay remains deterministic.
- MAP-2965B55AF1 future falsifiers: Invalid config is rejected before broker acquisition. | Secret rotation changes CredentialRef while AccountId and historical facts remain stable. | A malformed or environment-mismatched config fails before broker layer acquisition; a valid read-only/keyless intent retains query capability without executable authority.
- MAP-076B11499E future falsifiers: Restart while one transaction is Reconciling and one connection is Offline: transaction remains locked while query health recovers.
- MAP-7ACD53B4BE future falsifiers: Construct with a slow adapter and verify no mutation admission before readiness. | Close scope and verify event subscription is removed exactly once.
- MAP-8B7A06270E future falsifiers: Account read succeeds but orders read fails: view marks orders stale/unavailable instead of claiming an empty pending list.
- MAP-B4A46EAD8C future falsifiers: Start with a pending Unknown dispatch and slow connection: runtime blocks mutation, then schedules observation after capability is restored.
- MAP-03A2A17A58 future falsifiers: A keyless account reaches public data readiness without private account probe; a writable account waits for readable capability.
- MAP-EC8C814F12 future falsifiers: Public data remains reachable while funded private read is degraded; BrokerHealthView marks the account capability unavailable and mutation admission is false with a reason. | RuntimeHealth Recovering with verifiedJournal false blocks transaction admission even if broker reach is Readable.
- MAP-12EBFAE5E6 open questions: Each adapter must supply versioned structured native error fields and permanent/retry precedence; absent evidence remains UnclassifiedNativeFailure -&gt; OutcomeUnknown/RecoveryRequired and cannot authorize retry or terminal rejection.
- MAP-12EBFAE5E6 future falsifiers: Keyless layer emits PublicDataReady without private call; funded private-read failure yields ConnectedTransport + AccountUnavailable. | The same native error name without adapter code evidence does not disable or retry a transaction; a versioned mapping may later classify it without rewriting prior Unknown evidence.
- MAP-00D45A7149 future falsifiers: Malformed broker payload is ProtocolViolation and disables only the affected capability if policy says so; a venue rejection remains retry/plan-specific.
- MAP-70C8DB0025 future falsifiers: Dead during an active dispatch leaves its attempt Unknown; restored schedules observe on same identity, not redispatch.
- MAP-3714A83594 future falsifiers: Start with multi-wallet discovery unavailable: market query may run, write prepare returns ScopeDiscoveryPending.
- MAP-0A714E7908 future falsifiers: Slow init returns Connecting for query after grace; a mutation command returns CapabilityUnavailable/StartupRecoveryPending and creates no job.
- MAP-A0A0E5EBC7 future falsifiers: Timeout after place mutation returns OutcomeUnknown and one observation job; malformed query response is ProtocolViolation; public query failure does not alter transaction state.

**单一权威切换**

- 先以 ConnectionAssembler 取代构造函数内的 generic broker 组装，再把健康回调改为 scoped observation stream；先做旧 UTA ID/配置的离线 parity/import，再以新 authority 单次切换；运行时不做双读，也不保留 speculative shim/compatibility phase。所有实际受控写入都迁移到 writer-issued permission 与 DispatchStarted 之前的 durable boundary，DispatchStarted 之后不得因 pack 缺失而 reprepare。

### LCORE-PROTOCOL-BROKER-SPI：IBroker 兼容面的拆分与 scoped provider port

**源码文件：** [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/order.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/order.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/client/orders.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/client/orders.ts) · [packages/ibkr/ref/samples/Python/Testbed/OrderSamples.py](../../packages/ibkr/ref/samples/Python/Testbed/OrderSamples.py) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/git.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/contract-ext.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/contract-ext.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- IBroker 同时暴露 init/close/listener、contract search/details/expand、place/modify/cancel/close、sub-account、account/position/order、quote/clock/history、capabilities 和 native key；optional method 与一个全局 generic object 把不同 provider 的叶子绑在一起。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 固定 UTA-facing `CapabilityDescriptor` envelope（identity/path、schema version/fingerprint、exact slots、delivery/effect/resource/provenance/availability），provider capability tree 保持开放。每个 leaf 自己声明 `Input/Success/Failure/Delivery`，仅需要账户事实或受控效果的 leaf 才绑定 AccountScope；查询、流、Layer/resource 和 private native interpreter 分离。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 public search/details/quote/clock/history 与 account positions/orders 的调用语义及 provider 缺失能力；保留 optional listSubAccounts/expand/refresh 作为 capability absence/unavailable，而不是强行空实现。
- 保留 native key/Contract/Order 在 adapter 内部的作用，禁止其穿过 public/persisted wire。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Pack descriptor、config codec、resource Layer 和 permission evaluation 是不同通道；提供 Layer 只能满足资源依赖，不能生成当前 permission witness、scope authorization、native guarantee 或 schema compatibility。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-F59E470DFF: effectBoundary=Adapter parses native risk; market/accounting projection computes or stores no IO in pure merge. Query service encodes a safe view. durability=Persist observation identity/version and source; risk rows are projection facts keyed by scope+instrument, not mutable fields on a native Position object.
MAP-634E72490E: effectBoundary=Adapters parse native contract/Decimal. Application queries account and positions; pure accounting folds normalized exposures. Git/journal codecs own serialization, not broker objects. durability=Persist exposure observations with broker observation identity, AccountScope, InstrumentId, multiplier, and schema version. A rebuild must not instantiate native Contract or infer a missing multiplier beyond an explicit legacy migration marker.
MAP-77D0297A77: effectBoundary=Pure relationship constructors live in domain. Adapter dispatch/observation supplies native child IDs and atomic-group evidence; projection encodes safe leg views. durability=Persist parent/child identity, role, action/attempt, and native group identity in the journal before exposing a leg as pending. A leg result cannot be reconstructed from a string alone.
MAP-FE024081BB: effectBoundary=BrokerActionInterpreter owns native IO and maps raw responses; journal writer/application owns durable acknowledgement/progress. Protocol only encodes serializable associated variants. durability=Persist DispatchStarted before mutation, then scoped ack/observation with attempt epoch and evidence. Do not write success boolean or generic error string as authority.
MAP-BAD8B38E04: effectBoundary=Protocol/domain query validation is pure. Catalog application performs IO; broker adapter maps normalized query to native filters. durability=Persist only if a query request/response is part of audit; include normalized limit/cursor and total evidence. Read projections include `truncated`/next cursor rather than relying on a default.
MAP-403375E19B: effectBoundary=Adapter decodes native grid; catalog service performs selection and subsequent expansion. Protocol encodes only normalized grid data. durability=Grid is a read projection keyed by query identity and catalog revision; include asOf/source and do not persist mutable SDK Contract instances.
MAP-89DA5A834C: effectBoundary=Pure union construction/codec; catalog application and adapter perform remote search. durability=Persist query/revision only where audit requires; response includes catalog revision/asOf and continuation token. No result is durable execution authority.
MAP-C6BE0A6EA7: effectBoundary=Adapters perform listing/getOrder IO and native decoding; observation worker/journal records facts; projection exposes query view. durability=Persist listing observation identity, scope, order identity, and completeness/namespace evidence. External observation creates a journal fact before pending scanner treats it as known.
MAP-0422181E7C: effectBoundary=Adapter decodes account data; application obtains positions/FX observations; pure accounting derives PnL; projection/API encodes a read-only snapshot. durability=Persist account observation and derived valuation provenance separately or atomically with a source sequence. AccountScope is part of every row/key; stale/fx-uncertain snapshots remain queryable with explicit status.
MAP-C959380106: effectBoundary=Connection/account query service discovers subaccounts; pure resolver validates action scope; transaction writer persists scope. A broker adapter may ignore native selector only after it has declared SingleExplicitDefault evidence. durability=Persist account discovery revision and scope on every action, order ref, observation, and conflict key; stage UI must not rely on commit-message tags.
MAP-7E5E549A48: effectBoundary=Adapter performs quote IO/native decoding. Market-data service supplies time/freshness facts; protocol codec serializes Instant as canonical string. durability=Persist quote only as optional market observation with source identity; trading decisions must record the exact observation/asOf used, not query mutable Quote objects.
MAP-8C2153421E: effectBoundary=Connection/market-data adapter performs clock IO; calendar and precondition evaluation stay pure; protocol encodes state and Instants. durability=Persist session evidence only when used in a prepared plan/precondition, with calendar version and observedAt. A stale clock cannot authorize a write.
MAP-25118F5AFA: effectBoundary=Effect runtime owns resource Scope and concurrency. Protocol only encodes connection/capability views; pack adapters keep SDK instances and credentials private. durability=Persist account/connection identity, generation, and health events; do not persist callback closures or runtime metadata. Shutdown closes admission/workers before scoped adapter resources.
MAP-781BB54D06: effectBoundary=Application catalog service performs IO through adapter port; protocol codec encodes search/detail/expansion pages. `refresh` is supervised effect, not direct mutation from a domain object. durability=Persist catalog revision, source, completeness, and refresh outcome in projection/journal where required. Do not treat cache rows as execution authority without revision check.
MAP-255335BC1C: effectBoundary=Only BrokerActionInterpreter performs native dispatch/observe IO and secret resolution, returning typed Ack/RemoteOutcome. Transaction application/writer owns prepare/approval, DispatchStarted write-ahead, jobs, and durable progress; protocol encodes records and never invokes the broker. durability=Writer atomically records command receipt, selected leaf payload/fingerprint, locks, DispatchStarted, ack/observation, and jobs. No result is returned as committed authority before SQL commit.
MAP-3AB8DE4D1E: effectBoundary=Directory service performs discovery IO and returns a typed status; pure normalization/resolution/conflict compilation contain no adapter calls. Adapter native selectors receive only an already resolved scope. durability=Persist directory revision and scope in action/order/observation identity and lock keys; a connection generation change invalidates capability but not historical scope.
MAP-BAFF102815: effectBoundary=Adapters perform scoped account/position/order query IO; observation worker persists facts; application/projection encodes views. The protocol query ADT separates explicit-ID lookup, open-order enumeration, and pending projection. Query failure does not mutate transaction authority. durability=Persist durable lookup descriptors, scope, per-ID result evidence, listing completeness/cursor/namespace coverage, source sequence, and broker observation identity. Query failures never mutate transaction authority; partial absence never infers terminal status.
MAP-7056B295D1: effectBoundary=Adapter/query effects own IO; pure normalization, freshness, and precondition evaluation remain domain. Protocol only transports normalized observation schemas. durability=Persist observations with source/asOf/freshness and capability fingerprint when decisions consume them. Read projections can be stale but write prepare cannot treat stale as open/current.
MAP-BC6607AA1D: effectBoundary=Effect service loads cached/discovered facts; pure checker validates action. No synchronous broker object method. durability=Persist capability snapshot/fingerprint used by a plan and require writer recheck before dispatch; stale data yields ReprepareRequired.
MAP-40929B6DB6: effectBoundary=Catalog/adapter effects perform native resolution; domain identity constructors and equality are pure. Protocol encodes brands as canonical objects/strings via exact codecs. durability=Persist InstrumentRef/catalog evidence, native lookup descriptors, connection generation, and scoped order refs. Never regenerate historical identity from current secret/config or a display symbol.
MAP-A27D9FADF9: effectBoundary=Adapter owns native Contract and key extraction; protocol/domain has no import side effect. UTA/application effect calls resolver during catalog/observation collection. durability=Persist InstrumentId and native lookup descriptor explicitly wherever order/position/quote/bar/history is stored. Legacy records with only aliceId are imported as LegacyEvidence and blocked from writes until resolved.

**失败与恢复**

- 未声明叶子、已加载未连接、scope/authorization 不足、输入/输出不匹配、provider rejected 与 pack load failure 彼此分开；不支持的 broker action 不进入 global switch。
- MAP-F59E470DFF: InvalidRiskValue(field) -&gt; reject observation and retain prior with a stale marker.
- MAP-F59E470DFF: RiskUnavailable(reason) -&gt; expose absence explicitly and prevent liquidation policy from treating it as safe.
- MAP-F59E470DFF: ScopeMismatch -&gt; discard observation as conflicting evidence.
- MAP-F59E470DFF: InstrumentUnitMismatch -&gt; ObservationFailure only when the selected leaf declares the unit relation; otherwise preserve unknown unit evidence and withhold comparison.
- MAP-634E72490E: InvalidQuantityOrMoney -&gt; reject observation.
- MAP-634E72490E: InstrumentIdentityMissing -&gt; record LegacyEvidence/read-only and block writes.
- MAP-634E72490E: MixedCurrencyWithoutFx -&gt; return ValuationUncertainty while retaining per-currency rows.
- MAP-634E72490E: ScopeMismatch -&gt; reject as stale/conflicting observation.
- MAP-634E72490E: MultiplierMissing -&gt; LegacyEvidence/UnitFailure; never infer 1 for an executable projection.
- MAP-77D0297A77: InvalidProtectionRelation(parent, child) -&gt; refuse prepare.
- MAP-77D0297A77: LegIdentityConflict(scope, child) -&gt; record observation conflict and stop automatic reconciliation.
- MAP-77D0297A77: NativeGroupUnknown -&gt; do not claim atomic bracket success.
- MAP-FE024081BB: ActionMismatch -&gt; ProtocolViolation/defect.
- MAP-FE024081BB: DispatchUnknown(identity) -&gt; Reconciling/ObserveUnknown, no blind resend.
- MAP-FE024081BB: BrokerRejected(reason) -&gt; FailurePolicy decision; not generic Error.
- MAP-FE024081BB: LegObservationMissing -&gt; partial outcome.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04: InvalidStrikeRange -&gt; ValidationIssue.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04: UnsupportedDerivativeFamily -&gt; CapabilityUnavailable.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04: InvalidCursor/LimitOutOfRange -&gt; ProtocolViolation.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04: CatalogStale -&gt; QueryFailure with freshness.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04: StageRelationInvalid -&gt; ProtocolViolation before any SDK call.
- MAP-403375E19B: GridIdentityMissing -&gt; ObservationFailure.
- MAP-403375E19B: InvalidStrikePrecision/Multiplier -&gt; ObservationFailure.
- MAP-403375E19B: SelectionOutsideGrid -&gt; ValidationIssue.
- MAP-89DA5A834C: MalformedVariant -&gt; ProtocolViolation.
- MAP-89DA5A834C: CatalogRevisionMismatch -&gt; RequeryRequired.
- MAP-89DA5A834C: ExpansionUnavailable -&gt; CapabilityUnavailable.
- MAP-C6BE0A6EA7: InvalidNativeOrder -&gt; ObservationFailure.
- MAP-C6BE0A6EA7: MissingScope/OrderId -&gt; cannot attach observation; keep external unresolved.
- MAP-C6BE0A6EA7: ListingIncomplete -&gt; no cancellation inference.
- MAP-C6BE0A6EA7: StatusRegression -&gt; ReplayViolation/observation conflict.
- MAP-0422181E7C: InvalidAmountOrKnownCurrency -&gt; ObservationFailure.
- MAP-0422181E7C: MissingCurrency -&gt; retain Unpriced/Unknown valuation evidence; never default currency.
- MAP-0422181E7C: MixedCurrencyWithoutFx -&gt; ValuationUncertainty and per-currency breakdown.
- MAP-0422181E7C: AccountScopeUnknown -&gt; DiscoveryNotReady, never default account.
- MAP-0422181E7C: CapabilityAbsent(field) -&gt; field-level Unavailable, not zero.
- MAP-0422181E7C: ObservationOutOfOrder -&gt; ignore for projection and record duplicate evidence.
- MAP-C959380106: ScopeDiscoveryPending -&gt; retry query; no write.
- MAP-C959380106: ScopeRequired/UnknownScope/InstrumentScopeMismatch -&gt; domain rejection.
- MAP-C959380106: ScopeConflict -&gt; writer VersionConflict/lock wait.
- MAP-C959380106: NativeScopeSelectorUnsupported -&gt; CapabilityUnavailable, not ignored.
- MAP-7E5E549A48: InvalidPriceOrVolume -&gt; ObservationFailure.
- MAP-7E5E549A48: CrossedQuote -&gt; preserve explicit consistency evidence; only a leaf-declared invariant produces ObservationFailure.
- MAP-7E5E549A48: InstrumentMismatch -&gt; QueryFailure.
- MAP-7E5E549A48: StaleQuote -&gt; return explicit stale view and block price-dependent precondition.
- MAP-7E5E549A48: MissingBidAsk -&gt; valid if venue capability permits, not synthesized zero.
- MAP-8C2153421E: SessionHalted -&gt; preserve halt evidence as SessionUnavailable/Indeterminate; a controlled-effect leaf may map it to its own declared rejection or precondition failure.
- MAP-8C2153421E: CalendarVersionMismatch -&gt; QueryFailure/requery.
- MAP-25118F5AFA: PackVersionMismatch -&gt; refuse load.
- MAP-25118F5AFA: ConnectionFailure(scope) -&gt; degraded/offline capability; unrelated scopes remain usable.
- MAP-25118F5AFA: ScopeDiscoveryPending -&gt; no implicit default.
- MAP-25118F5AFA: CloseFailure -&gt; record diagnostics while releasing durable lease state.
- MAP-781BB54D06: CapabilityUnavailable(CatalogAction) -&gt; explicit failure.
- MAP-781BB54D06: NoMatches -&gt; complete empty result, distinct from Partial/Unavailable.
- MAP-781BB54D06: CatalogStale -&gt; query may return stale view but prepare rejects stale identity.
- MAP-781BB54D06: InstrumentNotFound -&gt; QueryFailure.
- MAP-255335BC1C: DeclaredInputInvalid/CapabilityUnavailable -&gt; prepare rejection for the selected leaf.
- MAP-255335BC1C: ScopeRequired/ScopeMismatch -&gt; reject before prepare.
- MAP-255335BC1C: DispatchUnknown -&gt; Reconciling; no redispatch without evidence.
- MAP-255335BC1C: KnownBrokerRejection -&gt; ContinueOnKnownRejection only when plan policy says so.
- MAP-255335BC1C: Unknown -&gt; suspend remaining forward steps.
- MAP-3AB8DE4D1E: ScopeDiscoveryPending -&gt; retry query; no write.
- MAP-3AB8DE4D1E: ScopeRequired/UnknownScope/InstrumentScopeMismatch -&gt; domain rejection.
- MAP-3AB8DE4D1E: ScopeConflict -&gt; writer VersionConflict/lock wait.
- MAP-3AB8DE4D1E: NativeScopeSelectorUnsupported -&gt; CapabilityUnavailable, not ignored.
- MAP-BAFF102815: ByIdsEmpty -&gt; ProtocolViolation; caller must use PendingOrdersProjection or EnumerateOpen.
- MAP-BAFF102815: ListingUnavailable(reason) -&gt; QueryFailure/observation job; never [] success.
- MAP-BAFF102815: PartialListing(missingNamespaces) -&gt; stale/partial view and no absence conclusion.
- MAP-BAFF102815: OrderNotFoundWithEvidence -&gt; per-ID observation result, not NotApplied or broker rejection.
- MAP-BAFF102815: ScopeMismatch -&gt; discard/reject the observation.
- MAP-7056B295D1: QueryUnavailable -&gt; CapabilityUnavailable/QueryFailure.
- MAP-7056B295D1: StaleObservation -&gt; explicit stale view; action precondition fails.
- MAP-7056B295D1: AssetClassUnknown -&gt; query can display but action-specific policy blocks if required.
- MAP-7056B295D1: VenueJurisdictionMismatch -&gt; ProtocolViolation.
- MAP-BC6607AA1D: CapabilityUnavailable -&gt; query failure with reason.
- MAP-BC6607AA1D: CapabilityUnknown -&gt; block action.
- MAP-BC6607AA1D: CapabilityFingerprintMismatch -&gt; reprepare.
- MAP-BC6607AA1D: ScopeDiscoveryPending -&gt; no capability default.
- MAP-40929B6DB6: IdentityAmbiguous -&gt; reject action.
- MAP-40929B6DB6: InstrumentNotFound/StaleCatalog -&gt; query/reprepare.
- MAP-40929B6DB6: ScopeMismatch -&gt; reject.
- MAP-40929B6DB6: NativeOrderIdPrecisionLoss -&gt; invalid adapter codec.
- MAP-A27D9FADF9: MissingIdentity -&gt; IdentityFailure/LegacyEvidence.
- MAP-A27D9FADF9: AmbiguousNativeKey -&gt; IdentityFailure.
- MAP-A27D9FADF9: MalformedAliceId -&gt; ProtocolViolation during import.
- MAP-A27D9FADF9: ScopeMismatch -&gt; reject observation/action.

**原生证据边界**

- 每个 pack 的 native kinds、account scope、history/bar support、stream semantics、error mapping 和 recovery metadata 需单独证据；IBroker 方法名本身不构成保证。
- MAP-F59E470DFF future falsifiers: Decode a spot position with no risk and observe RiskAvailability.Unavailable rather than leverage=1. | Decode an observed liquidation price with a selected leaf that declares quote currency and a mismatch, and observe InstrumentUnitMismatch; without that declaration preserve unknown unit evidence. | Receive a stale risk update and observe its stale asOf/provenance without replacing a newer observation.
- MAP-634E72490E future falsifiers: Load an option position with multiplier 100 and observe marketValue/PnL computed once with multiplier. | Load mixed USD/HKD exposures without FX and observe per-currency result plus uncertainty, not a numeric sum. | Load an old position with no multiplier/identity and observe LegacyEvidence plus write refusal.
- MAP-77D0297A77 future falsifiers: Same child ID on two AccountScopes remains distinct. | A TP child observed without parent linkage is external/unknown, not silently attached. | A partial bracket response yields parent plus explicit missing-leg evidence.
- MAP-FE024081BB future falsifiers: Ack without fill leaves order Working under AcceptedByVenue criterion. | Network timeout after DispatchStarted yields Unknown and durable observation job. | Cancel response with no final status is Pending/StillWorking, not cancelled.
- MAP-BAD8B38E04 future falsifiers: Pass strikeMin=100.25/strikeMax=99 and observe validation failure. | Omit limit on a leaf with a declared default and observe that exact declaration; omit it where no default is declared and observe typed validation; request a limit above the declared cap and observe rejection before adapter IO. | Request an option grid without expiry and observe the Grid variant; a leaf request without expiry/right is rejected.
- MAP-403375E19B future falsifiers: Decode a 0.00000001 strike and observe exact DecimalString round trip. | Select a strike absent from the grid and observe typed ValidationIssue. | Decode a grid whose source omits rights and observe UnknownRights rather than an invented Call/Put set.
- MAP-89DA5A834C future falsifiers: Construct each variant and JSON-round-trip it; a cross-variant payload or missing required field is rejected. | Use a capped result and verify page.hasMore/Continue(token), not silent truncation. | Replay a stale continuation and observe RequeryRequired.
- MAP-C6BE0A6EA7 future falsifiers: List same numeric-looking order ID on two scopes and observe distinct identities. | A missing order from an incomplete listing remains Working/Unknown. | An external order is recorded once then later fill observation updates the same scoped row.
- MAP-0422181E7C future falsifiers: Read all positions in base currency and observe DerivedFromExposures PnL equal to the fold. | Read mixed currencies without FX and observe Uncertain valuation plus broker source evidence, not a blind sum. | Read an account without day-trades support and observe DayTradeAvailability.Unavailable, not zero.
- MAP-C959380106 future falsifiers: A single-wallet directory becomes Available([default]) and every stored order ref carries that scope. | A write while directory is Discovering returns ScopeDiscoveryPending and does not route to default. | Selecting spot for a derivatives instrument returns InstrumentScopeMismatch before prepare.
- MAP-7E5E549A48 future falsifiers: Round-trip a sub-tick quote and observe exact decimal text. | Observe a stale quote and verify an explicit stale reason; observe a crossed quote as Crossed/Unknown and block a price-dependent precondition unless policy permits it. | Return the same instrument from two venues and observe venue-qualified observations with distinct source contexts.
- MAP-8C2153421E future falsifiers: Ask for an equity regular session during a holiday and observe Closed. | Ask for a crypto continuous venue and observe Open with NoScheduledTransition. | Feed a stale/unknown observation to prepare and observe Indeterminate, not successful admission.

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 各 package index.ts 只导出 API version、engine、legacy configSchema 与 generic createBroker；registry 按 engine 缓存 Promise，解析 installed/workspace/Mock，validateModule 以 cast 检查四个 export，失败统一 BrokerPackUnavailableError，broken installed 不落到 workspace 的行为由测试固定。

**选定的抽象表达**

- manifest/pointer/package identity/content digest 是 provenance gate；pack descriptor 是 SDK-free、versioned、construction-bound definition，固定 outer metadata 后携带 open provider capability tree。Descriptor certificate 的 provider instance/capability/revision/full semantic/schema digest/schema slot 必须同时匹配；descriptor cache key 含 content/protocol generation，account/connection/journal state 不在 cache。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 Mock built-in 与 live engines lazy isolation、installed release precedence、workspace source 仅显式 dev/test、broken installed 不 silent fallthrough、失败 load eviction、active pointer corruption 的显式失败。
- 保留 package-specific native implementation and config fields inside pack；public package 不再依赖 @traderalice/ibkr，wrapper 仅作为离线 parity/import 输入，单一 authority cutover 后删除，不作为 runtime shim。

**副作用与状态归属**

- PackLoader 负责 pointer/manifest/import/descriptor/policy phases；provider-local Layer/handler 负责 native resource/effect；permission evaluation 属于 UTA writer/runtime，不被 pack service 提供。历史 resolver 能加载旧 descriptor/observer/recovery，不向新 admission catalog 借 semantics。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-9AD9951502: effectBoundary=Composition only: main/effect-runtime loads this module and provides CredentialProvider, Clock, Scope, and JournalWriter-backed scheduler ports. No network occurs on import and no adapter object enters transaction state. Provider code may use any native SDK/protocol; only the validated UTA-facing descriptor and boundary codecs are shared. durability=The module descriptor is immutable code metadata; connection lifetime is Scope-managed. DispatchStarted and each Ack/RemoteObservation are written by durable-scheduler/journal, keyed by account scope plus DispatchIdentity. Prepared plan stores redacted/versioned native plan and CompensationAssessment, never the client or secret. Data handles/cache state are not order WAL; only a selected controlled effect receives transaction durability.

**失败与恢复**

- UnknownEngine、PackAbsent、ActivePointerCorrupt、ManifestMismatch、ProtocolMismatch、DescriptorInvalid、ImportFailure、PolicyDenied、CredentialFailure 和 RecoveryUnavailable 用 PackLoadFailure/availability ADT 表示；不要转换为 transaction Unknown，除非原动作已 DispatchStarted。
- MAP-9AD9951502: PackModuleContractViolation(engine="alpaca", missing=provider descriptor registration) -&gt; reject installation/load.
- MAP-9AD9951502: CredentialUnavailable(secretRef) -&gt; account remains non-writable; caller offers repair, not retrying a trade.
- MAP-9AD9951502: EnvironmentMismatch(declared=Paper, observed=Live) -&gt; reject capability and require reconfiguration.
- MAP-9AD9951502: UnknownOutcome(remoteIdentity) -&gt; reconcile observation job; do not issue a second order.
- MAP-DA5BBE56B3: PackApiVersionMismatch(expected=2, installed=1) -&gt; mark needs-update/unsupported, preserve prior account history.
- MAP-DA5BBE56B3: PackManifestMismatch(engine) -&gt; fail load with structured packaging detail.
- MAP-DA5BBE56B3: DescriptorSchemaMissing(surface) -&gt; reject before any connection resource is acquired.
- MAP-14D51E5BA4: UnknownEngine(engine) -&gt; configuration failure at protocol boundary.
- MAP-14D51E5BA4: EngineAdapterMismatch(expected="alpaca", actual) -&gt; pack load failure.
- MAP-14D51E5BA4: CapabilityUnavailable(reason) -&gt; no order job created despite a matching engine label.
- MAP-607170E22C: ConfigDecodeFailure(path, issue) -&gt; reject create/prepare with field-specific failure.
- MAP-607170E22C: SecretReferenceUnavailable(ref) -&gt; NeedsRepair/CapabilityUnavailable.
- MAP-607170E22C: NativeProtocolViolation(codec, redactedDetail) -&gt; connection degraded and observation not trusted.
- MAP-607170E22C: CapabilityUnavailable(leaf, evidence) -&gt; prepare rejection, not a generic config error.
- MAP-6496594BF0: InvalidInstrumentMapping(symbol) -&gt; prepare failure with no job.

**原生证据边界**

- pack descriptor 的真实 foreign handshake、provider output/schema coverage、native process crash/stream terminal and recovery 需运行 evidence；manifest digest 验证只由现有 broker-packs owner 声称已做的部分承担，不补声称缺失的验证。
- MAP-9AD9951502 open questions: Alpaca's SDK surface exposes UUID/client-order-id lookup paths, but this source and the completed adapter design do not prove server-side idempotency or retention across restart; until versioned native conformance records a dedupe window, keep ObserveBeforeRetry with persisted DispatchIdentity/ClientOrderId and never issue a second create-order request.
- MAP-9AD9951502 future falsifiers: A module that is imported with no CredentialProvider must not construct an SDK client or open a socket. | A paper config whose `/account` evidence says live yields EnvironmentMismatch and no dispatch permission. | After a durable DispatchStarted followed by process loss, reconnecting observes the same native order id and yields one RemoteOutcome without duplicate create-order calls.
- MAP-DA5BBE56B3 future falsifiers: An installed v1 pack returns PackApiVersionMismatch and never imports its SDK. | A descriptor missing required outer schema, delivery, provenance or availability metadata is rejected even if config parsing works. | A product release version change with unchanged v2 API remains loadable, while a descriptor contract change increments the API and rejects the old one.
- MAP-14D51E5BA4 future falsifiers: A descriptor tagged ccxt under `engine: alpaca` is rejected before connection construction. | Two accounts with engine alpaca but different AccountScope values receive independent connection/lock identities. | A matching engine with missing Pack remains needs-install rather than canTrade.
- MAP-607170E22C open questions: Alpaca getAccount probing and endpoint evidence are required, but this wrapper and the completed adapter design do not identify authoritative response fields for paper/live or trade permission; until a versioned adapter contract records those fields, keep environment/scope/capability unknown and expose no write action.
- MAP-607170E22C future falsifiers: Paper config with a live observed account fails closed. | Malformed key reference is rejected without calling Alpaca. | A valid config can expose read-only account queries while PlaceOrder remains unavailable when credential scope lacks trade permission.
- MAP-6496594BF0 open questions: Alpaca lookup endpoints and fill-activity observations are available as adapter paths, but server idempotency/retention, group semantics, and partial-fill completion criteria remain unproven; until native conformance records them, use persisted identity, observe before retry, and retain partial exposure in RecoveryRequired.
- MAP-6496594BF0 future falsifiers: Crash immediately after DispatchStarted leaves one durable attempt and schedules observe; no duplicate native create occurs without idempotency evidence. | A partial fill produces a fill observation and a compensation assessment based on actual exposure, not the original full quantity. | A missing trade capability yields typed unavailability before the writer creates a dispatch job.
- MAP-B40F4C1C42 open questions: Exact idempotency scope and completeness/retention horizon differ by exchange and are not established by this wrapper source; each adapter must record evidence before allowing resend.

**单一权威切换**

- 先实现 typed PackManifest/ActivePackPointer/ProviderDescriptor codecs，再迁 registry callers；cache failure 只驱逐 definition load，active connection generation 和 journal state 独立。先离线导入并核对旧 API 结果，再由单一 authority 接管；随后删除 generic createBroker/compat types，而非保留 alias 或双读。

<a id="lcore-catalog-composition"></a>

### LCORE-CATALOG-COMPOSITION：连接组装、FX 要求与模块边界

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/index.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/index.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- factory 以 presetId 解析 raw presetConfig、cast Record、load engine、校验后丢弃 parse result，再以 generic createBroker 建对象；FX 依靠 optional setFxService duck cast；brokers barrel re-export IBroker、factory、catalog、serialization，并以 types.ts compat shim 维持相对 import。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `ConnectionAssembler` 输入 typed UTAConfig/ConnectionIntent、exact historical/live resolver、PackLoader、SecretResolver 与 evidence services，输出按 leaf scope 的 `ScopedConnection`/read handle。FxRequirement/FxObservation 是 capability contract 的显式 requirement；提供 Fx Layer 不替代 permission witness。public data leaf 不需默认账户或 FX，account/effect leaf 才声明这些要求。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 preset-to-engine 的选择、optional FX 对 currency-dependent operations 的影响、installed/live implementation 不从 public barrel 直接暴露，以及 keyless/readOnly/asVendor 的配置语义。
- 保留 failed engine load 不影响 config/history readability，旧 caller 先以 explicit named ports 做离线 parity/import，单一 authority cutover 后替代 generic imports。
- MAP-6367D87808: Preserve presetId as the account config linkage and all keyless/read-only distinctions.
- MAP-6367D87808: Intentionally replace return type IBroker and hidden factory side effects with typed connection/evidence composition.

- MAP-C3B978232C: Keep no-FX actions executable when capability evidence says conversion is unnecessary.

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-6367D87808: effectBoundary=The assembler is an Effect interpreter/composition boundary; parsing, preset translation, and policy decisions are pure inputs. It owns no SQL and must not mutate UTA state or instantiate SDKs before pack/evidence checks. durability=AccountId/legacy aliases, SecretRefs, environment/scope evidence, and readiness decisions are persisted through account storage/journal writers outside this module; connection cache is ephemeral and generation-tagged.
MAP-C3B978232C: effectBoundary=Requirement evaluation and conversion are pure. FX provider IO, rate freshness, and service lifecycle are effects; JournalWriter records the observation reference with the plan when it affects quantity/notional. durability=Persist only typed FX observation metadata/rate source and plan inputs, not provider internals. Missing FX never mutates order state; failure policy follows action semantics.
MAP-093F5766C9: effectBoundary=Parsing and translation are pure. Pack loading, secret resolution, adapter lifecycle, probing, and FX layer acquisition are effects; no broker is created before durable readiness/identity checks. durability=Persist parsed serializable config, SecretRefs, AccountId/aliases, scope/evidence generations, and migration state through account storage; factory does not write SQL and cannot discard durable identity.
MAP-E010E516DB: effectBoundary=Only layer acquisition and rate fetching are effects. The adapter boundary receives a typed service interface and cannot inspect arbitrary properties or mutate itself through a setter. durability=Persist capability/evidence and FX observation references as part of connection/plan metadata; no setter state is durable or authoritative.
MAP-D914E7F49F: effectBoundary=Barrel exports are pure module wiring. Importing broker-spi must not evaluate SDKs or access services; effects live in adapter implementations/runtime composition. durability=No persistence owner; exported records carry identity/scope and durable IDs but JournalWriter owns event/projection writes.
MAP-16D7FC3B84: effectBoundary=The barrel change itself is pure import wiring; connection acquisition remains an explicit effect boundary. durability=Connection construction has no direct persistence authority; AccountId/legacy migration and JournalWriter interaction belong to application/runtime orchestration.
MAP-4D0C34ED53: effectBoundary=Barrel wiring is pure; actual config parsing, pack loading, probing, and policy evaluation are separate effects/pure functions as appropriate. durability=Preset metadata is rebuildable; account config/identity/evidence persist elsewhere. Public exports must not expose SecretMaterial or mutable SDK objects.
MAP-E981F551DA: effectBoundary=Barrel remains pure/lazy. Dynamic import and pack manifest validation are effects owned by PackLoader; descriptors are decoded into SDK-free interfaces before use. durability=Pack definitions may be cached ephemerally, but active account/journal/connection generation and recovery state are durable elsewhere.
