<a id="lsdk-ibkr-effect"></a>

### LSDK-IBKR-EFFECT：IBKR 原生丰富订单：标识、sentinel、条件关系与未知恢复

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/IbkrBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/order.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/order.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/client/orders.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/client/orders.ts) · [packages/ibkr/ref/samples/Python/Testbed/OrderSamples.py](../../packages/ibkr/ref/samples/Python/Testbed/OrderSamples.py) · [packages/ibkr/src/order-condition.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/order-condition.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 可变 Order 暴露 orderId/clientId/permId、action、Decimal quantity、type、prices、TIF、active/good-after/good-till、OCA/group/type、orderRef/transmit/parentId、outsideRth、display/trigger、trailing、FA/short-sale/clearing/algo/scale/hedge/delta-neutral、原生 cashQty、conditions、附加 ids 和受服务器版本限制的字段。
- UNSET_INTEGER=2^31-1、UNSET_DOUBLE=Number.MAX_VALUE、UNSET_DECIMAL=2^127-1 和 Infinity 哨兵值按版本序列化为空值或零；字段存在不代表远端接受。
- placeOrder 探测 currentTime，分配原生 ID，注册 openOrder 等待器，再调用 void EClient.placeOrder，并将回调视为成功。modify 修改获取的 Order/复用数字 ID。cancel 合成状态/对象。closePosition 读取缓存并递归提交反向 DAY MKT。拒绝非空 TPSL。
- 示例证明 MOC=MOC、LOC=LOC+lmtPrice、MOO=MKT+OPG、LOO=LMT+lmtPrice+OPG、REL=REL+auxPrice 且可选 lmtPrice 上限；percentOffset 仅限 REL。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 下单输入为语义 Order 加精确 IbkrOrderExtension：scope/account、原生 contract、action、Decimal quantity/cashQty、type、lmt/aux/trigger/trail、TIF/带时区的 GoodAfter/GoodTill、outsideRth/session、parentId/parentPermId、OCA、combo legs、conditions（Price/Time/Margin/Execution/Volume/PercentChange，使用 And/Or）、protection/relations 及已声明的版本受限字段。哨兵值是 Absent(reason)，不是普通数字。
- Order 身份标记包括 ClientOrderRef、BrokerOrderId、ClientId、PermId、ParentId/ParentPermId、account 和 generation；生成的原生 ID 不是持久幂等键。
- MOC/LOC/MOO/LOO/REL 是精确的叶级组合；不支持的 notional/cashQty、trailing amount/percent、protection/bracket/OCA/parent/conditions 在无证据时不列出或标为不可用，绝不丢弃。
- withTransaction 仅封装已声明的效应。Prepare 冻结所有字段/证据；writer 在原生发送前提交意图/批准/租约及 DispatchStarted。原生 ack/working/fill/cancel/criterion 各不相同。效应服务 R（socket/clock/codec）与 writer 权限凭证分离。
- 实时准入目录修订影响新调用；历史观察器/恢复解析精确的旧编译器/观察器。任何 DispatchStarted/Unknown 之后，若缺少旧解释，则携带封存字节/身份进入 RecoveryRequired，绝不按当前目录重新准备。
- 延迟订单只有一个激活所有者。纯函数 advance(checkpoint,fact,futureBoundary) 产生 NoActivation/Candidate/Gap；事件消费/checkpoint/outbox 在一次 writer 提交中完成。ReturnToAgent 是配置的 RequestDecision，不是通用默认值。
- 受控关系为 Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract&gt;：回执/控制结果及每个阶段错误 schema 均保持与此 IBKR 配方关联。已安装的原生 Effect 服务 R 不同于准入/执行 P；安装解释器绝不授予执行权限。
- 只有全新且成功的 Start 转换才产生绑定进程、仅用一次的 DispatchGrant。重复/查询 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted 证据，绝不返回可重放的授权；持久化授权不是 grant。桥接层在原生发送时一次性消费 grant。
- ReturnToAgent 的无回复、过期或无法送达处理采用注册时选定并冻结的策略：SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch，或显式指定保留方式/接收方的 EscalateDecision。超时与响应在同一控制 CAS 下竞争；超时绝不回退到执行。
- Capability/command/plan 摘要使用目标 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256，针对精确 slots/constraints/requirements/interpretation 计算完整、域分离且带版本的摘要；本章不声称这些局部示例实现了规范化。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留丰富的原生字段/关系、Decimal/哨兵值语义、身份证据及精确观察到的示例映射。
- 保留发送前对不支持的 TP/SL 和无效路由的拒绝；绝不将受保护输入降级为无保护开仓。
- 保留只读列表/回调证据，不提供通用的成功/取消/幂等性保证。

**具体替代与修正**

- 用不可变计划、前镜像/版本屏障、类型化确认/观察/恢复，替代直接 void 修改、Partial 合并、parseInt IDs 和合成取消。
- DispatchStarted 先于发送；越过边界后的歧义为 Unknown/Observe，重连不能盲目重发。
- 要求 AccountScope、规范 InstrumentId、jurisdiction/session/TIF 证据及能力接受；GoodTill 需要 expiry/timezone/calendar。
- 订单列表命名空间（clientId、completed、reqAllOpenOrders/manual、permId）是各自带覆盖范围的独立叶。
- 强制要求无回复/过期/无法送达的控制策略，并在每次注册时冻结；在同一 CAS 下使用 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，超时绝不自动执行。

**副作用与状态归属**

- 适配器负责 SDK 对象构造/克隆和回调编解码器；SDK 类绝不跨越边界。
- 共享 writer/scheduler 负责命令身份、授权、dispatch CAS/WAL/回执/unknown 恢复；适配器接收有界计划并返回证据。
- 数据列表/报价/账户读取器没有订单 WAL/预留/补偿；选定观察仅通过纯编译器进入效应证据。

**失败与恢复**

- 输入失败包括缺少路由、非正 quantity、缺少 LMT、未知 TIF、缺少 GTD expiry/timezone、无效哨兵值、不支持的 protection/condition 及 scope 不匹配。
- CapabilityUnavailable 不同于已声明但断开连接的叶。
- 已知拒绝需要关联的原生 code/status；没有分发身份的 openOrder/orderStatus 只是观察。
- Unknown 保留恢复所有者/身份；通过限定范围的 order/client/perm/listing 观察；只有未应用的证据才允许新尝试。
- 重复或查询 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted 证据，不返回可复用的 DispatchGrant；仅有持久化批准证据不能跨越原生发送边界。

**原生证据边界**

- SDK 序列化/版本限制不能证明接受/幂等性/原子性/产品矩阵；示例存在产品/模拟交易限制。
- permId/clientId 完整性、原生查找、ID 复用、子单时序、保护及发送字节边界均需实证。
- Capabilities 数组是 AdvertisedCandidate；timezone/TIF/percentOffset/jurisdiction 需要证据。

**单一权威切换**

- 为每个实际 IBKR 操作组合一个绑定 schema 的效应叶，并派生 descriptor/AI/CLI schemas；不设推测性兼容或双写阶段。
- 对观察运行离线一致性校验/导入，再让共享 writer 成为唯一权威；在发送前/DispatchStarted/已接受但尚未确认/重连/重复/迟到审核处加入崩溃切点。
- 在权威切换时删除 SDK 导出/原生修改/合成状态/直接平仓递归。

<a id="lsdk-lb-effect"></a>

### LSDK-LB-EFFECT：Longbridge 原生订单、TIF、状态/字符串 ID 与受控 effect

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-types.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-contracts.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/longbridge-contracts.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/longbridge/LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 映射：HK MKT→ELO，其他 MKT→MO，LMT→LO，STP→MIT，STP LMT→LIT，TRAIL→TSMPCT，TRAIL LIMIT→TSLPPCT；TIF DAY/空→Day，GTC→GoodTilCanceled，GTD→GoodTilDate，IOC/FOK/OPG→null，未知→Day。
- placeOrder 将 Decimal 值强制转换后放入 SubmitOrderOptions，并返回 string orderId 和合成的 New；忽略 TPSL。modify 接受部分替换，在 promise 完成时返回 Replaced；cancel 返回合成的 Cancelled；close 读取扁平化持仓，递归提交反向 DAY MKT。
- 原生订单包含 string orderId、数值型 status/side/type/TIF、类 Decimal 的数量/价格和 msg。mapOpenOrder 设置数值型 orderId=0；未知 status/type/TIF 默认设为 Submitted/LMT/DAY。
- 源码未证明名义金额、金额跟踪、TP/SL、bracket/OCO、parent、幂等性或完整的状态/错误语义。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Place 输入是语义化 Order 加精确的 Longbridge 扩展：带后缀的 InstrumentId、scope/channel、side、Decimal 数量或已声明的名义金额、价格/触发价/跟踪金额或百分比、原生 type、TIF 和 GTD 到期时间/时区/日历，以及仅已声明的关系。Decimal 以经验证的字符串跨边界传递。
- NativeOrderIdentity 保留不透明的 string orderId、client/request/dispatch 身份、scope/channel、原始 status、返回的 parent/OCA、已执行数量/价格及响应版本；绝不解析为数值零。
- cancel 是独立的 provider leaf：输入以不透明 string orderId、scope/channel 绑定；availability、ack、not-found 与 outcome semantics 需要 Longbridge conformance。不能用 synthetic Cancelled；native send 后 unknown 必须进入 Observe/OutcomeUnknown。
- Provider 叶节点声明已证实的 MKT/LMT/STP/STP LMT/跟踪变体；HK MKT→ELO 与非 HK→MO 各不相同。Day/GTC/GTD 需要证据；IOC/FOK/OPG/未知值在证实前均受限。
- Schemas/constraints/descriptor/digest 一同构建；原生 mapper 不是藏在通用元数据后的独立回调。Effect 服务 R 与 writer 权限分离。
- withTransaction 准备精确证据，并在原生调用前提交 DispatchStarted。实时准入目录不同于精确的历史 observer/recovery；开始后或进入 Unknown 后，不得按当前修订版重新准备。
- 敞口证据新鲜时，Close 保留源码的反向 DAY MKT 行为，但它是带残余判据的敞口效应，并非精确回滚。延迟订单只有一个激活所有者，且检查点推进为纯操作；ReturnToAgent 是配置好的 RequestDecision。
- 受控关系为 Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract&gt;：receipt/control-result 和每个阶段的错误 schema 始终与此 Longbridge recipe 关联。已安装的原生 Effect 服务 R 不同于准入/执行 P；安装解释器绝不授予执行权限。
- 只有新鲜且成功的 Start 转换才产生绑定进程、一次性的 DispatchGrant。重复/查询 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted 证据，绝不返回可重放的 grant；持久化授权不是 grant。桥接层在原生发送时一次性消耗 grant。
- ReturnToAgent 的无回复、到期或无法投递处理，是注册时选定并冻结的策略：SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch，或带明确保留规则/接收方的 EscalateDecision。超时与响应在同一控制 CAS 下竞争；超时绝不回退到执行。
- Capability/command/plan 摘要以 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 为目标，对精确的 slots/constraints/requirements/interpretation 使用完整、域分离且带版本的摘要；本章不声称这些局部样例实现了规范化。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留区分市场的映射、正值 Decimal 数量/价格/触发价/跟踪值、已知状态、不透明的 string IDs 和反向平仓意图。
- 保留提交前对未知 symbol/type/TIF/非正数量的拒绝，以及购买力证据。
- 保留 modify/protection 的能力缺失；cancel 不视为缺失，保留独立 native-string-id leaf 与其 availability/outcome evidence。

**具体替代与修正**

- 拒绝未知 TIF、缺失的 GTD 到期时间/时区、未设置的 LMT、无效 Decimal/tick/lot、含糊的 scope、不支持的关系/跟踪；不再使用未知→Day。
- 保持 string IDs 不透明，投影前精确解码 response/status。
- 用 writer/observer 替代直接修改/部分替换/合成状态；确认前已接受归为 Unknown/Observe。
- 不凭空添加幂等性/补偿；终态需要身份/判据；残余敞口归为 RecoveryRequired。
- 只读/无权限时可生成 Preview，但不可生成 EffectJob。
- 将无回复/到期/无法投递的控制策略设为必填，并按注册冻结；在同一 CAS 下使用 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，绝不在超时后自动执行。
- 将 cancel 暴露为独立 provider leaf：使用 native string order ID 与 scope/channel，要求 conformance 的 availability、ack/not-found 与 outcome evidence；禁止 synthetic Cancelled，send 后 unknown 进入 Observe。

**副作用与状态归属**

- 解释器负责 Submit/Replace 选项及状态/错误编解码器；SDK 类不跨边界。
- Writer 负责持久化意图/批准/派发/未知/恢复；reader 仅提供证据。
- Lookup 负责 detail/list 覆盖范围；兼容性 OpenOrder 仅用于展示。

**失败与恢复**

- 派发前失败：IdentityUnavailable、UnsupportedVariant、InvalidTIF/Expiry、QuantityUnitMismatch、InvalidPrice、ProtectionUnavailable、EnvironmentUnknown。
- 已知拒绝需要 schema+action 关联；开始后的未知结果归为 OutcomeUnknown/Observe。
- 未知状态保留为 Unknown(raw)，而非 Submitted；缺失详情归为 Partial/Unavailable，除非已证明不存在。
- Close 敞口不匹配/证据过期会阻止执行/触发重新准备；市价平仓不是 Exact 补偿。
- 重复或查询 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted 证据，不返回可复用的 DispatchGrant；仅有持久化批准证据不能跨越原生发送边界。
- Cancel 的 known ack/not-found 只能按 provider conformance 归类；send 后异常或无响应归为 OutcomeUnknown/Observe，不合成 Cancelled。

**原生证据边界**

- Envelope/version、状态/错误码、查询完整性、幂等性、确认前已接受、parent/OCO/protection、金额跟踪/名义金额、cancel/replace 语义仍未验证。
- marker/enums 不能证明 Paper/live 的 endpoint/account 一致性及 TIF/session 接受情况。
- Mock promise 完成不能证明 ack/fill/cancel/finality。

**单一权威切换**

- 每次组合一个绑定 schema 的效应叶节点，使用 provider 已证实的变体；不盲目继承 schema enum，也不使用兼容垫片。
- 先运行离线一致性校验/导入，再通过 writer/原生 lookup 切换到单一权威；移除递归 close/直接写入/合成状态/数值 IDs。
- 声称重试/幂等性前，使用独立远程账本进行崩溃切点测试；否则保留 Unknown。
- 迁移保留独立 cancel leaf 与 native string order ID；先取得 availability/outcome conformance，再允许调用，未知结果始终由 observation 收口。

<a id="lvenue-alpaca-orders"></a>

### LVENUE-ALPACA-ORDERS：Alpaca：订单输入、受控写入与边界投影

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-contracts.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- place/replace/cancel/close 直接消费 mutable IBKR `Contract`/`Order`，把 qty/notional、limit/stop/trailing、TIF、extended hours 和 bracket/OTO 数据拼成 untyped SDK record。place 立即 POST，replace 直接 PATCH，cancel/close 将 void/response 映射成本地 terminal state；status/legs/filled data 被压缩进 legacy `OrderState`/`PlaceOrderResult`。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 以 `Order` base unit 加 provider exact extensions 形成 schema product；`Units|Notional`、`Set|Retain` 等 genuine alternatives 是小型 tagged sums，禁止 Cartesian order types。Alpaca leaves 分别声明 input/success/failure/prepared/ack/observation/recovery/compensation schema；所有 schema 与 `Constraint` identifier/version/evaluator/digest 在 construction 绑定。`withTransaction` 只包装 place/replace/cancel/close 等 mutation recipe，query invoker 不可拿到 native dispatch function。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 qty 与 notional 的 provider 语义差异，并在输入 schema 中显式互斥；不再 qty 胜出而吞掉 notional。
- 保留 native TIF、outside-hours、trailing、OTO/bracket/held leg、parent/child IDs 和 order class；未证实的变体保持 unavailable/structurally absent。
- 保留 close 的 Full 与受本地 exposure preflight 限制的 QuantityTarget 语义；不宣称 Alpaca DELETE 提供 reduce-only/CAS。

**具体替代与修正**

- place 输入由 `InstrumentId`、`AccountScope`、Order clauses、provider extension 与 exact sizing/protection schema 构成；字段单位和约束在 boundary 解析。
- 准备阶段冻结 catalog/price/sizing/permission/criterion evidence，写入 serializable prepared payload；writer 先提交 DispatchPlanned，再以唯一 AttemptId 和 permission witness 提交 DispatchStarted，之后才调用 SDK。
- OTO/bracket 以有序 leg/group records 保存每个 native ID 与 status；在缺乏 atomicity evidence 时使用显式 `IndependentBatch`/逐 leg observation，不将父订单 ack 解释为子腿成交。
- replace 采用 `Retain|Set(value)` tagged amendment；只有新 native evidence 支持时才增加 Clear。保存 before-image、provider order version（若有）和 command identity；unknown 禁止盲目 PATCH 重试。
- cancel 返回 acknowledged/working/unknown observation；void 不等于 remote cancelled。close 的 native full path 与 local reverse-order partial path 分开声明，partial 先检查 `quantity <= observed exposure`。
- 不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。
- 新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。

**副作用与状态归属**

- JournalWriter/CAS/command dedupe、reservation、approval、DispatchStarted 和 recovery 由 UTA single writer 管理；Alpaca SDK 只在 private interpretation 内发送。
- 每个 mutation 叶子独立保留 prepared/ack/observation；组合策略不由一个 global BrokerActionTypeMap 推断。
- data pulls（catalog/account/quote）只提供选中 evidence，不被 `withTransaction` 事务化。

**失败与恢复**

- 输入/schema/permission/stale revision/constraint rejection 在 handler 前返回 typed expected failure；native 4xx/5xx、malformed output、transport/timeout 按阶段分类。
- POST/PATCH/DELETE crossing 后 response loss、cancel ambiguity、group child gap 都保留 Unknown/RecoveryRequired，先按原 BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId/dispatch identity observe。
- 只有有证据的 terminal rejection 才释放 reservation；ack、working、fill、cancel、replace criterion 分开。
- no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 的冻结 policy 必须是 `SuspendControl|CloseWithoutDispatch|EscalateDecision` 之一；timeout 与 response 在同一 control CAS 下竞争，绝不自动 fallback 执行。

**原生证据边界**

- installed SDK source 只证明 POST/PATCH/DELETE、client-ID lookup 与 full-close endpoint 的存在，不证明 idempotency horizon、group atomicity、held-leg retention、final-state absence、replace queue priority、reduce-only 或 compensation。
- Alpaca order status future enum、TIF/order-class legality、fractional/tick limits 和 protection semantics 需 provider conformance；unknown status 不再静默 Submitted。

**单一权威切换**

- 按 place→replace→cancel→close 分别生成 provider leaves，先迁移 callers 与 CLI/AI projection，再删除 mutable IBKR action entrypoint。
- 迁移所有 callers 到 typed receipt/observation；离线 parity/import 仅核对旧输出，随后删除 `PlaceOrderResult`/`OrderState` shape。只有已验证的 published external boundary 仍要求该形状时，才在边界保留只读投影；它绝不具备 execution authority。

<a id="lvenue-alpaca-order-observation"></a>

### LVENUE-ALPACA-ORDER-OBSERVATION：Alpaca：订单查询、列表覆盖与 execution observation

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-types.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/alpaca-types.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- getOrder 将 UUID response cast 为 AlpacaOrderRaw，所有异常变成 null；batch/list 只返回成功 rows，open listing 不分页；legacy OpenOrder/OrderState 丢掉 provider status、client identity、version、legs 与 coverage。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 订单 observation 是 AccountScope-bound finite Pull，使用 exact `AlpacaOrderRaw` decoder 与 `OrderObservation` schema。单 ID lookup 返回 `Found|AbsentWithEvidence|Unknown|Malformed`，list 返回每个 request/cursor 的 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable` 并保留 source/as-of/namespace evidence；open presence 与 absence 分开，held/conditional legs 不能由 open list 空结果否定。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 UUID BrokerOrderId、client_order_id、created/updated/filled timestamps、legs、filled qty/price 与 native status。
- 批量输入顺序、每个 ID 的结果和 list pagination/namespace evidence 均可观察；找不到一项不能缩短数组。
- 旧 null/OrderState 只作为已验证 published external boundary 的只读输入/输出投影候选；默认迁移 callers 到 typed outcomes 后删除，不作为 NotFound 或 terminal authority。

**具体替代与修正**

- raw responses 先 runtime parse；status 使用 exhaustive known/Unknown variant，未来 status 不降级 Submitted。
- 按 provider cursor/limit 实现 bounded iteration，保存 coverage and query scope；必要时用 getOrder confirmation 做 absence evidence。
- getOrder/list/open-list 与 mutation recovery 分离；只有 known DispatchId/BrokerOrderId 观察可解未知 effect。
- 保留 parent/child/OTO/bracket held legs separately，不能把 order class map 压平为一个 TP/SL pair。

**副作用与状态归属**

- order data pull 使用 reader/SDK R，不持有 order transaction；selected observation 可供 recovery job。
- UTA writer 才决定 command/dispatch terminality；SDK list response 不自动释放 reservation。

**失败与恢复**

- auth/transport/schema/protocol/coverage errors typed；unknown/timeout after a possible send remains Unknown.
- open list absence only after documented complete namespace; otherwise Partial/Unknown and observe by identity.
- 历史 schema/version unavailable after DispatchStarted requires exact recovery, never reinterpret new response.

**原生证据边界**

- SDK declaration uses any and does not establish complete status enum, pagination/default namespace, client ID retention, held-leg visibility or final absence semantics。
- Alpaca raw shape omission of client/version/legs is not proof those fields never exist.

**单一权威切换**

- 先实现 typed lookup/list/observation leaves，再迁移 batch/order projections and close recovery callers。
- 删除 catch-all null、drop-on-error、single-page/static open assumptions；离线 parity/import 完成后删除旧 `OrderState`/null projection，除非有已验证 published external boundary 的明确要求。

<a id="lvenue-leverup-effect"></a>

### LVENUE-LEVERUP-EFFECT：Leverup：受控 open/close、relayer acknowledgement 与恢复

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- open 只支持 MKT，按 Pyth price 与 qty*price 假设 1x USDC/LVUSD，立即 sign→POST 并把 inputHash 放进 in-memory map；close 选第一条 OPEN position、忽略 quantity、整仓签名；status booleans 与 timer 被映射为 Submitted/Filled/false；modify/cancel 固定 unsupported。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 只发布 source-backed `order.open` 与 explicit whole-close leaf；modify/cancel 叶子结构上不存在。Open/close 的 exact provider schema、units, price/protection, signer, relayer, ack, observation, recovery 与 compensation evidence 在 declaration construction 时绑定；dynamic certification 绑定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest/schema slot。`withTransaction(recipe, policy)` 返回 public receipt/handle，native dispatch 留在 private interpreter。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 MKT-only 当前能力边界、Pyth price/update、qty/price/amountIn native fields 与 MONAD endpoint intent（待 endpoint evidence）。
- legacy omitted close quantity 只映射为 explicit `All`；supplied quantity 选择 absent `Units`，在 DispatchStarted 前拒绝。
- inputHash/txnHash/reason 保留为 opaque validated evidence；Ack 不等于 fill/finality。
- modify/cancel 不发布 command/CLI；不得用 cancel-and-replace 冒充 cancel。

**具体替代与修正**

- prepare 需 Complete scoped position/catalog/scale/price/network/schema evidence；把 exact request/derived values、schema digest、policy、expiry 写入 serializable plan。
- writer 先 `DispatchPlanned`，再在唯一 attempt/permission/CAS 下写 `DispatchStarted`，然后 sign/POST；调用结束只返回 action-specific Ack/Rejected/Unknown。
- response loss/timeout/false status 进入 observation/recovery；原 inputHash/dispatch identity 复用，禁止 schema fallback、new salt 或 blind resend。
- close effect 由 scoped `PositionRef {AccountScope, InstrumentId, positionHash, observationRevision}` 编译；whole/partial semantics 独立。
- native idempotency/atomicity/finality 未证明时使用 ObserveBeforeRetry 与 explicit compensation grade None/不允许的 policy。
- 不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。
- 新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。

**副作用与状态归属**

- UTA JournalWriter/approval/permission witness/lease/CAS/outbox 唯一拥有 write authority；relayer client 不持有 durable order state。
- reader/Pyth data observations 与 controlled effect records 分离；status GET 只在 known effect identity 下进入 recovery。
- ReturnToAgent 若 configured 只保留未发送 intent/evidence/outbox，不创建 relayer dispatch；source fact 不能授权。

**失败与恢复**

- pre-handler invalid MKT/pair/quantity/scale/schema/permission 为 expected typed failure；post-start HTTP/JSON/process errors 为 Unknown/RecoveryRequired。
- `executed=false`、`success=false`、poll timeout 不能单独成为 Rejected；只有 evidenced terminal refusal 才结案。
- 一个 revision 只能有一个 activation owner/attempt identity；未知状态下 lease expiry 不允许 resend。
- no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 的冻结 policy 必须是 `SuspendControl|CloseWithoutDispatch|EscalateDecision` 之一；timeout 与 response 在同一 control CAS 下竞争，绝不自动 fallback 执行。

**原生证据边界**

- relayer duplicate-submit/inputHash retention, accepted EIP-712 schema, Pyth update semantic effect, chain finality, close partial support, status retention/finality and native cancellation/atomicity remain empirical.
- 测试 fixtures only prove request shape/stub transition; no live transaction or wallet fund claim.

**单一权威切换**

- 先将 protocols codecs/schemas/private signer/relayer behind provider leaves，再接 durable writer and observation jobs。
- 迁移 old `LeverupBroker.placeOrder/closePosition/getOrder` callers；删除 in-memory order map, mutable schema switch, generic errors and unsupported fake methods。

<a id="lvenue-protocol-relayer"></a>

### LVENUE-PROTOCOL-RELAYER：LeverupProtocols：Relayer acknowledgement、status 与 durable polling

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/relayer-client.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/relayer-client.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/others/leverup/LeverupBroker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- relayer-client.ts 用 raw request/response interfaces 与 generic `post<T>` cast；open/close POST 只回 inputHash，status GET 只回 executed/success/txnHash/reason；poll 用 setInterval-like timer，30 秒后伪造失败 status。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 为 open/close/status 分别声明 exact request/success/failure/observation schemas；`RemoteOutcome = Confirmed|Rejected|StillWorking|Unknown` 只用于有 known effect identity 的 controlled observation。`post<T>` 被 provider-specific action leaves 取代；HTTP effect 持有 endpoint generation/timeout/cancel/size policy，writer 负责 Dispatch barriers 与 recovery。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 inputHash、txnHash、reason 等 native evidence（经 schema 验证）；open/close action schemas 不合成一个 untyped union。
- 异步 acknowledgement 仍可立即返回，但明确 Ack/Working 与 Filled/Finality 分层。
- poll interval/timeout 只作为 scheduler policy hint，不再产生 terminal rejection。

**具体替代与修正**

- 记录 request digest/schema/version/scope/dispatch/attempt before POST；DispatchStarted 是唯一 mutation boundary。
- POST response decode 为 typed Ack；GET status 关联 `OpaqueLookupRef` 与 expected effect identity，保留 as-of/endpoint generation。
- 用 durable observation job/checkpoint/lease/backoff 取代 in-memory timer；failure 后不能 Completed，status item error 与 terminal outcome 分开。
- response loss/timeout/transport unknown 观察原 inputHash；native idempotency unproven 时 observe-before-retry，不生成新 POST。
- controlled plan/contract/command 使用目标 canonicalization：RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、full 64-hex 与 domain-separated/versioned digest；本窄协议 fixture 只记录设计前提，不宣称已实现该持久 writer。

**副作用与状态归属**

- HTTP client/transport timer/cancel 属于 Relayer Effect R；writer 的 command identity/permission/recovery 属于 UTA。
- status query 若非 controlled effect 仅是 data observation，不自动拿 AccountScope 或交易 lock。
- 只有 fresh writer Start 可发出 process-bound one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 仅返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，persisted authorization 不可重放。

**失败与恢复**

- pre-send validation/HTTP refusal 可是 typed expected failure；post-start bad JSON/connection loss 为 Unknown。
- `executed=false`/`success=false` 没有 terminal evidence 就是 StillWorking/Unknown；poll deadline 不改事实。
- 旧 interpretation unavailable after start 保留原 sealed request/identity RecoveryRequired，不能 reprepare。

**原生证据边界**

- inputHash dedup/retention/namespace、relayer status semantics、txn finality、chain confirmation、headers/auth and endpoint limits 需 native evidence。

**单一权威切换**

- 按 action/status 拆 exact codecs/adapter Effects，再让 Leverup effect leaf 使用 durable scheduler。
- 删除 generic post/casts, timer-synthetic status, boolean failure mapping and in-memory submission authority。

<a id="lvenue-mock-order"></a>

### LVENUE-MOCK-ORDER：MockBroker：订单叶子、状态观察与纯会计 reducer

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 旧 Mock 用 mutable SDK objects 与 default Filled/Submitted state；MKT 立即按 mark fill，LMT/STP pending，STP LMT 被 matcher collapse；modify/cancel/close 原地变更 map，getOrder unknown=null，partial fill 通过缩短 totalQuantity 丢失 requested quantity，multiplier 缺失 fallback=1。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Mock provider 只发布 exact declared leaves：`place`（MKT/LMT/STP，StopLimit absent）、可选 `amend`、`cancel`、`close`。Input 使用 `MockPlaceInput`/`MockAmendment`/`MockCancelInput`/`MockCloseInput`，OrderRef 带 AccountScope 与 opaque broker/client ID；expectedOrderVersion/exposureVersion 是显式 CAS。Output 区分 Ack/Working/Filled/Cancelled/Unknown；read lookup 是 Found/AbsentWithEvidence/Unknown/Malformed。WAC/short/multiplier 是 pure reducers，不等于 native venue semantics。 Coverage 只使用固定 `Complete|Partial|Unavailable`；某个值、字段质量或协议状态未知时保留独立 payload/reason 或局部结果 union，不新增全局 coverage variant。 受控定义的完整形态是 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`：receipt/control-result 与每个 stage-error schema 始终绑定 recipe；admission 的 services/permissions 与 native execution R/P 分离，安装 interpreter 只能 discharge native R，不能制造 execution permission。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 MKT immediate fill、LMT/STP pending、manual fill/cancel、full/partial close、long/short/WAC/option multiplier behavior where explicitly configured。
- 保留 quantity/limit/trigger/trailing/TIF/target fields only when their leaf declares them；TPSL/StopLimit ignored paths 不再静默宣称 support。
- 保留 exact Decimal accounting and order/exposure identities；原始 requested quantity 与 fills 分开。

**具体替代与修正**

- Place schema 以 tagged order kind 与 Quantity/Price units 构造；provider capabilities omit StopLimit until trigger→working-limit semantics exists。
- modify/cancel 叶子若启用，要求 expected order version、scope、opaque ID；amend fields 为 Retain/Set，返回 Ack then observation。
- close 输入显式 `All|QuantityTarget`、target/policy/expiry/exposure version；opposite market reducer 只是 Mock implementation，不冒充 reduce-only/atomicity。
- Order observations 不在 read 时 mutate SDK object；Partial fill 记录 original requested, cumulative/leaves, execution identity, price/time。
- missing/invalid multiplier 是 typed Unavailable/Invalid；WAC reducer 对 oversell/short/mixed exposures 返回 explicit error/incomplete。
- 不从候选文档或旧 enum 盲目继承变体；只有该 provider leaf 的 construction-bound schema/evidence 才产生输入 alternative。
- 新的 `Start` writer transition 只在 fresh admission 成功时生成 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，不生成可重放 grant。persisted authorization evidence 不是 grant。

**副作用与状态归属**

- pure match/reduce functions 在 test layer 内；controlled mock effect 仍走 writer permission/Dispatch barriers。
- read/list/order projection 是 data pulls，失败不补偿；DurableMockVenue 才提供 remote outcome/restart proof。
- AccountScope、InstrumentId、ExposureKey、BrokerOrderId/ClientOrderId、DispatchId distinct。

**失败与恢复**

- schema/expected version/scope/exposure/multiplier errors 在 handler 前 rejected；pending→fill/cancel observations typed。
- crash/transport after start returns Unknown; observe remote ledger before resend。
- native guarantee gaps（idempotency, absence, atomicity, reversibility）保持 evidence-gated；mock immediate fill 只属 fixture policy。
- no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 的冻结 policy 必须是 `SuspendControl|CloseWithoutDispatch|EscalateDecision` 之一；timeout 与 response 在同一 control CAS 下竞争，绝不自动 fallback 执行。

**原生证据边界**

- Mock `setMark`/matcher/map mutation/legacy success records 不证明 external venue fill/finality/cancel/replacement semantics。
- STP LMT advertised-versus-collapsed contradiction is preserved as evidence; no StopLimit leaf until independent state-machine evidence.

**单一权威切换**

- 先拆 exact input/output/error codecs 与 pure reducers，再迁移 existing order/account tests to scoped fixture leaves。
- 删除 Partial SDK mutation, null success/failure, default multiplier/mark, lossy clone and generic legacy PlaceOrderResult authority。

### LCORE-PROTOCOL-ERROR-FAILURE：协议错误、未知结果与边界解码

**源码文件：** [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.spec.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.spec.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/types.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/types.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/errors.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/errors.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- broker.ts 以 BrokerErrorCode 七值 union、Error subclass、message regex 和 permanent 布尔推导失败；BrokerError.from 接受 unknown 的 name/code 结构。WireBrokerError 又把错误压为 code/message/transient/hint，测试使用 Object.assign(Error) 与未知 code。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 在 boundary decode unknown→exact `Failure` ADT，并按 capability identity/path、provider instance、request/attempt、schema revision/digest 关联。Load/input/domain/output/transport/authorization/provider rejection/storage/DispatchUnknown 各自保留；expected native rejection、pending observation 与 unknown 不相等。permission witness 与 Effect service 不能由错误分类伪造。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留现有 BrokerError code/message precedence 作为 provider adapter 的历史解析输入，以及未知 code 的安全保留；不把 regex 命中视为跨 provider 永久性证据。
- 保留敏感信息不得进入 descriptor/diagnostics，错误 projection 可 redacted 但 replay payload 必须是独立 sealed representation。
- MAP-654966E128: Keep coverage that a failure encoded by an independently loaded broker pack can be consumed by the UTA protocol.
- MAP-654966E128: Intentionally remove the assertion that a value is instanceof BrokerError; package identity must not be part of the contract.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: Preserve the test guarantee that recognized AUTH evidence survives a package boundary.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: Correct the guarantee that `cause` is part of the public result: keep it only in redacted logs and retain structured failure data for callers.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: Keep the fact that unrecognized native codes cannot be trusted as a known code.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: Intentionally change silent fallback to UNKNOWN into explicit unknown evidence, preventing false retry/terminal claims.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: Preserve Decimal precision by encoding decimal strings and preserve native fields only as adapter metadata when evidence requires it.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: Intentionally remove SDK objects from every public protocol type, including read projections.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: Preserve stable labels for existing user-facing CONFIG/AUTH/NETWORK cases via an explicit presentation mapping.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: Correct reliance on a universal UNKNOWN code by retaining unknown native values and requiring recovery classification.
- MAP-710D1204ED: Keep legacy AUTH/CONFIG non-retryable behavior as adapter evidence only; provider mappings and account impact remain explicit policy, not a universal code rule.
- MAP-710D1204ED: Preserve CONNECTING non-failure behavior but move it out of Error and health failure counters.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: Preserve cross-package code recognition for known variants.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: Intentionally stop constructing a new Error for every unknown source; callers receive typed failures and diagnostics remain local.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: Preserve the observed regex precedence and redacted lexical evidence as adapter-local diagnostics during migration; it is not a native guarantee.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: Correct regex-driven status claims by retaining UnclassifiedNativeFailure/Unknown and requiring observation after a possible remote side effect.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: Preserve human-readable hint/message as redacted presentation text.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: Correct universal wire shape and generic client exception by route-specific exhaustive codecs.

**具体替代与修正**

- MAP-654966E128: Change broker.spec.ts to import schemas/codecs from the protocol public entry point.
- MAP-654966E128: Add one fixture per action-associated failure family and delete direct class construction once adapters expose normalized output.
- MAP-654966E128: Keep class-specific tests in each adapter package, not in shared protocol.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: Replace BrokerError.from assertion with decode/encode round-trip and an adapter mapping assertion.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: Move native `Error.cause` assertions to adapter diagnostics tests.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: Make action association and scope mandatory when the failure originates during dispatch.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: Change the test expectation to assert rawCode preservation and UnknownBrokerFailure.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: Add protocol-version/mappingVersion to pack boundary and recovery classifier.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: Expose a stable redacted response while keeping native code out of user-facing messages where sensitive.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: Replace imports and side-effect augmentation with protocol-local brands/codecs.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: Create one native codec per adapter and migrate services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/types.ts callers to SPI interfaces.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: Delete the compatibility barrel once all adapters/application code consume normalized contracts.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: Define route-specific schemas and adapter mapping functions.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: Replace all BROKER_ERROR_CODES.has calls with exhaustive codecs.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: Update pack compatibility negotiation so new variants are rejected by version rather than accepted as strings.
- MAP-710D1204ED: Introduce failure/readiness schemas and map legacy catches in UTA/broker adapters.
- MAP-710D1204ED: Remove extends Error from protocol domain model after diagnostic call sites migrate.
- MAP-710D1204ED: Make policy decisions consume variants, not code/permanent.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: Port existing adapter catches to parseNativeFailure once per SDK boundary.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: Replace BrokerError.from imports with the typed parser or retain a private compatibility adapter only until caller migration.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: Add redaction before logs and HTTP encoding.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: Move the regex table into each adapter as a last-resort classifier that emits HeuristicEvidence, with explicit redaction and classifier version.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: Add provider-specific structured response codecs only when native fields and retry/idempotency evidence are documented; map unsupported facts to UnclassifiedNativeFailure.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: Remove shared `classifyMessage` after all callers consume the typed failure/recovery ADTs; do not replace it with an unverified shared mapping.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: Define schemas in `protocol/` and map all transaction/query/capability routes.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: Migrate UTAClient to typed decoding and preserve status/body for diagnostics only.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: Delete WireBrokerError and generic `error` property requirement.

**副作用与状态归属**

- 错误解释是 construction-bound descriptor/adapter effect；纯 domain reducer 只处理已解码 failure variant。持久控制日志记录最小 predicate checkpoint 和 selected execution evidence，不把完整 feed 当 WAL。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-654966E128: effectBoundary=No IO in the protocol test. Native adapter tests construct the failure locally; HTTP/application tests consume the encoded envelope through the transport decoder. durability=The durable journal stores the typed failure reference and schema version, not a class name, stack, or cause object. The fixture must be stable across package copies and process restarts.
MAP-ACEFB58A14: effectBoundary=Pure codec and constructor only. Credential and broker adapters provide the redacted message/code; transport maps the ADT to HTTP/tool presentation. durability=Journal `DispatchFailed`/`ObservationRecorded` stores actionRef, dispatch identity, failure tag, and evidence reference atomically with progress. The cause stack is local telemetry only; no persisted pointer may depend on object identity.
MAP-1A43E0FCC4: effectBoundary=The protocol parser is pure; an adapter supplies its versioned mapping table. Scheduler/application consumes the typed result and may issue an explicit observation job. durability=Persist rawCode as redacted evidence, mappingVersion, and the attempt/action identity in the event payload. Do not overwrite a previously unknown event when a newer mapping becomes available; projections may enrich separately.
MAP-D4DBF6173C: effectBoundary=No IO in protocol/domain codecs. Adapter layer owns SDK parsing and secret injection; application/effect services own fetching facts and journal writes. durability=Journal/event schemas store canonical encoded values plus encoding version, not SDK objects or Decimal instances. Projection rows use normalized codecs and can be rebuilt without loading a broker pack.
MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: effectBoundary=Schema decoding is pure and transport/application use it at HTTP/plugin boundaries. No global registry or mutable Set is consulted by domain decisions. durability=Events store failureTag + schemaVersion + redacted evidence reference. A mapping-table version belongs to the adapter diagnostic, not a global set shared by all brokers.
MAP-710D1204ED: effectBoundary=Health reducer/application is pure; connection service emits typed readiness/failure events. Effect catches native exceptions once and translates them before entering domain. durability=Persist health/failure events with event time, connection generation, subject and typed failure evidence. Do not persist stack/cause or derive retry decisions from Error.message.
MAP-6ED1656D7F: effectBoundary=Parsing is pure. Adapter boundary catches SDK exceptions; effect interpreter supplies context and logs diagnostics. The transport codec never receives raw cause objects. durability=Persist only redacted evidence and references; event schema version and mapping version make replays deterministic even if a pack later changes its classifier.
MAP-9F0ED3057E: effectBoundary=Pure helper may run inside adapter. Network/HTTP response acquisition and redaction occur in adapter effect code; recovery and transaction writer consume typed output. durability=Persist redacted evidence, evidenceKind, adapter/mapping/classifier version, dispatch phase, action/dispatch identity, scope, and source sequence. Preserve native and heuristic evidence separately; never overwrite an unknown event with a later heuristic mapping or use it as an absence proof.
MAP-430A3CCB4D: effectBoundary=HTTP transport/application owns status and authentication; domain failures are constructed before encoding. No generic `Error.message` is consumed for retry/recovery. durability=Journal stores domain failure/event references and schema versions; HTTP response is a projection. Storage failure must not be collapsed into broker transient or retried mutation.

**失败与恢复**

- 未知 native fields/code、schema slot mismatch、provider load failure、output decode failure、storage failure、post-dispatch unknown 都必须成为可查询的 typed variant；Failed stream terminal 后不能追加 Completed。
- MAP-654966E128: ProtocolViolation(unsupportedFailureTag) -&gt; reject malformed wire input and surface a typed transport failure.
- MAP-654966E128: BrokerRejection(opaqueCode, redactedEvidence) -&gt; expose non-retryable/unknown semantics without throwing a generic Error.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: AuthenticationFailure(subject, evidence) -&gt; apply disable/reauthorization only under documented adapter/application policy; do not retry blindly or infer universal permanence.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: BrokerRejected(actionRef, reason, retryability) -&gt; settle the associated step according to FailurePolicy.
- MAP-ACEFB58A14: ProtocolViolation(leaf schema/category mismatch) -&gt; reject at decode.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: ProtocolViolation(invalidTagOrShape) -&gt; reject request before journal mutation.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: UnknownBrokerFailure(code) -&gt; record and suspend automatic retry until observation/evidence or operator recovery.
- MAP-1A43E0FCC4: CodeMappingUnavailable(version) -&gt; mark adapter capability degraded.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: ProtocolDependencyViolation(module) -&gt; fail package boundary/build gate.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: InvalidDecimalString(field) / InvalidInstrumentIdentity -&gt; reject wire/domain construction.
- MAP-D4DBF6173C: PlanVersionUnsupported(adapterVersion) -&gt; refuse dispatch rather than reinterpret native data.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: ProtocolViolation(malformedPayload) -&gt; return structured 4xx/pack load failure.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: UnsupportedFailureVariant(tag) -&gt; preserve evidence and suspend automatic dispatch.
- MAP-6C0ADD0EA4: CapabilityUnavailable(action, reason) -&gt; caller must choose another action or leave plan unqueued.
- MAP-710D1204ED: DocumentedAuthenticationFailure(subject, evidence) -&gt; adapter/application policy may disable or require reauthorization; heuristic evidence cannot authorize retry.
- MAP-710D1204ED: DocumentedNetworkFailure(subject, evidence) -&gt; policy may schedule retry with backoff while retaining health evidence; unknown/post-dispatch outcomes remain observation/recovery.
- MAP-710D1204ED: ConnectionStarting(subject) -&gt; return typed pending query result, not a transaction failure.
- MAP-710D1204ED: BrokerRejected(actionRef, reason, retryability) -&gt; settle associated action according to FailurePolicy.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: ProtocolViolation(rawShape) -&gt; reject input or mark pack incompatibility.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: UnknownBrokerFailure(rawCode) -&gt; durable unknown outcome; no blind resend.
- MAP-6ED1656D7F: MissingDispatchContext -&gt; defect/configuration failure before journal commit.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: UnclassifiedNativeFailure(evidence) -&gt; persist Unknown and enqueue observation/recovery; never retry solely because a lexical match says NETWORK.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: HeuristicInsufficientEvidence -&gt; UnknownBrokerFailure with `ObserveUnknown`, not MarketSessionClosed or TransportFailure.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: ProtocolViolation(invalidStructuredShape) -&gt; reject malformed adapter output before journal mutation.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E: NativeMappingUnavailable(adapterVersion) -&gt; capability/evidence gap; block safe dispatch classification without claiming provider support.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: ProtocolViolation -&gt; invalid request/pack protocol failure.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: VersionConflict(scope, expected, observed) -&gt; caller reloads current transaction.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: DispatchUnknown(identity) -&gt; query/recovery, no retry by HTTP client.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: StorageUnavailable -&gt; report unavailable; no receipt claimed.
- MAP-430A3CCB4D: BrokerRejection -&gt; map action policy, not generic 500.

**原生证据边界**

- 各 adapter structured code precedence、retryability、idempotency/absence 和 terminal semantics 仍未在 shared source 得到证明，归 provider evidence，不可用 shared regex 补齐。

- MAP-710D1204ED future falsifiers: Feed CONNECTING into a read route and observe a pending/retry response with unchanged failure counter. | Feed a documented AUTH mapping into recovery and observe its declared no-retry/disable policy; an unverified AUTH-like message remains Unknown rather than forcing that policy. | Feed an EXCHANGE rejection under ContinueOnKnownRejection and observe batch continuation with the rejected step recorded.

- MAP-9F0ED3057E open questions: Native SDK/provider error fields, stable code precedence, and idempotency/absence guarantees are unavailable in this shared source; each adapter must supply evidence before classifying a native failure as safe retry or terminal rejection.
- MAP-9F0ED3057E future falsifiers: A structured adapter response with an evidenced market-closed code maps to KnownNativeFailure/MarketSessionClosed; an ambiguous 403 text maps to UnclassifiedNativeFailure and Unknown rather than a guessed AUTH/EXCHANGE result. | A timeout text after a durable DispatchStarted produces ObserveUnknown/RecoveryRequired and no second dispatch, even if the heuristic label would otherwise be NETWORK. | An unmapped native code is retained as redacted evidence with mappingVersion; changing the mapping later does not mutate the original attempt event.

**单一权威切换**

- 先在 HTTP/foreign bridge/SDK adapter boundary 完成一次解码，再让 public route、journal、CLI 和 AI projection 消费精确 ADT；删除裸 `Error.message`、success boolean 和全局 WireBrokerError 作为领域契约的用途。

### LCORE-CATALOG-PRESENTATION：展示 schema、公共 barrel 与搜索路由

**源码文件：** [packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/presets.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/presets.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/index.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/index.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/presets.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/presets.spec.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- presets.ts 从 catalog 生成 SerializedBrokerPreset 与 raw `schema: Record<string,unknown>`，buildJsonSchema 对 Zod 输出做 cast/mutate，BUILTIN_BROKER_PRESETS 是进程级数组；protocol/schemas barrel 为空或 re-export native types，测试只验证 raw sample config 与 engine schema round-trip。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `PresetPresentationCatalog`、`SerializedPreset`、`JsonSchemaDocument` 与 runtime `ConnectionIntent` 分离；presentation AST 由受限 structural schema algebra + Zod-derived construction 生成并 versioned，mode labels/writeOnly 是 immutable projection，绝不含 secret values。schemas barrel 提供 versioned probe/scope/search/Draft/Prepare/Approve/Reject/Recover/query envelopes，而不是 global action map。

- 保留搜索规则的 source symbol/rule version、per-provider source grouping、explicit no-match/partial result；展示成功不等于 provider ready/authorized。

**副作用与状态归属**

- presentation generation 是 pure；runtime parse/pack/evidence query 是 boundary effect。CLI/HTTP/AI projection 只调用 final definition/catalog，不直接调用 recipe，不把 schema parse 当权限。

Record-level boundaries:
MAP-21AAC99E0D: effectBoundary=Building the presentation view is pure and must not load packs, resolve secrets, or import vendor SDKs. HTTP/UI code may serialize the view; connection effects happen only in the runtime composition layer. durability=Persisted config stores PresetId and typed serializable values/SecretRefs, not generated UI schemas. Schema version is a wire/view concern and cannot mutate account identity or journal history.
MAP-F8525C7A99: effectBoundary=The encoder is pure. Public protocol serialization/deserialization is the boundary; no vendor SDK, SecretMaterial, Effect, or live capability object can inhabit the serialized record. durability=Only stable display metadata and schema version are sent/stored. Secret fields remain write-only references; presentation snapshots are rebuildable and have no journal or execution authority.
MAP-5C311A55C1: effectBoundary=Schema building is pure CPU transformation; it has no network/IO and must not import adapter SDKs. The HTTP/UI effect boundary serializes the resulting document. durability=Generated schema snapshots are rebuildable and versioned; no schema object is persisted as account identity or action capability. A failed schema build must not prevent loading a previously persisted account.
MAP-1D576100CB: effectBoundary=Construction is pure and SDK-free; consuming routes may cache/serialize it. Readiness and capability queries are effects with freshness and scope evidence. durability=Persisted accounts reference PresetId/AccountId, never array position or serialized schema object. Presentation rebuilds must not alter durable transaction state.
MAP-AE04CD83E4: effectBoundary=Barrel assembly is pure module wiring. Importing the public package must not evaluate optional vendor SDKs or load secrets; HTTP/client effects occur in UTAClient/route boundaries. durability=Public schema/version identifiers are durable compatibility contracts; changing exports requires coordinated client/UTA migration. No protocol type owns SQL or broker runtime state.
MAP-E43DFC70EF: effectBoundary=Schema parsing/encoding is a boundary effect-adjacent pure function; Hono validation and client fetch are IO boundaries. Schemas contain no SDK objects, Effect values, credentials, or functions. durability=Schema versions and aggregate/event versions are explicit wire metadata. JournalWriter/transaction state remains server-side; responses expose receipts/projections, not mutation authority.
MAP-6E311CAABB: effectBoundary=Tests should call pure codecs directly and use a narrow in-memory Effect fixture for pack/secret/evidence boundaries; they must not import vendor SDKs or rely on global generic factory state. durability=Fixture journal/account store must expose durable identity and sealed-binding assertions; presentation snapshots are disposable and cannot stand in for runtime state.
MAP-D74564C976: effectBoundary=Fixture construction is pure except for the fake resolver/evidence provider used in scoped adapter tests; no network or vendor SDK is required. durability=Fixture account store includes stable AccountId/legacy aliases and sealed-binding metadata; each test uses isolated logical scope rather than a new process-wide resource.
MAP-076B691F74: effectBoundary=Pure catalog/lookup test; pack-unavailable case uses a deterministic loader stub, not real SDK/network IO. durability=No SQL owner; test store asserts no identity/history mutation on lookup or pack failure.
MAP-F4B8428675: effectBoundary=Use pure parser/translator tests plus a deterministic adapter evidence fixture; any dispatch/receipt ordering assertion uses a durable JournalWriter test-store, not an in-memory writer, and no real broker calls or SDK loading. durability=The durable test-store JournalWriter captures any identity/plan writes and verifies DispatchStarted is absent when config/probe fails; no generic engine config is treated as durable.
MAP-D3ABE635D3: effectBoundary=Translation remains pure. Evidence probes and capability policy are deterministic Effect fixtures; no native network calls. durability=Record only intent/evidence/decision metadata in fixture journal; native config objects are ephemeral adapter inputs.
MAP-2092F69746: effectBoundary=Hint conversion is pure; evidence policy uses deterministic fixtures. No endpoint is contacted in these unit-level cases. durability=Persisted policy decision/evidence generation is represented in fixture journal; a boolean is never the sole durable authorization field.

Redaction checks inspect emitted payload, not implementation calls. durability=Presentation output is rebuildable; fixture verifies no AccountId/journal/capability mutation and no SecretMaterial persistence.
MAP-F45EE8D4C7: effectBoundary=Legacy hash/canonicalization tests are pure. Identity allocation, alias/sealed-binding migration, and collision checks use an isolated durable account-store fixture. durability=The fixture must preserve old git/sealed IDs, owner binding, and all history/order references while recording migration; no secret values enter persisted payloads.

<a id="ltx-bridge"></a>

### LTX-BRIDGE：已认证的 Alice/AI bridge、生命周期命令与生成式 projection

**源码文件：** [src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts](../../src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts) · [src/webui/routes/trading-config.ts](../../src/webui/routes/trading-config.ts) · [src/tool/trading.ts](../../src/tool/trading.ts) · [src/services/connector-client/uta-review.ts](../../src/services/connector-client/uta-review.ts) · [src/services/connector-client/action-bridge.ts](../../src/services/connector-client/action-bridge.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- Alice loopback proxy 明确以 host trust 取代 Alice→UTA auth；trading-config 在 Alice 直接写 config、reconnect/remove，并可清除 ephemeral trading data；allowAiTrading=true 让 AI tool 直接 `uta.push`，connector review 以 pendingHash push/reject。Connector claim/ack/release 与 UTA review delivery 在 durable UTA transaction 外运行。CLI/HTTP 仍有手写 command map、stringly payload 和 generic JSON output。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Bridge 请求先由 UTA 验证 `Authorization: Bearer` 对应的 ServiceCredentialBinding、`X-Request-ID`、audience/body digest/expiry，再解析 authenticated principal、scope、capability binding 和当前 permission witness；TransportPrincipal 不能由 body 自填，service auth 也不等于 transaction authorizer。Alice 继续拥有 WorkspaceConversationControl、headless attribution、Issue/Inbox projections；UTA review outbox 只提供 stable ReviewRequest，ReviewCommand 必须是 Discard/KeepSuspended/Rearm/Revise/RequestSubmission 的 explicit schema。AI text/connector status 不能代替 approval。AI/CLI/help/HTTP 均从 discovered capability tree 投影，effect leaf 只返回 durable receipt/observation，data leaf 保持 pull/push contract。无回复、expiry、delivery unavailable 的 policy 在 registration 时冻结为 `SuspendControl|CloseWithoutDispatch|EscalateDecision` 之一；response 与 timeout 用同一 control CAS 竞争，不能自动执行兜底。 AccountLifecycle lifecycle command 验证 expectedConfigRevision，并将持久化 config/secret mutation 委托给既有 Alice owner；UTA 仅将已授权 revision 应用到 connections/readiness/recovery，不创建新的 config store。

**保留的可观察契约**

- allowAiTrading=false 仍产生 AwaitingApproval/manual UI path；true 只作为 persisted/configured policy input，仍走正常 prepare→approval→writer→DispatchStarted，不保留 raw push bypass。
- stable account id 在 credential rotation 后保持；duplicate broker identity 冲突；read-only/lite mode 与 hidden operation warnings 继续显式呈现。
- ReturnToAgent 消耗一次 activation 并创建一个 broker dispatch 为零的 ReviewRequest；KeepSuspended 返回可查询的 HeldIntentControl，后续命令使用当前 control CAS。
- Alice 的 exact/reconstructed/unavailable recipient 语义、Issue 的 pending/replied/failed 与 Inbox visibility 保持为 projection/delivery evidence，永不成为 UTA authority 或 receipt。

**具体替代与修正**

- 在 BFF/connector edge 建立 authenticated service binding，剥离不可信 principal headers，仅转发有界的 identity/correlation；UTA 在查找 receipt 前执行最终 auth、capability/scope/policy checks。
- trading-config 的 config/rotate/disable/retire lifecycle request 保留 Alice 对 persisted config/secrets 的写入所有权；typed lifecycle command 验证 authenticated principal、scope、expectedConfigRevision 与 control context 后，将 persisted mutation 委托给既有 Alice owner，UTA 只将已授权 revision 应用到 connections/readiness/recovery。connector/AI push/reject 迁移为 typed effect commands，携带 immutable intent revision、PlanDigest、actor、policy、expiry 与 expected control/review revision；实际 `ApprovalBinding(planDigest, actor, policy, expiry)` 使用独立 digest，不能把 binding digest 写入 PlanDigest。
- Review outbox admission 与 Alice task/Workspace spawn 分阶段持久化 `(reviewId, deliveryGeneration)`；response loss 查询原 admission，不能生成新 agent authority。
- 由 capability catalog 派生 HTTP/CLI/AI describe/help/invoke schemas；命令缺失是真结构缺失，schema 参数变体按 leaf 精确收窄。

**副作用与状态归属**

- UTA 持有 authenticated service authorization、transaction writer、review/control identity、effect receipt/recovery，以及将 Alice 已授权的 config revision 应用到 connections/readiness/recovery 的职责；Alice 保留 persisted config/secrets 写入、session provenance 和 exact responsible AI delivery。
- AI/CLI public handle 只能提交 intent、查询 receipt，不能获得 provider dispatch function 或 native credentials。
- AccountLifecycle 是带 expectedConfigRevision 的 typed command boundary；它将 persisted config/secret mutation 委托给既有 Alice owner。UTA 将已授权 revision 应用到 connections/readiness/recovery，不创建新的 config store；raw secret 不进入 plan、receipt、descriptor 或 projection。
- Issue/Inbox/connector store 是 delivery/projection resource；不会成为第二个 effect queue 或 transaction authority。

**失败与恢复**

- Unauthenticated/AuthorizationDenied/ApprovalBindingMismatch/IdempotencyConflict/RecipientUnavailable 都是显式 failure，且不泄露 receipt/resource existence。
- Alice admission/task/UTA response loss 使用同一 review identity + generation reconciliation；awaiting reconcile 不是 unsent 证明。旧 callback 不能让新 generation 回退。
- No reply、expiry 或 delivery unavailable 必须使用 registration 时冻结的 `SuspendControl|CloseWithoutDispatch|EscalateDecision` policy；timeout 与 response 在同一 current control revision 下 CAS 竞争，绝不 fallback 到 auto-execution。Credential rotation 或 account retirement 是 Alice-owned lifecycle write；UTA 应用已授权 revision，而 Unknown effect 会阻断新写入并保留 recovery credentials/ownership。
- RequestSubmission 只进行 eligibility work；source event、AI text 或 UI button 都不能授权 dispatch。

**原生证据边界**

- 当前源码证明 loopback trust、direct allowAiTrading push、pendingHash connector review 和 Alice delivery states；但不证明拟议的 authenticated bridge、review command endpoint、durable admission/reconciliation 或真实 Session delivery。
- Service credential provisioning/verifier、Session retirement/reconstruction、native credential scope 和 foreign bridge auth 仍需 runtime evidence；设计不宣称这些能力已实现。

**单一权威切换**

- 先离线为每个 existing route/tool/connector path 生成 typed capability projection 与 auth-context mapping，保留 read-only review；完成单一 writer boundary 后一次性切掉 direct broker mutation bypass，保留 Alice 对 persisted config/secrets 的写入所有权；lifecycle command 仅通过 validated revisioned delegation 接入，UTA 只应用 authorized config to connections/readiness/recovery。
- 迁移顺序为 authentication→command dedup→draft/review CAS→writer receipt→Alice config/delivery projection；配置 lifecycle 的 durable write 仍经 Alice owner 的 revisioned delegation，broker effects 不得旁路 UTA writer。
- 只有 descriptor-derived tree 覆盖等价命令后，才删除 static CLI_EXPORTS 的 authority；generated CLI 仍是 outer interpreter，不能发明缺失的 leaf。

<a id="lsurface-alice-transport"></a>

### LSURFACE-ALICE-TRANSPORT：Alice facade：构造绑定的能力传输边界

**源码文件：** [packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/client/UTAClient.ts) · [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts) · [src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts](../../src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts) · [src/webui/middleware/auth.ts](../../src/webui/middleware/auth.ts) · [src/services/auth/token-store.ts](../../src/services/auth/token-store.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- UTAClient 公开任意 HTTP verb/path、unknown body/query 与泛型 request&lt;T&gt;；非 2xx 被压成 UTAHttpError，JSON 解析失败仍返回原始文本，调用方的 AbortSignal 还会绕过内部 deadline 的组合。
- UTAAccountSDK 把 account、subaccount、position、order、quote、market-clock、contract、wallet、stage、commit、push、simulation 混在一个宽兼容对象中；UTAManagerSDK 再以摘要列表和 Guardian 全进程重启模拟 manager 生命周期。
- SDK 依赖和导出泄漏裸 string id、IBKR Contract/ContractDescription/ContractDetails、unknown callback 与空/乐观 health/capability 结果；缺失能力以 NotImplementedInSDK 或字符串 Error 表示。
- 当前 Alice web auth 由 alice_session cookie、admin token store 与 loopback/trusted-proxy 规则守护；trading-proxy v1 明确没有 Alice↔UTA service auth，PASSTHROUGH_HEADERS 只转发 x-request-id 等公共头而不转发 Authorization，UTAClient 也只发 content-type。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 能力定义采用构造时绑定的 schema-bound `Definition<Input, Success, LeafFailure, Requirements>`：固定 `input/success/failure/delivery` schema slots；受控效果另有 `prepared/ack/observation/recovery/compensation` slots。结构 schema algebra、语义 Constraint&lt;Value, Configuration, Failure&gt;、确定性 evaluator artifact 与 digest 在同一构造中生成，不能以任意 Zod callback 加手写 descriptor 拼接。
- 本地 TS 定义保留 schema 推导的 Input/Success/Failure 与 Effect service requirement `Requirements`；运行时 foreign 定义是带 opaque binding 的 `CertifiedDocument<ProviderInstance, CapabilityId, Revision, SemanticDigest, Slot>`，构造器针对同一 slot 解析，eliminator 再核对同一 binding/slot。`Requirements`（Effect 服务 R）与每次调用按 principal/capability/scope/policy 求出的 `PermissionWitness` 是两个独立通道。
- 能力调用为 `invoke(definition, input, context, signal) -> Promise<Result<Success, Cancelled | DeadlineExceeded | TransportUnavailable | ProtocolViolation | RemoteBoundaryFailure | RemoteDomainFailure<LeafFailure>>>`；Push 为 scoped `AsyncIterable<Start | Item | Correction | Retraction | Gap | ItemError | SnapshotEnd | Completed | Failed | Cancelled>`。公共入口不接受 raw action/path 加未绑定结果。
- catalog binding 的稳定键是 provider instance + capability identity + declaration revision + full semantic/schema digest；`CapabilityDescriptor` 同时承载 schema fingerprints、delivery/effect/resources/source/availability。当前可用性与授权是动态事实；历史 interpretation resolver 只为既有 attempt 找原 revision，不授予新调用 authority。
- Contract 与 command digest 使用 RFC 8785 JCS、UTF-8、SHA-256、完整且 versioned domain-separated digest；contract projection 覆盖 schema slots/semantic-constraint-unit/delivery/requirements/interpretation，command projection 覆盖 binding/scope/canonical input/identity/revision/policy。array order 与 Decimal string 按声明语义，duplicate keys、nonfinite number、invalid Unicode 在边界拒绝。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留可注入 fetch/base URL、调用 correlation、deadline/cancel、query/stream/controlled 三种使用形态及 provider 自有输入/输出/错误词汇；不再把这些保证伪装成所有 provider 的统一 IBroker 方法。
- 保留 Alice 需要 account identity、provider instance、sub-account、native identity 与错误阶段信息的可观测性；native SDK 对象只停留在 trusted UTA/provider interpreter 内。
- Descriptor 可以渲染给 AI/CLI，但动态 document 永远不能 cast 成未存在的静态 provider union。

**具体替代与修正**

- 先从声明树选择 leaf，再以 construction-bound codec 解码输入、编码结果和 expected leaf failure；缺少 evaluator、digest 或 slot certification 时 contract 为 unavailable，而不是 export 成功。
- 本 accommodation 的 transport profile 使用 `Authorization: Bearer <resolved credential>`，请求发出 `X-Request-ID` 且响应 echo；本地 opaque `CredentialRef` 由 UTA-owned `ServiceCredentialBinding` 解析并只注入认证 transport channel。secret 不进入 capability input、descriptor、log 或 AI payload；wire 上不出现 TransportPrincipal、actor claim 或 loopback assertion。
- 通过 versioned foreign handshake/discover/bind/invoke/subscribe/cancel/credit/terminal protocol 接入 Java/Python/native SDK/gateway/REST；credential-bearing adapter 留在受监督的 trusted UTA execution tree。
- schema/descriptor/executable binding 一起变更；revision/digest 不匹配拒绝新调用，旧 attempt 在 DispatchStarted/Unknown 后只走 exact historical interpretation 与 RecoveryRequired。
- 每个 provider 自己声明 exact schema/enum/extension；不得从 closed IBroker 或候选文档盲目继承 enum，也不得把历史 route 名称当作公共 vocabulary。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Alice：只负责 descriptor-bound transport、schema codec、correlation、AI/CLI projection 与消费结果；不拥有 provider credential、financial authorization 或 durable dispatch state。
- UTA：解析 ServiceCredentialBinding，签发/核对 PermissionWitness，持有能力 catalog、prepared plan、writer/outbox、attempt/recovery 与历史 interpretation。
- ProviderProcess：执行声明过的 native interpretation，返回 typed ack/observation/domain failure；不接受 Alice 直接传来的 authority。
- Bridge：只做版本化 handshake、边界 framing、size/resource/cancel/credit 与 transport failure 映射。

**失败与恢复**

- 本地边界错误穷举为 `Cancelled`、`DeadlineExceeded`、`TransportUnavailable`、`ProtocolViolation`；verified remote boundary 用 `RemoteBoundaryFailure(code)`，verified leaf failure 用 `RemoteDomainFailure<LeafFailure>`。
- Malformed output 不进入 domain value；diagnostic 仅保留 capability/schema identity、phase、HTTP status、content type、byte count 与最多 16 个 issue code/path（path ≤128，JSON ≤4096，带 truncation 标记），禁止 body/params/headers/native message/raw-body digest。
- Durable send boundary 是 `DispatchStarted`。边界之后的 cancellation、断线、进程崩溃返回 `OutcomeUnknown`/RecoveryRequired，不由 Promise wrapper 或 scheduler lease 触发盲重发；边界之前才可在新检查后 reclaim。
- Push 中 item-error、snapshot-end、gap 是非 terminal；Completed、Failed、Cancelled 是互斥 terminal，Failed 后不得补 Completed。崩溃/断管时不能承诺 final wire frame 已抵达。

**原生证据边界**

- 已观察到 UTAClient 的 arbitrary path/verb、unknown JSON、raw Error 和 timeout signal 覆盖；已观察到 SDK 的 native IBKR import、空 capability、fabricated healthy 与 no-op/stub lifecycle。
- 当前 source 只实现 Alice web session/admin-token 与 loopback trust，未实现 UTA↔Alice service credential issuer/verifier；本 accommodation 选定 Bearer/X-Request-ID、Promise&lt;Result&gt;/AbortSignal、AsyncIterable 与 bounded redaction，issuer/verifier、header echo、foreign framing 和 sink enforcement 仍是 runtime acceptance gate。
- 该边界不声称 foreign program 的 evaluator 等价性，也不把 native provider 未验证的 idempotency、replay、atomicity、stream finality 变成 host guarantee。
- RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization 与 full domain-separated digest 是 host target law；当前窄 specimen 未实现或证明该 canonicalizer，不能把现有 config fingerprint 当作目标 contract digest。

**单一权威切换**

- 新增 descriptor/codec/Constraint construction path，并让 Alice facade 只保存 `CapabilityHandle`/opaque runtime document；删除 public arbitrary request&lt;T&gt; 与 raw native Contract 参数面。
- 将每个旧 SDK method 映射为声明树的 query/stream/control leaf；没有可实现 interpretation 的旧 stub/no-op 改为结构上不存在或明确 unavailable descriptor。
- 把 client timeout 与 caller AbortSignal 合并为单一本地生命周期；将 HTTP/foreign errors 解码到固定 boundary ADT，保留 provider leaf error payload。
- 在旧 route 迁移完成后，CLI/AI/HTTP 从最终 catalog 生成 help/describe/invoke/subscribe；不得保留第二套手写 command map 或 raw dispatch escape hatch。

<a id="lsurface-alice-data"></a>

### LSURFACE-ALICE-DATA：Alice 数据 facade：账户、合约、行情与公共数据的显式 scope

**源码文件：** [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/bars/types.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/bars/types.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/bars/bar-service.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/bars/bar-service.ts) · [src/domain/news/types.ts](../../src/domain/news/types.ts) · [src/domain/news/collector/rss.ts](../../src/domain/news/collector/rss.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/reference/types.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/reference/types.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 账户 SDK 以 optional raw subAccountId、comma-delimited order ids、flat arrays 和 generic envelopes 查询；quote/historical/details 接受 full/partial native IBKR Contract 或 aliceId hint。
- manager 把 bar support 压成 source→quality map，unavailable 时返回空数组/空 map；search 丢失 assetClass/来源语义，contract details 为 stub；bar service 还会过滤 absent capability、聚合多源结果并保留延迟 warning。
- bars 目前由 pull-oriented UTA/vendor path 消费，provider richness（例如 IBKR WAP/barCount/update）被归一化或丢弃；News RSS 以 GUID/link/hash 去重并持久化，但单 feed 错误丢弃、没有 correction/retraction/coverage；reference board 是独立的低频事实投影。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `PullCapability<Query, Data, LeafFailure>` 返回 `Result<{items, coverage: Complete | Partial | Unavailable, source, scope, asOf, freshness, cursor?}, Failure>`；`PushCapability<Subscription, Frame, LeafFailure>` 返回同一 Unit schema 的 scoped stream，并显式声明 source identity/generation、ordering、buffer/backpressure、replay、finality、cancel 与 correction/retraction。
- `AccountScope` 只附着需要账户/子账户权限的事实与 capability；公共 `Instrument`、`Candle`、`News`、`NewsGroup` 使用 `Public` 或声明要求的 scope。account identity 不得替代 instrument identity，native Contract 仅是 provider interpretation 的私有输入。
- Unit schema 采用 exact base + provider extension namespace/sum：Candle 保留 interval/session/adjustment、Decimal OHLCV、provisional/closed/unknown finality、revision/correction；Instrument 分离 native identity、resolved facts、display name；News/NewsGroup 保留 source/published/observed/revision/coverage/membership。
- 数据组合使用 typed map/flatMap/combine；合并 finite pulls 保留每个 source 的 identity 与 coverage，stream combine 明确 ordering/buffer/cancel。数据查询永不获得 transaction recipe、account/order lock 或 dispatch authority。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 account、sub-account、position、open order、market clock、quote、historical、search、details、FX/equity 等旧查询的字段语义和 provider-specific extension，不把 `[]` 当作未知/不可用的成功。
- 保留 contract search 的 source/assetClass/selector、native IDs、bar interval/whatToShow 等输入约束；保留 quote unavailable、market-clock session 与历史数据非完整的真实可能性。
- 保留 RSS 的 GUID/link/hash 去重、feed identity 和 durable archive；NewsGroup 作为数据 selection/membership unit，不变成 command namespace 或 atomic transaction。
- 普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 直接读取；journal 只持久化 explicit capture、受控 effect evidence 与 deferred predicate checkpoint，不把全部行情 frame 写入 control WAL。

**具体替代与修正**

- 为每个 query/stream leaf 声明 scope、输入/输出/failure schema、coverage/finality/correction/replay；`Complete | Partial | Unavailable` 是唯一 coverage 变体；Unknown 作为 value/quality/reason payload，与合法空结果分开编码。
- Decimal quantities 走 validated strings；禁止 Number()、truthiness 或默认 currency/multiplier 证明数值存在。native WAP/barCount、sentinel、contract fields 通过 exact extension 或 Presence/Unknown evidence 保留。
- 将 current flat search、bar capability map、account-wide clock、RSS feed errors 改成 descriptor-bound public/account projections；查询失败以 typed failure 或 coverage 表示，不静默空降级。
- 对于公共数据、账户数据、reference board、News/NewsGroup，分别声明 source/asOf/entitlement；不因同一 Alice client 或同一 HTTP server 而共享 scope 或交易锁。
- Coverage 的全局变体严格只有 `Complete | Partial | Unavailable`；未知值/质量/单字段存在性是 payload/reason（例如 UnknownNativeSentinel 或 quality reason），不得增设新的 global coverage variant。
- 保留已验证的 same-currency FX `Identity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display value；只删除 unknown=1 fabrication，不把所有 1:1、默认值或合法零值一概删除。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Alice：只选择 query/stream leaf、提交 typed input、消费 coverage/finality/revision 与 provider extension。
- UTA：拥有 account/sub-account scope admission、credential access、账户查询连接 generation 与 durable controlled-effect state；不将普通数据 frame 写入 trading WAL。
- DataProvider：拥有历史/实时实现、native sentinel/profile、source identity、coverage/finality/replay 证据及其版本。
- NewsArchive/ReferenceStore：各自拥有 feed/archive 或 board projection；不能借 trading journal 宣称数据完整性或交易原子性。

**失败与恢复**

- Query 失败保留 `DataUnavailable`、`ScopeDenied`、`InvalidQuery`、`ProviderDomainFailure`、`TransportUnavailable` 与 `ProtocolViolation` 区分；多个 source 的 `allSettled` 结果逐源保留 failure/coverage。
- Push 的 `ItemError` 是可恢复 item-level frame；`Gap`、`Correction`、`Retraction`、`SnapshotEnd` 非 terminal；只有 `Completed | Failed | Cancelled` terminal，Failed 后不能 Completed。
- Stream cancel 只释放该 stream owner 的连接/credit/buffer；不会取消已经持久化的 order、deferred wait 或 unknown venue attempt。
- 缺 baseline、continuity 或 finality 证据时返回 Partial/Unavailable/Unknown；不得用空列表满足 FreshQuote、complete catalog 或 activation predicate。

**原生证据边界**

- 已观察 bars、instrument/reference、RSS/news 与 UTA routes 的实际消费路径；IBKR native historical decoder 有 WAP/barCount/update，但当前 UTA IbkrBroker 暴露 quote/clock 而没有 getHistorical leaf。
- Alpaca、CCXT、Mock 有历史路径；IBKR、Longbridge、LeverUp 在当前 UTA historical path 的支持缺口仍是 source fact。News native IBKR primitives 未被当前 RSS/archive consumer 使用。
- provider capability、pagination、replay/finality、correction/retraction 与 native sentinel completeness 均不能由字段或闭合 interface 推断；需 provider evidence。

**单一权威切换**

- 先建立 AccountScope/Public 与 source identity 的 schema slots，再迁移 account/contract/quote/clock/historical/search/details 旧方法；native Contract 适配留在 adapter。
- 把 bar service、reference service、RSS/archive/news route 接到 descriptor-bound data leaves；保留延迟 warning、partial source 与 feed failure，而非强行全局成功。
- 为 Push 增加生命周期/control frame、item-error、snapshot-end、gap/correction/retraction 与 terminal protocol；取消旧的 empty-array-as-unavailable fallback。
- 删除 manager 的 flat capability map、raw generic arrays 和 contract-detail stub；未声明 leaf 从 catalog 消失，历史 resolver 仅保留既有运行所需的 exact interpretation。

<a id="lsurface-alice-audit"></a>

### LSURFACE-ALICE-AUDIT：Alice 审计与 wallet projection：可读 evidence，不是第二 authority

**源码文件：** [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts) · [src/core/event-log.ts](../../src/core/event-log.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git-persistence.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/UnifiedTradingAccount.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- SDK 的 log/show/status/orderHistory/tradeHistory 直接投影 TradingGit；show 通过 Error.message substring 判断 not-found，trade/order history 没有稳定 scope/source provenance。
- getState/exportGitState/contractFromAliceId 等路径以 NotImplementedInSDK 失败，HTTP 又将 exported commits 压成 lifecycle-collapsed orders 或 fill-only trades；Git status 同时承担 staging/head/head hash 语义。
- event-log 是 append-only JSONL + process-local subscribe；它有 durable history 但没有 durable cursor/ack/lease/retry，不能当 task dispatcher 或 data-feed WAL。
- `sync` 接受可选 `delayMs`，读取 pending order ids/open-order listing，再以 `getOrder` 观察 status、filledQty、filledPrice；`UnifiedTradingAccount.sync` 把 selected observations 交给 `TradingGit.sync`，生成 hash/updatedCount/updates、commit 与 `onCommit`，而非发起新的 broker order。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `AuditProjection.read(request) -> Result<RedactedAuditView, AuditFailure>` 是 read-only capability，返回 commit/event identity、revision、phase、source/scope、selected execution evidence 与 projection provenance；不会提供 mutation recipe 或 writer authority。
- `JournalWriter` 的单 writer transaction 负责 progressive state、command identity dedup、expected version/CAS、events、decision projections、jobs/outboxes 与 receipt；普通 event-log/read feed 保持其独立的 append-only/history 语义。
- `PreparedPlan`/sealed execution representation 与 audit view 分离：前者保存 schema-encoded immutable payload、compiler/predicate versions、exact derived values、scope、policy、criterion、expiry/native lookup identity；后者严格 redacted，不能 replay。
- `SyncReconcile<AccountScope, { delayMs?: number }, SyncResult, SyncFailure>` 是 account-scoped observation/reconciliation capability：它把选定 order observations 通过 UTA single writer 导入 decision-bearing projection/journal，保留 hash/read-projection identity、updatedCount 与 update rows；可选异步实现必须带 job/generation。它不接受 mutation recipe、approval 或新 financial attempt。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 wallet log/show/status、order/trade history、commit hash/head/pending staging 与 Git chronology 的可读性；保留 commit/revision/native IDs 的追溯关系。
- 保留 event journal 为产品历史与审计来源，而不把旧 EventLog 的 process-local subscription 扩张成可靠 job queue；保留 snapshot/data archive 与 trading control journal 的分离。
- read-only review/preview 可观察 exact terms、predicate evidence、authorization state 与 validity，但无权改变 prepared plan 或提交 dispatch。
- 保留 `delayMs`、pending/open-order selection、status、filledQty、filledPrice、hash、updatedCount、updates 与 `onCommit`/read-projection identity；sync 可导入并持久化 selected observations，但不扩张为完整 market-feed WAL。

**具体替代与修正**

- 将 order/trade/history 变成 descriptor-bound read projections，字段带 source identity/scope/asOf/coverage；拒绝 Error.message substring 与隐式 empty-success。
- 把 Git pending hash 迁移为 writer-issued plan/revision digest/CAS；`push` 的 response receipt、DispatchStarted、ack/observation/recovery evidence 进入受控 journal，不将每个行情 frame 写入其中。
- 按权限输出 bounded redacted evidence；native request replay 使用 sealed/reconstructable exact representation 与 installed compiler/version，绝不使用 audit redaction 作为 replay bytes。
- 删除 getState/exportGitState 等不可实现兼容 stub；若旧 UI 仍需查看状态，生成 read-only projection，不恢复 wallet/object 穿透。
- 将 `/sync` 明确成 `SyncReconcile` data/resource operation：它使用 account scope/permission，写入 selected observation/projection 的 single-writer path，并可帮助 resolve 已存在的 Unknown；它不创建自己的 DispatchStarted、Unknown send、broker dispatch 或 trading approval。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Alice：消费并展示审计 projection、history、receipt 与 review evidence；不能根据 projection 直接 dispatch。
- UTAWriter：唯一更新 control state、prepared revision、CAS/version、outbox、receipt、selected execution evidence 的 owner。
- TradingJournal：保存受控 effect 与最小 predicate checkpoint；不承担完整 market-feed WAL。
- EventLog：保存产品事件历史并提供进程内通知；不负责 durable task acknowledgment/retry。
- SyncReconcile：UTA 负责 account-scoped observation、single-writer import、selected projection/commit 与 hash receipt；它不拥有新的 broker dispatch recipe。

**失败与恢复**

- Audit read 区分 `NotFound`、`Redacted`、`ProjectionUnavailable`、`CorruptRecord`、`ScopeDenied` 与 transport failure；禁止从 message substring 猜测类型。
- writer storage failure 不得变成成功 admission；重复 command + 相同 encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，identity 相同但 input 不同返回 conflict。
- snapshot/export 在 dispatch 之后失败不撤销 venue reality；出现 sent/unknown evidence 时保持 ownership 与 recovery，不依赖重新生成 request id/salt/nonce。
- open-order listing/getOrder timeout、缺 observation、sync commit/onCommit failure 与 stale generation 保留 typed reconciliation failure；恢复重查既有 order observation，不重发旧 order，也不把 sync 变成新的 financial attempt。

**原生证据边界**

- 源码已显示 JSONL event history、TradingGit projection、pending hash/CAS 与 SDK stub；source 不能证明 concurrent append ordering、durable cursor 或 provider idempotency。
- E01 明确观察到 dispatch 后 snapshot/onCommit 失败，重试 pending hash 会重复 dispatch；该结果只支持 durable send/receipt/recovery 设计，不构成 venue idempotency guarantee。
- 审计 redaction byte limits、concurrent sink sequencing 与 sealed execution storage 仍需 implementation acceptance。

**单一权威切换**

- 把现有 wallet read route 逐项映射为 read-only descriptor leaves，保留历史字段但附加 scope/source/asOf/provenance；将 mutation route 移到 LSURFACE-ALICE-CONTROL。
- 引入 single-writer journal transaction 与 durable receipt/outbox；在 cutover 前离线导入 pending-hash 状态为 plan revision/digest，cutover 后只有 plan revision/digest 一个 authority，不做 dual-read、shim 或 speculative compatibility path。
- 实现 redacted audit view 与 sealed execution payload 两个不可互换 schema；删除 raw export/state fallback 和 substring error classifiers。
- 将 SDK `/sync`、HTTP `/uta/:id/sync` 与 UTA/TradingGit observation import 离线 parity/import 为 `SyncReconcile` leaf，再 single-authority cutover；保留 selected journal/projection persistence，明确不写 full market-feed WAL。

<a id="lsurface-alice-control"></a>

### LSURFACE-ALICE-CONTROL：Alice controlled effect：draft、审批、CAS 与 durable dispatch

**源码文件：** [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/order-entry.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/order-entry.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 旧 SDK 将 stagePlace/Modify/Close/Cancel 接成 wallet mutation，把 commit(message) 与 push(expectedPendingHash) 当作主要边界；reject/push 有 pending hash，但 stage 输入是 raw compatibility bag，部分方法没有本地 read-only guard。
- HTTP 以 local Zod 校验 legacy place/close/cancel，one-shot 直接 stage→commit→push；错误被映射成 phase 字符串和 HTTP status。simulatePriceChange 只经 local callback 就可触发生产 proxy 的 simulation path。
- 源实验显示 dispatch 后持久化失败可在重试时重复发送；Guard cooldown 会先改变状态再在后续 guard reject，说明 expected rejection 必须不变更早期 guard state。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>` 同时保留 recipe→prepared→dispatch→ack/observation→receipt/control-result/stage-error association；Admission `R/P`（Effect service requirements 与 runtime policy 产生的 `PermissionWitness`）和 execution `R/P` 分开求解；`PermissionWitness` 不是 process-bound `DispatchGrant`，persisted authorization evidence 也不能重放 grant。
- `withTransaction<PrivateRecipe, TransactionPolicy, AdmissionContract>(prepare: PrepareAssociation<ReadonlyFacts, PrivateRecipe>, policy: TransactionPolicy, admission: AdmissionContract) -> Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`；recipe 不进入 public input，也不能由 query/stream invoker 接受，readonly facts 属于 typed prepare association。
- `Prepare` 是 pure compiler：读取构造 facts，生成 immutable encoded `PreparedPlan`（intent/input/derived/selected evidence/scope/revision/policy/criterion/expiry/native lookup/implementation versions），不发请求；Admission/approval 将 exact plan digest、authorizer/policy revision、expiry、scope 与 actor 绑定。
- 受控状态是 `NotStarted -> DispatchStarted -> Ack|OutcomeUnknown -> Observation -> Criterion|RecoveryRequired` 等显式事件；`Ack`、working、fill、cancel、replacement、exposure criterion 不互相替代。
- 只有 fresh successful `Start` transition 产生 process-bound、one-use `DispatchGrant`，private dispatch consume 一次；duplicate/query Start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，永不返回 replayable grant。
- Draft/PreparedPlan 可以持久化并返回 draft receipt；Prepare 的 non-mutating 约束只禁止 native/financial side effect，不禁止 durable planning、review evidence 或 stage-error 记录。Admission `P` 是运行时 policy 产生的 PermissionWitness，和 fresh Start 才产生的 transient DispatchGrant 不同。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 stage/commit/reject/push 的用户意图、human message/reason、pending hash/CAS、partial/full close、cancel、attached protection、wallet/Git chronology 与 provider-native order fields。
- 保留 read-only/product mode 可构造 preview/draft，保留 explicit writer approval 与 direct provider distinctions；read-only 不得被空实现伪装成 writable。
- 保留 IndependentBatch、AllOrCompensate(allowed grades)、VenueNativeAtomic 作为受控效果政策；普通查询组合不是金融原子性。

**具体替代与修正**
