- 将 stage-only 显式改为 non-executable `Draft`/`PreparedPlan` capability：它可以读、编译、展示 terms/evidence，但不能创建 job、锁、approval 或 dispatch。`allowAiTrading` 只是 policy input，不是 permission witness。
- single writer 在一个事务中 deduplicate command identity、检查 expected version/authorization/reservation、append events、创建 outbox/job 并持久化 receipt；success 只在 commit 后返回。
- DispatchStarted 固定 immutable attempt identity 与 writer-issued permission；lease 过期不能重发可能已发送的 request。边界前可 reclaim，边界后/unknown 只能 observation/recovery；历史 interpretation 缺失时禁止 reprepare 或用 current code。
- 将 ReturnToAgent review、RequestSubmission、KeepSuspended、Discard、Rearm、Revise 建模为 deferred disposition，不从文本或 HTTP body 解析 authority；control journal 只保存 selected execution evidence 与最小 predicate checkpoint。
- 将 contract/command canonical digest 固定为 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256、full domain-separated/versioned digest，并把 exact digest 绑定 schema slots、recipe/plan、scope、revision、policy；这不是窄 specimen 已实现的承诺。
- 将 no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 的 frozen policy 设为显式 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision`（含 retention/recipient）；timeout 与 response 在同一 control revision/CAS 下竞争，timeout 永不 auto-exec fallback。
- Draft/PreparedPlan 的保存与 native mutation 分离：writer 可以持久化 draft、receipt、stage-error 与 review evidence；只有 Admission/Start/Dispatch 产生受控外部 effect，不能把“未发请求”误写成“不可持久化”。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Alice：创建/呈现 typed draft、提交已授权的 structured review command，维护 Workspace/Session 投递；不持有 writer lock、native credential 或可直接执行 recipe。
- UTAWriter：拥有 approval/CAS/plan revision、outbox、DispatchStarted、receipt、reservation、recovery owner 与 durable deferred state。
- ProviderInterpreter：将 exact sealed plan 编译成 native request，返回 ack/observation/expected failure；不可绕过 UTA writer。
- ReviewChannel：只传 exact ReviewRequest/allowed command schema；Keep 是 suspended handle，Revise 是新 revision，Discard 只允许未发送的本地退休。

**失败与恢复**

- 输入/schema/permission/policy/expiry/CAS 失败在 DispatchStarted 前拒绝且不改变 earlier guard state；同 command identity 同 encoded semantics 返回原 receipt，语义不同 conflict。
- `DispatchStarted` 后 response lost、process crash、lease expiry、provider timeout 产生 `OutcomeUnknown`/`RecoveryRequired`；不得转换为普通 HTTP rejection 后盲 retry。
- Ack 不是 Fill；cancel/replacement/exposure 用独立 observation；terminal 只在无 unresolved exposure 或 durable recovery owner 接管后释放 reservation。
- E02 的 cooldown 先改 state 再 reject 被改成 pure `Decision`/`Evolution`：guard 评估只输出 accepted events/effect descriptions，拒绝不污染此前 checkpoint。
- Start 仅在 fresh control transition 后生成 one-use DispatchGrant；duplicate/query Start 只返回 AlreadyStarted evidence。grant 丢失/response 丢失进入 observation，而 persisted authorization 不能重放 grant。

**原生证据边界**

- 已观察 stage→commit→push、pending hash conflict、one-shot phase failures、Mock TPSL/partial close 与 Git history；这些是要保留的行为，不证明真实 venue 的 atomicity/idempotency。
- E01/E02 是 source experiment，确认 durable send boundary 与纯 guard transition 的必要性；不能替代 provider ack/fill/replay evidence。
- native protection parent-link、trigger identity、venue cancellation/finality、compensation grade 仍按 provider/account acceptance 观察。

**单一权威切换**

- 将旧 stage/commit/reject/push 的请求离线导入 typed Draft/Prepare/Approve/Dispatch/Observe leaves，核对 parity 后 single-authority cutover 到 plan digest/revision；不保留 pending-hash dual-read、shim 或 speculative compatibility path。
- 拆除 account proxy 内的 direct raw mutation callback；所有 writer command 经 UTA-owned permission、single writer 与 durable outbox。
- one-shot route 只成为生成的 composition（prepare+admit+dispatch+observe），不能再独立维护第二种 command/error map；unsupported protection/order alternative 从树中缺席。
- 为每个旧 provider-native field 建立 exact extension/presence schema；未判定 sentinel 或缺 native observation 时保持 Unknown，不发送未经证明的 payload。

<a id="lsurface-alice-lifecycle"></a>

### LSURFACE-ALICE-LIFECYCLE：Alice manager 与连接生命周期：catalog、readiness、Guardian 边界

**源码文件：** [src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAManagerSDK.ts) · [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/preset-catalog.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/brokers/preset-catalog.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- UTAManagerSDK 的 setup hooks、initUTA、add/remove/closeAll、refreshCatalog、nudgeRecovery、setCurrentRound 多为空操作或 NotImplemented；list/resolve/resolveOne/get/has 以 summaries、source prefix、tier filter 和 generic Errors 兼容。
- reconnectUTA/removeUTA 忽略目标 id，调用 Guardian 全 UTA restart 或 best-effort external file deletion；health/waitForConnect 与 account availability 可能被硬编码为空/healthy。
- 当前 broker registry/factory 在同进程动态加载模块，校验 apiVersion/engine/configSchema/createBroker 并返回闭合 IBroker；preset catalog 使用 engine union 与 config fingerprint，不是 capability digest。

**选定的抽象表达**

- `discover(principal, requestedScope) -> Result<CatalogSnapshot, DiscoveryFailure>` 返回经过 principal filtering 的 `CapabilityDescriptor` 树；`AdmissionCatalogBinding` 固定 provider instance/capability/revision/full digest，availability/authorization 独立。
- `resolveHistorical(attemptIdentity) -> Result<InstalledInterpretation, RecoveryRequired>` 是 exact historical resolver，与 live admission catalog 分离；旧 revision/leaf 可继续 observer/recovery，但不得重新授予新-call authority。
- Lifecycle 作为有限 ADT：`Loaded | Connecting | Ready(epoch) | Degraded | Disconnected | Retiring | Closed`；reconnect/remove 必须带 account/provider identity 与 scoped outcome，Guardian 仅是受控 supervisor effect，不是 Alice manager 的隐式全局副作用。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 provider/account/source prefix resolution、tier/data/trading presentation filter、availability reason、capability presence、connection generation、Guardian restart/reconnect 与 external config ownership 的可观测差异。
- 保留 keyless/read-only/data source 与交易账户在 catalog 中的不同 scope；保留无法初始化时的 typed unavailable，而不把所有失败变成空列表。
- 保留 current same-process factory 作为实现选项，同时允许 foreign process boundary；native provider vocabulary 不被 manager 统一成四方法或 global map。

**具体替代与修正**

- 把 resolve/resolveOne/get/has 从 summary convenience 改为 descriptor-bound catalog query，并返回 `NoCapability`、`AmbiguousIdentity`、`Unavailable`、`ScopeDenied` 等精确失败；不以 id prefix 猜 provider identity。
- 将 live admission catalog 与 historical resolver 明确分离：revision/digest 变化会 invalidate stale new-call binding，但已 DispatchStarted/Unknown 的 attempt 只能 exact resolve 或 RecoveryRequired，绝不 reprepare。
- 将 setup/no-op lifecycle methods 删除或生成明确 unavailable leaf；reconnect/remove 只操作选定 account/provider instance 的 owner，Guardian restart 通过监督控制 capability 返回 job/epoch/evidence。
- catalog descriptor 由 construction-bound declarations 生成 schema/fingerprint/delivery/effect/resources/source/availability；加载但 disconnected 的 capability 可以 describable，未加载/unsupported leaf 不出现。

**副作用与状态归属**

- AliceManager：消费 catalog、presentation filters、descriptor metadata 与 lifecycle receipts；不管理 in-process brokers 或配置文件写入。
- UTA/Guardian：拥有 credentials、broker process supervision、connection generation、ready/recovery/retire state 与 config ownership。
- AdmissionCatalog：记录当前结构支持、availability、authorization；不代替 historical resolver。
- HistoricalResolver：按 attempt 保存的 revision/compiler/observer identity 恢复；不能制造新的 admission permission。

**失败与恢复**

- catalog discovery 区分 unavailable/disconnected、unauthorized filtering、invalid declaration/schema digest、provider load failure、ambiguous resolution；不静默 `[]`。
- restart 把未开始计划按 policy 退休并要求新 revision/approval；任何 attempt started/unknown 且 interpretation 缺失时返回 RecoveryRequired，保留原 bytes/identity/ownership。
- Guardian failure 只产生 lifecycle/recovery evidence；不会自动重复 native request 或把 stop/close 当作 unknown venue cancellation。

**原生证据边界**

- 已观察 same-process registry/factory 的 apiVersion/config/createBroker checks、closed IBroker、preset config fingerprint 与 manager whole-process Guardian behavior；均不证明 foreign handshake、capability fingerprint 或 native guarantees。
- source 只证明空/healthy compatibility values 和 ignored IDs 的当前实现；新 catalog availability、policy entitlement、historical resolver 需要 runtime gate。

**单一权威切换**

- 先生成 descriptor catalog 与 typed lifecycle/readiness ADT，再迁移 summary-based SDK methods；保留 source/tier filters 为 projection 而非 authority。
- 按 provider instance identity 拆分 reconnect/remove/close owner，Guardian 只通过 explicit supervisor effect 触发；删除 manager 内的全局 restart、无 id 忽略与 silent no-op。
- 保留 historical interpretation registry 的 versioned observer/recovery entry，切断其对新 catalog invoke 的反向注册。

<a id="lsurface-http-data"></a>

### LSURFACE-HTTP-DATA：HTTP data projection：descriptor-bound query/stream 与 scope-aware response

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts) · [services/uta/src/__tests__/trading-tools.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/__tests__/trading-tools.spec.ts) · [src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts](../../src/webui/routes/trading-proxy.ts) · [src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts](../../src/services/uta-client/UTAAccountSDK.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- routes-trading 直接 import UnifiedTradingAccount/BrokerError/TradingGit，并在 `/uta`, `/equity`, `/contracts/search`, `/fx-rates`, `/subaccounts`, `/account`, `/positions`, `/orders`, `/clock`, `/quote`, `/expand`, `/historical`, `/details` 中返回 raw manager/account/provider JSON。
- queryAccount 对 offline/error 做 nudge+503 或 raw 500；snapshots/equity curve 把 file-backed reads 缺失转成空数组并用 Number() 聚合；test-connection 动态创建 config/broker 后 best-effort close。
- HTTP route 与 tests 可见 direct casts、Object.assign native IBKR Contract、raw subAccountId/order ids、optional delays 和 local Zod，web proxy v1 仍 loopback-trusted 且转发 headers/body。
- `/uta/:id/simulate-price` 是账户级 hypothetical read path：UTAAccountSDK 发送 `PriceChangeInput[]`，TradingGit 读取 GitState positions，解析 `@absolute` 与 `+/-relative`；`symbol=all` 按每个 position 自有 mark（含 derivatives）重标，symbol-specific underlying change 明确排除 derivatives 并写出说明；结果保留 Decimal string 的 currentState/simulatedState/summary，并按 side/multiplier 计算。route/source 说明它不是 Mock-only order write。

**选定的抽象表达**

- HTTP 是外层 interpreter：`describe/catalog/principal -> generated RouteTree`，每个 leaf 从最终 definition 派生 path/query/body schema、scope、delivery/effect、errors 与 help；它不能直接执行 opaque recipe 或 invent absent verbs。
- Pull response 为 `Result<DataEnvelope, BoundaryFailure>`，envelope 带 capability/provider/schema digest、scope、source、asOf/freshness、coverage 与 continuation；Push response 是 correlation-bound `AsyncIterable<Frame>`，control/terminal ADT 与 LSURFACE-ALICE-DATA 相同。
- 账户 routes 明确 `AccountScope{providerInstance,accountId,subAccountId?}`；公共 search/market/candle/news 使用 `Public` 或 declaration-specific scope；不从 path id、body actor、loopback 自动获得 permission witness。
- HTTP client 使用 `Promise<Result<...>> + AbortSignal`，内部可由 Effect 解释；响应先过同一 construction-bound schema slot，再进入 application/domain。
- `PricePreviewPull<AccountScope, PriceChangeInput[], PricePreviewResult, PricePreviewFailure>` 是 account-scoped Pull/data capability：输入保留 absolute/relative syntax 与 symbol selector，结果保留 Decimal current/simulated/summary、side、multiplier、quality/diagnostic note；它不接受 order recipe、approval、DispatchGrant，也不宣称新的 pricing model。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留账户列表、equity、FX、subaccounts、account、positions、orders、clock、quote、expand、historical、details、snapshot 与 curve 的业务字段/分页/legacy selectors，并保留 provider-specific richness。
- 保留 offline、partial source、market data unavailable、sentinel/unknown 与 snapshot absence 的可观察分支；不把空数组误认 complete。
- 保留 test-connection 与 simulator 管理用途，但让动态 provider config、credentials、native object 仅在 trusted UTA execution tree 内解析。
- 普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 直接读取；journal 只持久化 explicit capture、受控 effect evidence 与 deferred predicate checkpoint，不把全部行情 frame 写入 control WAL。
- 保留 `PriceChangeInput[]`、`@absolute`/relative change、`symbol=all` 的逐仓自有 mark（包括 derivatives）、symbol-specific underlying change 对 derivatives 的 loud exclusion、Decimal state/summary、side/multiplier 与质量/诊断说明。

**具体替代与修正**

- 从 descriptor tree 生成 route tree 与 codecs；删除固定十条 route 假设、raw generic query、Object.assign Contract 与 route-local DTO duplication。
- 将 `/uta` 等 summary 变成 catalog/discovery；query leaf 明确 public/account scope、source identity、coverage/finality、pagination/cursor 和 freshness。
- 错误 envelope 只在边界映射 typed local/remote/leaf failure；401 UnauthenticatedTransport、verifier unavailable、403 scope/policy、409 identity/CAS conflict、503 typed unavailable 不由 raw message 猜。
- snapshots/equity/FX 聚合仅组合 typed reads，保留 per-source coverage/Decimal/FX provenance；不获得 transaction approval 或 control journal lock。
- Coverage 的全局变体严格只有 `Complete | Partial | Unavailable`；未知值/质量/单字段存在性是 payload/reason（例如 UnknownNativeSentinel 或 quality reason），不得增设新的 global coverage variant。
- 保留已验证的 same-currency FX `Identity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display value；只删除 unknown=1 fabrication，不把所有 1:1、默认值或合法零值一概删除。
- 将 simulate-price 投影为 explicit AccountScope `PricePreview` Pull leaf，而非 HTTP-SIMULATOR 或 controlled order leaf；保留现有假设价格计算和错误/质量说明，不把 preview 变成 approval、order write 或 Mock 专属能力。

**副作用与状态归属**

- HTTP：解析 wire envelope、验证 schema/correlation、投影 help/invoke/subscribe；不保存 secrets/recipes，不授予 actor authority。
- UTA：验证 service credential、principal/scope/capability/revision/policy，调用 account/provider and writer ports。
- Snapshot/Equity services：拥有各自 file-backed/read projection 与 freshness；不承担 order dispatch。

**失败与恢复**

- 调用者 AbortSignal 与 deadline 合并；transport cancellation/deadline 在 DispatchStarted 之前可返回本地 failure，受控 effect 之后保持 Unknown/recovery。
- stream 启动/updates/item-error/gap/snapshot-end 与 terminal 分开；route disconnect 不伪造 Completed，不取消 UTA-owned wait/order。
- 动态 request body 未过 resolved schema slot 或 digest/provider binding 不匹配时 ProtocolViolation/SchemaMismatch；禁止回退 raw JSON。
- 输入格式错误、非 Mock/当前 broker 不可提供 preview、缺 position/mark 或 derivative exclusion 都是 typed preview failure/quality reason；preview 不产生 financial attempt、send、reservation 或 Unknown send。

**原生证据边界**

- 当前 route 与 trading-tools tests 证明 direct account/provider coupling、raw responses、legacy status mappings、empty fallback、native Contract construction；不证明目标 route tree 或 auth verifier 已存在。
- HTTP 本 accommodation naming and module shape 已由 host contract 决定；UTA↔Alice credential issuer/verifier、header echo、foreign transport and live response decoding 仍需 runtime acceptance。

**单一权威切换**

- 先把各 route 的 input/output/error 定义迁入 descriptor leaves，生成 HTTP schemas/routes；先离线做旧 payload 到同一 declaration 的 parity/import，再 single-authority cutover；不添加 dual-read、shim 或 speculative compatibility route，也不保留 raw dispatch。
- 将 queryAccount、summary/equity/FX/snapshot fallback 改为 typed scope/coverage/error projection；将 test-connection 放入显式 discovery/admin scope。
- 为 HTTP/foreign streams 接入 correlation、credit/cancel、item-error/terminal protocol，并删除 route-local direct casts 与 unknown body forwarding。
- 将 `/uta/:id/simulate-price` 离线 parity/import 到 AccountScope PricePreview Pull declaration，再 single-authority cutover；保留输入/输出 Decimal 字段和 derivative diagnostic，不建立第二套 simulation command map。

<a id="lsurface-http-control"></a>

### LSURFACE-HTTP-CONTROL：HTTP controlled projection：认证、read-only review 与 one-shot composition

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-trading.ts) · [services/uta/src/http/routes-trading-wallet.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-trading-wallet.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/http/trading-order-entry.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/trading-order-entry.spec.ts) · [src/server/cli.ts](../../src/server/cli.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- wallet routes 直接读取 TradingGit；commit/reject/push 使用 message/reason/expectedPendingHash，stage routes 接受 arbitrary JSON；one-shot handlers 把 stage/commit/push 的 string phase union 映射 HTTP 400/500。
- UTA `/uta` route 当前没有 UTA↔Alice service credential verifier；web proxy 依赖 loopback trust 并只转发白名单 headers/body，局部 Zod 只验证输入，不产生 output/error/effect metadata。
- wallet tests 已验证 pending-hash-required/conflict，order-entry tests 已验证 stage/commit/push phases、precision forwarding、close-all/cancel 与 unknown account 的状态码；这些是 acceptance obligations，不是现有统一 contract。

**选定的抽象表达**

- HTTP controlled leaf 投影 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract>`，保留每个 stage-error、receipt、control-result 与 prepared/native evidence 的关联；admission 与 execution 的 Effect service R 和 permission P 分开，持久化 authorization 不是 private one-use DispatchGrant。
- 控制 HTTP leaf 必须由 controlled `Definition` 生成：`prepare`/`review`/`approve`/`dispatch`/`observe` 的 schemas、policy、scope、effect metadata 与 errors 一起认证；`Draft`/read-only leaf 不得收到 recipe 或启动 job。
- 固定 auth envelope：`Authorization: Bearer <resolved credential>`、`X-Request-ID` request/response echo；verifier 从 UTA-owned ServiceCredentialBinding 构造 Principal，body actor、TransportPrincipal、loopback 不得充当 authority。
- HTTP one-shot 只是声明树组合，不是第二 command map：成功返回 committed receipt/handle；DispatchStarted 后 response loss 映射 OutcomeUnknown/recovery。
- ReviewRequest 是 typed exact terms/evidence/predicate/validity/recipient/allowed commands；`RequestSubmission` 仍走普通 permission/policy/CAS，文本不具授权力。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 pending hash conflict 409、missing message/quantity 400、unknown account 404、phase-specific failures、precision Decimal text、partial/full close、cancel 与 TPSL fields。
- 保留 commit/reject/push read-only review distinction；readOnly 可生成 preview/draft，但不能产生 approval/dispatch/lock/outbox。
- 保留 response correlation、idempotent command identity、provider-specific leaf errors 与 explicit Unknown after possible send。

**具体替代与修正**

- 所有 HTTP control routes 先验证 service credential/principal/scope/current policy/capability revision/digest/expiry，再调用 UTA writer；没有 auth verifier 时返回 `UnauthenticatedTransport`(401) 或 `TransportVerifierUnavailable`，不得 loopback fallback。
- 将 expectedPendingHash 迁移为 plan revision/digest + writer CAS，保留 409 semantics；same command/same encoded semantics 返回 prior receipt，different semantics conflict。
- 禁止 route 直接使用 TradingGit mutation、raw JSON、legacy phase string map 或 body actor；generated interpreter 只能调用 installed controlled leaf。
- 通过 `ReviewRequest`/Alice bridge 将 ReturnToAgent、Keep、Discard、Rearm、Revise、RequestSubmission 编码为 allowed command ADT；未发送 Discard 可退休本地计划，sent/unknown 只能 recovery。
- HTTP start/dispatch 只接受 fresh control CAS 后签发 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`；duplicate/query start 返回 `AlreadyStarted` evidence，禁止从 persisted approval 复用 grant。
- 为 no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 固定 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision` policy；timeout 与 AI response 以同一 control revision/CAS 竞争，禁止 timeout 后 auto-exec。

**副作用与状态归属**

- HTTP：仅 transport/interpreter；保存 request correlation 和 redacted diagnostics。
- AliceBridge：认证后 durable-admit stable ReviewRequest key，再向 WorkspaceConversationControl 投递；不代替 UTA writer。
- UTAWriter：拥有 control identity/revision/CAS/approval/outbox/receipt/dispatch/recovery。
- TradingGit：迁移期可作为现有 persistence implementation；长期不直接暴露为 HTTP authority。

**失败与恢复**

- 401 未认证、verifier unavailable、403 scope/policy denied、409 revision/command conflict、422 schema/domain rejection、503 unavailable、504 deadline/unknown 的分类必须由 typed ADT 驱动。
- commit/push storage failure 不返回 200；DispatchStarted 后 HTTP disconnect/timeout 不能自动重发；需要 observation/recovery route。
- read-only review 中 Keep 生成 durable suspended control handle；Discard 只退休未发计划；Rearm/Revise 生成新 epoch/revision 并重新检查。
- Stage errors、admission failures、dispatch receipts/control results 分别解码但保持同一 Controlled association；lost grant/response 走 observation/recovery，不把 durable authorization 当作 replay token。

**原生证据边界**

- HTTP wallet/order tests 已实测 status/body/phase/precision/pending hash obligations；不证明 auth, generated projection, CAS persistence or foreign protocol implementation。
- 当前 source 未提供 UTA↔Alice service credential issuer/verifier；该缺口只能作为 deployment/runtime gate，不把 route-local crypto 或 body identity写进设计。

**单一权威切换**

- 把 wallet/stage/one-shot route 输入提升为 construction-bound controlled schemas，先实现 Draft/Prepare/Review，再连接 writer Dispatch/Observe。
- 引入 auth middleware 与 correlation/error codec；将 status mappings 从字符串 substring 改为 typed envelope，保留原有 externally observed HTTP statuses。
- 最后删除 direct TradingGit mutation、legacy raw handlers 与独立 one-shot map；由 final descriptor tree 生成 help/route/invoke。

<a id="lsurface-http-simulator"></a>

### LSURFACE-HTTP-SIMULATOR：HTTP simulator/admin tree：隔离的 MockBroker 控制能力

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/http/routes-simulator.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/routes-simulator.ts) · [services/uta/src/http/simulator.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/http/simulator.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/uta-lifecycle.e2e.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/uta-lifecycle.e2e.spec.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- routes-simulator 通过 instanceof MockBroker 解析 `/utas` 与 `/uta/:id/state`，直接调用 setMarkPrice/tickPrice/fillOrder/cancelPendingOrder/externalDeposit/externalWithdraw/externalTrade；price/fill body schema 接受 simulator wire `{price?, qty?}`，Zod 的 numericString 接受 string/number 并统一转为 String，随后将 fill body 传给 fillOrder。
- simulator tests 验证 real MockBroker 与非 Mock object 的筛选、mark/tick/fill/cancel、wallet deposit/withdraw/trade、partial/full fills 与 exact average-cost/cash changes；route 本身没有独立 auth/admin scope。
- UTA lifecycle Mock E2E 覆盖 immediate/deferred、pending external fill、partial/full close、cancel、history、TPSL 与 Decimal precision。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 模拟控制是独立的 `Admin/Simulator` capability tree，前提为 authenticated simulator principal + explicit mock provider instance + AccountScope + simulator policy；它不是生产 provider catalog 的隐式 universal leaf。
- 控制输入采用 exact ADT：`SetMarkPrice{nativeKey, price}`、`TickPrice{nativeKey, deltaPercent}`、`Fill{orderId, price?: Decimal, qty?: Quantity}`、`CancelPending{orderId}`、`ExternalDeposit`、`ExternalWithdraw`、`ExternalTrade`；simulator published wire schema 保留 `qty` 这一字段名，省略 `qty` 表示填充剩余 totalQuantity。若 host canonical record 使用 `quantity`，只在 schema-bound boundary 做 pure `qty→quantity` parse，再在旧 native boundary re-encode `{qty}`；不得把 `quantity` 误传给只读取 `opts.qty` 的旧方法。输出带 generation/sequence/state projection/receipt。
- Mock immediate/deferred execution 仍使用受控 effect protocol：DispatchStarted/ack/observation 与 unknown recovery 不因内存实现而消失；external stimulus 单独标记 actor/provenance，不是 UTA dispatch。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 MockBroker 的 matching threshold、mark/tick price、manual `fillOrder`/cancel、wallet-source cash/position、external trade、partial fill、average cost、history；fill simulator wire 保留 `{price?, qty?}`，省略 `qty` 仍按 pending order 的剩余 totalQuantity 全量填充，提供的 qty 必须为正且不超过 totalQuantity，price/qty 保留 Decimal 转换与默认价格语义。HTTP simulator 没有 TPSL command，Mock `placeOrder` 的 optional tpsl 仅按 provider implementation 记录/忽略。
- 保留 immediate 与 deferred mode 的不同观察时序、pending order 与 sync/reconcile；保留 Decimal exactness 与 full close 恢复 cash 的可观察结果。
- 模拟 controls 只在明确 mock/admin scope 下可用，不让其成为 live effect 或 HTTP general route。

**具体替代与修正**

- 将 `/simulator` endpoints 从 production trading route 分离为 authenticated admin capability tree；catalog 只在 MockBroker instance 宣布时暴露，拒绝 arbitrary provider cast/instanceof 作为 wire contract。
- 为每个 stimulus 提供 schema、scope、generation/sequence、actor/provenance 与 typed failure；state snapshot 是 query projection，不是 command success 的替代。
- 把 immediate/deferred mode 与 pending observation 声明在 provider descriptor，模拟可复现但不得证明 live idempotency/finality/atomicity。
- 所有 simulator errors 通过 same boundary ADT；未知 order/quantity/price/currency、invalid 或超量 qty 与 stale generation 不静默成功。published schema 的 `qty` 解析为 exact `Quantity`；若内部 canonical 字段写作 `quantity`，adapter 必须是 pure schema-bound `qty→quantity`，调用旧 `MockBroker.fillOrder` 时再明确编码为 `{qty}`，绝不把 `quantity` 当作旧 native input。
- Simulator admin tree 只声明 `Fill`→`MockBroker.fillOrder`、`CancelPending` 等实际 controls；不增加 TPSL execution command。Mock `placeOrder` 的 tpsl forwarding 只能作为 verification evidence，不能被 HTTP simulator capability 宣称。

**副作用与状态归属**

- SimulatorAdmin：认证和调用显式 simulator controls，读取 projection；不持有 live credentials。
- MockBroker：拥有 simulated matching/wallet/position state、generation/sequence 与 native-like observations。
- UTA：仍拥有 account scope、controlled journal 与 deferred activation；external stimulus 进入 observed fact channel。

**失败与恢复**

- unknown mock instance、not-a-MockBroker、stale generation、invalid Decimal/price/quantity、missing pending order 都是 typed failure。
- 内存 Mock process crash 后只可依据持久化 test fixture/recovery contract 判断；不能把 restart 后空 state 当作 live cancellation或clean baseline。
- simulator stream cancellation释放模拟资源，不取消持久化 UTA wait 或 live unknown attempt。
- `fillOrder` 的 pending/order/qty/price 错误按 simulator typed failure 返回；省略 qty 的 full fill 与提供 qty 的 partial fill 都保留 actual validation（qty &gt; 0 且不超过 totalQuantity）；TPSL 不在 simulator HTTP control surface，不能由其返回执行成功。

**原生证据边界**

- simulator.spec 与 uta-lifecycle E2E 已观察上述 mutation、precision、partial/fill/history/TPSL behavior；不证明当前 ad hoc HTTP route 的 auth/isolation 或 live guarantees。
- Mock/IBKR sentinel evidence 仅覆盖已测 fixtures；完整 NativeSentinelProfile 与 provider/account versions 仍需 evidence。

**单一权威切换**

- 建立 simulator/admin descriptor namespace 与 explicit mock account scope，迁移现有 routes/tests 的 controls 和 response schemas。
- 为 state projection 增加 generation/sequence/provenance/coverage，并将 direct MockBroker mutation 隐藏在 installed interpreter。
- 删除生产 route 对 instanceof/raw JSON/ad hoc error 的依赖；保留 lifecycle fixtures 作为 verification-support，不将测试路径升级为 live capability。

<a id="lsurface-supp-data"></a>

### LSURFACE-SUPP-DATA：补充数据 consumer：bars、reference、news 与 CLI/quant 入口

**源码文件：** [src/domain/market-data/bars/types.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/bars/types.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/bars/bar-service.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/bars/bar-service.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/reference/types.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/reference/types.ts) · [src/domain/market-data/reference/service.ts](../../src/domain/market-data/reference/service.ts) · [src/domain/news/types.ts](../../src/domain/news/types.ts) · [src/domain/news/collector/rss.ts](../../src/domain/news/collector/rss.ts) · [src/domain/news/store.ts](../../src/domain/news/store.ts) · [src/domain/news/query/archive.ts](../../src/domain/news/query/archive.ts) · [src/webui/routes/news.ts](../../src/webui/routes/news.ts) · [src/tool/quant.ts](../../src/tool/quant.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/client/historical.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/client/historical.ts) · [packages/ibkr/src/decoder/historical.ts](../../packages/ibkr/src/decoder/historical.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- bars consumer 以 barId/source/interval 组合 identity，聚合 vendor/UTA reads、记录 freshness/quality/delayed warning；OhlcvBar 仍有开放 index signature，provider richness/finality/coverage 不完整。
- reference service 提供 board-shaped low-frequency facts（provider/asOf/cache/origin/stale），与交易账户事实不同；quant tool `searchBars`/`calculateQuant` 明确 barId/source/capability 并传播 delayed warning。
- News RSS collector/store/archive 以 feed identity、GUID/link/hash 去重，定时 poll 并容忍单 feed errors；web route 仅有限 lookback/filter。native IBKR historical/news primitives 存在，但当前 news consumer 未使用。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 将 bars/reference/news/NewsGroup 各自注册为 Public 或声明-specific data capabilities；公共 consumer 不借用 UTA account identity。
- `Candle` exact base + provider extension 保留 WAP/barCount/update/provisional/closed/unknown/revision/correction；`News` 与 `NewsGroup` 保留 observed/published/source/coverage/membership/retraction。
- quant/CLI/web route 都从 data descriptor tree 生成 query schema/help；finite pull 返回 coverage/asOf/freshness/cursor，push 返回 nonterminal control frames 与 terminal ADT。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 barId/source/interval/timezone/session/adjustment、quality/freshness/delayed warning、reference stale/cache origin、RSS dedup/archive/lookback/filter 与 provider-native historical fields。
- 保留单 feed failure、partial historical support、missing/unknown finality，不以 feed drop 或 no native endpoint 推导 complete absence。
- 保留 quant 对 source/bar capability 的显式选择；数据输入不能调用 transaction recipe 或获得 trading authority。
- 普通 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 直接读取；journal 只持久化 explicit capture、受控 effect evidence 与 deferred predicate checkpoint，不把全部行情 frame 写入 control WAL。

**具体替代与修正**

- 去掉 OhlcvBar 开放 index bag，使用 exact extension schema 和 Decimal strings；provider richness 不可由 generic normalization 丢弃。
- 为 data leaves 增加 completeness/finality/correction/replay/coverage schema，并区分 public/account scope、finite pull/stream lifecycle。
- 将 RSS/native news/reference/quant/web routes 接入同一 generated declaration projection，但不合并成 `NewsGroup` command namespace。
- 对 IBKR/Longbridge/LeverUp historical absence、native news unused 等事实保持 provider evidence boundary；未观察 complete pagination/coverage 时返回 Partial/Unavailable。
- Coverage 的全局变体严格只有 `Complete | Partial | Unavailable`；未知值/质量/单字段存在性是 payload/reason（例如 UnknownNativeSentinel 或 quality reason），不得增设新的 global coverage variant。
- 保留已验证的 same-currency FX `Identity` 与显式 policy-approved `Estimated` display value；只删除 unknown=1 fabrication，不把所有 1:1、默认值或合法零值一概删除。

**副作用与状态归属**

- PublicDataProviders：拥有 source identity、native rich fields、coverage/finality/replay evidence。
- Bars/Reference/NewsStores：拥有各自 cache/archive/projection、dedup、cursor/freshness；不写 trading control journal。
- Quant/CLI/Web：只消费 generated data leaves，传播 exact coverage/failure/warnings。

**失败与恢复**

- per-source query failure 与 coverage 在 aggregate 中保留；feed error/drop、stale reference、historical unavailable 不静默 complete。
- push correction/retraction/gap/item-error 是 nonterminal；stream owner restart/loss 只在 provider replay/continuity evidence 下恢复。
- News persistence conflict/corrupt record 与 HTTP schema failure 进入 typed data/projection failure，不污染 order effect state。

**原生证据边界**

- 本节仅扩展原始 map 之外的 source-backed consumer entry points；它不增加 MAP ID，也不重写既有调查 JSON。
- source 证明当前 bars/reference/news/quant/web/native historical paths 与缺口；provider completeness, finality, correction/retraction/replay remain empirical。

**单一权威切换**

- 为每类 data unit 注册 construction-bound schema/descriptor/coverage policy，迁移 bars/reference/news/quant/web adapters。
- 保留现有 archive/cache/dedup stores，但增加 source/asOf/revision/coverage/finality fields 与 bounded failure projections。
- 删除 open JSON fallback 与 empty-as-complete behavior；未声明 native capability 从 tree 缺席，provider-specific unknown 显式保留。

<a id="lsurface-supp-provider"></a>

### LSURFACE-SUPP-PROVIDER：补充 provider/CLI/MCP consumer：开放 provider vocabulary 与生成解释器

**源码文件：** [src/server/cli.ts](../../src/server/cli.ts) · [src/server/cli-commands.ts](../../src/server/cli-commands.ts) · [src/core/mcp-export.ts](../../src/core/mcp-export.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/registry.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/factory.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/schemas/index.ts) · [packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts](../../packages/uta-protocol/src/types/broker.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- CLI_EXPORTS 是手写 command map，schema 多只约束 input；z.toJSONSchema 对不可表示内容 fallback `{}`；invoke 通过 unchecked internals 与 raw command name 转发。
- cli-commands 同时维护 UTA account/contract/order/position/git/market/sim 和 Alice RSS/search-bars 等 map；MCP exporter 只生成通用 text/content，不能表达完整 capability contract。
- provider registry 是 same-process module loader，IBroker 是闭合 mandatory method interface，native provider richness、stubs 与 generic Unsupported pressure 被投影到统一 surface；schemas barrel 当前为空。

**选定的抽象表达**

- CLI/MCP/AI 都是 `Projection(final Definition, AdmissionCatalog) -> Help | Describe | Invoke | Subscribe` 的 outer interpreter；不拥有独立 command map、recipe、permission 或 provider switch。
- provider declaration 使用 restricted structural schema algebra + construction-bound Constraint/evaluator/digest；runtime foreign provider 以 certified opaque document/slot binding 进入 catalog，不能 retroactively add TS union member。
- foreign boundary 提供 versioned handshake/discover/bind/call/subscribe/credit/cancel/terminal，descriptor schema/metadata/executable interpretation 一起认证；provider business vocabulary open，kernel control ADT exhaustive。
- output/error/effect/delivery/scope/resource/availability/fingerprint 从同一 declaration 派生，禁止 schema 与 independent metadata drift；unknown runtime document 可渲染但不 cast。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留现有 CLI/MCP consumers 的 discover/help/invoke/subscribe intent、provider-specific command names/fields、RSS/search-bars/market tools 与 native diagnostics。
- 保留 same-process registry 作为一种 trusted local interpretation path；保留 IBroker adapters 在迁移期的 exact native methods，不把未实现方法强制填成 global Unsupported。
- 保留 generated AI/CLI 的 provenance/correlation and redacted errors；不保留 raw action/path arbitrary dispatch。

**具体替代与修正**

- 将 CLI_EXPORTS/cli-commands/MCP exporter 改为最终 descriptor/catalog projection：named help、JSON Schema、invoke/subscribe path 和 output/error/delivery metadata 自动派生。
- 把 runtime schemas barrel、foreign handshake 与 capability certification 补为 construction-bound boundary；schema slot 绑定 provider/revision/digest 后再解析 input/output/failure。
- 将 IBroker closed interface 拆为 provider declarations/installed interpretations；缺 native capability 的 leaf 从 provider tree 缺席，避免四方法/global ActionContractMap。
- unknown runtime provider/document 只能走 encoded generic projection and typed boundary failure；它不会凭 schema shape 互换 capability 或跨 slot。
- 每个 provider 自己声明 exact schema/enum/extension；不得从 closed IBroker 或候选文档盲目继承 enum，也不得把历史 route 名称当作公共 vocabulary。
- descriptor/command identity 使用 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 full domain-separated digests；provider configuration fingerprint 不能代替包含 schema slots、delivery、requirements、interpretation 的目标 digest。

**副作用与状态归属**

- CLI/MCP/AI：渲染/调用最终 definitions，维护 CLI session/help/provenance；不执行 opaque recipe。
- Registry/Loader：加载并验证 provider declaration/interpretation/version/digest；foreign loader 由 UTA trusted tree 监督。
- UTA：拥有 current admission authorization、credential/effect requirements、writer and recovery；提供 Effect services R 但不制造 PermissionWitness。

**失败与恢复**

- schema export/parse failure、unknown provider document、binding slot/revision/digest mismatch、foreign load/handshake/transport/output error 都是 typed boundary failures。
- CLI process stop/pipe break 不代表 controlled effect cancelled；DispatchStarted/Unknown 仍由 UTA recovery owner 处理。
- registry interpretation unavailable 对新调用是 unavailable；历史 attempt 只能 exact resolver/recovery，不可用 current loader reprepare。

**原生证据边界**

- provider investigation 已证明 Zod 4 local input-only schema、手写 CLI map、empty schema barrel、same-process registry、closed IBroker 与 native richness/stubs；不证明 target declaration/evaluator/foreign protocol implementation。
- CLI/MCP runtime generation、AI display of dynamic document、remote error decoding 与 credential isolation 必须由 executable specimen/runtime gate 证明。

**单一权威切换**

- 建立 descriptor/catalog projection API，再逐项迁移 CLI_EXPORTS、cli-commands、MCP exporter；保留 user-facing names only as generated declaration metadata。
- 把 provider declarations 与 implementations construction-bind，增加 schema slot/digest certification；删除 `z.toJSONSchema` fallback `{}` 和 unchecked command internals。
- 为 foreign/local provider paths 增加 handshake/discover/invoke/stream/cancel/terminal protocol；移除 global map/four-method requirement，保留 provider-native unsupported absence。

<a id="lsurface-supp-trigger"></a>

### LSURFACE-SUPP-TRIGGER：补充 trigger→ReturnToAgent：Workspace、Session、headless、Inbox 的精确分工

**源码文件：** [src/core/event-log.ts](../../src/core/event-log.ts) · [docs/event-system.md](../../docs/event-system.md) · [docs/workspace-issues-and-scheduling.md](../../docs/workspace-issues-and-scheduling.md) · [src/workspaces/conversation-control.ts](../../src/workspaces/conversation-control.ts) · [src/workspaces/headless-task-registry.ts](../../src/workspaces/headless-task-registry.ts) · [src/workspaces/issues/comment-delivery.ts](../../src/workspaces/issues/comment-delivery.ts) · [src/core/inbox-store.ts](../../src/core/inbox-store.ts) · [docs/conversation-provenance.md](../../docs/conversation-provenance.md)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- EventLog 是 durable append-only history + process-local subscription，不是 task dispatcher；event-system 文档将自动化路由到 Workspace Issues/headless/Inbox，而不是 event bus。
- Workspace Issues 的 when 只表达 at/every/cron timing；scanner 触发时机，prompt 仍需检查条件。ConversationControl 根据 exact resumeId/owner/workspace 重建 target，缺失/删除的 native session 会 unavailable。
- headless task registry 把 task log/resumeId 写盘，boot 时 leftover running→interrupted；comment delivery 有 pending/replied/failed 与 deterministic reply ID；Inbox 是 server-stamped user notification record，不是 AI command queue，当前 connector dedup 不足。

**选定的抽象表达**

- A7 的 public relation 是 `DeferredInvocation<SourceBinding, Checkpoint, PredicateVersion, IntentRevision, FutureBoundary, Disposition, DecisionChannel>`。纯 `advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary) -> {checkpoint, NoActivation | Candidate | Gap}` 在 writer transaction 中与 event consumption/next outbox 一起提交；一个 not-started revision 只有一个 live activation owner，多个 source 在 owner 内组合。
- UTA durable outbox/control 先生成 stable `ReviewRequest{requestId, intentRevision, exactTerms, source/predicate evidence, reasons, validity, authorization state, recipient, allowedCommands}`；authenticated Alice bridge 以 `(requestId, deliveryGeneration)` durable-admit，再调用 exact `WorkspaceConversationControl`。
- `ReturnToAgent` 是 configured `RequestDecision` strategy：它不直接 dispatch broker。Alice 对 exact/reconstructed product Session 做责任归属；Workspace 是持久 context/desk，Issue 是用户可见 projection（除非明确另有 authority）；headless task 在 spawn 前写入 stable task/resume link；Inbox 只是用户通知 projection。
- Session/Workspace/headless/Inbox 不拥有 UTA effect authority：Session `resumeId` 是 responsible AI target，native agentSessionId/PID 是 backend metadata；headless retry 查询同一 admission；Inbox delivery 不等于 review command/venue completion。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留旧 HeldIntent/TriggerBinding/review/control records 的 durable fields 作为 DeferredInvocation storage projections：source identity/continuity、baseline、predicate revision、future/expiry、intent revision、recipient、allowed response。
- 保留 Workspace owner/reconstruction、exact resume/unavailable semantics、headless task attribution、Issue comment idempotent reply、Inbox user notification 与 product EventLog history。
- 保留 ReturnToAgent zero-dispatch semantics；Keep 返回 queryable suspended control handle，Rearm/new future boundary/new epoch，Revise 是新 intent revision，Discard 只限未发送。

**具体替代与修正**

- 事实可选择 evidence/request transition 但不能 authorize dispatch；predicate checkpoint 即使 nonmatching event 也持久化，missing baseline/continuity gap 不能制造 crossing，correction/retraction 维护 checkpoint/evidence。
- writer atomically consumes trusted event identity + invocation epoch at most once, commits checkpoint and next outbox; outbox send/receipt uses durable status and unknown recovery，scheduler lease expiry 不准重发 old possibly-sent request。
- Alice bridge 负责 stable request admission、WorkspaceConversationControl delivery、headless attribution、Inbox/Issue projection；UTA 负责 durable review/outbox/control identity。
- responsible AI response 必须 decode 到 `Keep | Discard | Rearm | Revise | RequestSubmission` 等 allowed schema，再由 UTA 重查 review id/revision/scope/policy/CAS；绝不解析自由文本作为 permission。
- ReviewRequest 的 no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 必须冻结为 `SuspendControl | CloseWithoutDispatch | EscalateDecision`；response 与 timeout 在同一 control CAS 竞争，禁止自动执行 fallback。

**副作用与状态归属**

- UTA：拥有 DeferredInvocation intent revision、checkpoint、source binding、predicate version、outbox、ReviewRequest identity、activation owner、dispatch/recovery。
- AliceBridge：拥有 authenticated admission record、deliveryGeneration、WorkspaceConversationControl exact/reconstructed routing、headless attribution。
- Workspace/Session：Workspace 持久化 product context；Session resumeId 指定 responsible AI conversation；两者都不授予 UTA writer authority。
- Headless/Inbox/Issue：Headless 记录 task/resume/worker lifecycle；Issue/Inbox 是用户可见 delivery projections；delivery/reply receipt 与 venue outcome 分开。

**失败与恢复**

- source gap/correction/retraction、missing baseline、predicate evaluator unavailable、stale future boundary、duplicate event identity、stale epoch 进入 `Gap`/checkpoint invalidation/RecoveryRequired，不触发 fake activation。
- Alice admission duplicate 查询同一 stable request；Workspace resume unavailable 则 exact policy 返回 unavailable/ask user/reconstructed target，不创建任意新 agent；headless crash 标记 Interrupted，不能声称 delivery/dispatch complete。
- Keep/expiry/lease/approval 是不同 clocks；停止 CLI 或保留 draft 不取消 sent/unknown venue work。Inbox pending/replied/failed 只证明 delivery projection，不证明 responsible AI command 或 effect terminal。
- 新的 review admission 只产生一次 durable request identity；若后续 controlled Start 成功才获得 one-use DispatchGrant，重复 Start 返回 AlreadyStarted evidence，不能由保存的 approval 重新发 grant。

**原生证据边界**

- source 已证明 EventLog/history、Issue timing/scanner、ConversationControl exact/reconstructed resolution、headless task logs、comment delivery states、Inbox notification roles；不证明已有 UTA review outbox↔Alice bridge。
- trigger supplemental investigation 明确要求 authenticated bridge、stable request key、one activation owner、pure checkpoint and ReturnToAgent strategy；这些是 host design obligations，非现有 native capability。
- EventLog subscription、Issue scanner 和 Inbox connector 不可升级为 durable trigger bus/delivery authority without implementation evidence。

**单一权威切换**

- 将 waiting order/TriggerBinding/review records 映射为 DeferredInvocation storage projection，增加 checkpoint/predicate/version/epoch/activation owner/outbox identity。
- 实现 UTA outbox→authenticated Alice durable admission→WorkspaceConversationControl→headless/Inbox/Issue projections；retry 使用同一 request/delivery/task identity。
- 实现 pure advance + single writer checkpoint transaction，禁止 source fact 直接 dispatch；将 ReturnToAgent/Keep/Rearm/Revise/RequestSubmission 接入 typed response schema。
- 保留 EventLog、Issue scheduler、headless registry、Inbox 为各自 owner；不要创建新的 global event bus 或把 delivery projection 当作 venue/effect authority。


## 迁移、模拟边界与能力验收

<a id="lcore-cross-boundary"></a>

### LCORE-CROSS-BOUNDARY：跨组不变量与证据边界

**关系依据：** 主设计书 A1–A8；相关原始问题与跨组契约见逐项绑定附录。

**旧行为与来源约束**

- 恢复的 crossGroupContracts、additionalFindings、composition/data/trigger/provider investigations 共同指出：旧 UTA/IBroker/Git/registry 以 SDK superset、默认 scope、静默过滤和字符串错误把不同语义压成一个 facade；source experiments 又显示 remote side effect 后 snapshot/persist failure 与 guard cooldown consumption 的真实风险。

**选定的抽象表达**

- 本章所有迁移都服从 A1–A8：一个 schema-bound capability definition 绑定 semantic unit、exact slots、requirements、delivery 与 controlled-effect protocol；provider vocabulary open、kernel control ADT finite；Effect service、permission witness、availability/evidence 和 historical interpretation resolver 分离。动态 descriptor 必须 construction-bound，stream item-error/snapshot-end 与 terminal sum 分离，deferred invocation 用 durable pure checkpoint 与 single activation owner。 Coverage 对外固定为 Complete|Partial|Unavailable，未知仅是 value/quality/reason；公共 live data 可带 asOf/coverage 而不被强制 journalize。迁移仅采用离线 parity/import 后的单一 authority cutover，不做 speculative dual-read/shim。 受控效果必须保持 `Controlled<RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract>` 的 recipe/receipt/stage-error 关联与 admission/execution R/P 分离；只有 fresh Start 返回 one-use process-bound `DispatchGrant`，duplicate/query Start 只能返回 AlreadyStarted。No-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable policy 必须预先选择 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision，并在同一 control CAS 下处理 timeout/response，永不 auto-exec fallback。普通 live data 可以用 asOf/coverage 读取并保留 provenance，不必把所有事实写进 journal。 旧 Git import 同样不以 DispatchStarted marker 缺失推定 NoStart：只有正面的 no-callback provenance 才可退休；缺 native/attempt identity 的旧 post-push 为 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay，positive terminal evidence 才可历史 resolve。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 所有 source-specific unknown、read-only review、keyless/public boundary、native field richness、decimal/FX/valuation uncertainty、callback generation、sync/history/snapshot、simulator and Guardian boundaries 均保留为 observable obligations。
- ReturnToAgent 只作为 configured RequestDecision strategy；trigger/source/event 本身不授权 dispatch；数据流不承担交易 WAL/lock/compensation。
- CoreAccount: K01: Each CoreAccount capability is a declaration that supplies its own exact input/output/error schemas, semantic unit, handler and resource needs; data readers and controlled effects compose separately, and adding a provider leaf must not edit a kernel switch.
- CoreAccount: K02: The UTA-facing fixed CapabilityDescriptor envelope is shared, but provider trees remain open-ended. CoreAccount must not introduce a global ActionContractMap or require every provider to implement empty broker handlers; the source IBroker/global switch is retained only as currentBehavior evidence.
- CoreAccount: K03: Zod/JSON-schema declarations are the source for validation, static types, metadata and CLI projections. Native order, instrument and error fields survive as exact provider extensions; SDK Contract/Order values are adapter-bound and never journaled.
- CoreAccount: K04: Order, Candle, Instrument and related units are composable contracts, not a closed order-combination catalogue. Quantity/notional, protection, TIF and relation choices are provider-declared HOF/schema combinations; AccountScope is required for account/order effects only, while public data carries explicit Public or schema-declared context.
- CoreAccount: K05: Account/position/order/catalog reads are pull data or resource-scoped push streams with explicit freshness, cursor, coverage, backpressure and recovery evidence. They do not use prepare/approve/compensate, effect locks or per-frame WAL.
- CoreAccount: K06: Generated CLI/help/describe views must come from the same declared capability tree. Pull returns finite schema data and push returns lifecycle-aware frames; CLI cancellation releases its read resource without cancelling an already accepted trading effect.
- CoreAccount: K07: Broker adapters may retain native SDK/protocol/process boundaries. Only the selected declared leaf handler crosses that boundary; load/input/output/delivery errors and post-dispatch Unknown remain distinct, and method presence never proves idempotency or atomicity.
- CoreAccount: K08: Durable intent, approval, dispatch, WAL/CAS/idempotency, reconciliation and compensation apply only to controlled trading effects. Data-cache or observation failure cannot trigger transaction compensation; native guarantees remain evidence-qualified.
- CoreAccount: K09: A trigger/event source is not authority. If CoreAccount later participates in a trigger binding, activation must carry frozen intent/revision, scope and policy evidence and pass the normal execution authorization path.
- CoreAccount: K10: ReturnToAgent is a durable unsent-order review branch with stable ReviewRequest/outbox identity and explicit retain/rearm/revise/discard/request-submission commands; it creates no broker dispatch and does not claim AI delivery.
- CoreAccount: K11: Existing source facts, durability boundaries, unknown/precision/absence obligations and open native questions remain evidence. Reframing removes obsolete universal-SDK conclusions without declaring sibling ownership or empirical gaps solved.
- CoreAccount: K12: CoreAccount verificationCases are future falsifiers only: prove declaration-derived type/validator/metadata changes, public-vs-account scope, data pull/push separation, native schema validation, unknown barriers and ReturnToAgent zero-dispatch behavior; no runtime proof was run here.
- ProtocolModels: AccountScope is required on account-bound controlled effects, order/position observations, conflict keys and account-authenticated market observations; public Candle/Instrument/News data uses an explicit PublicMarket source variant or a provider-declared scope and never receives a default account. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:642-688, :700-724, :759-790 and git.ts:256-305.
- ProtocolModels: CapabilityDescriptor is the fixed UTA-facing envelope (identity/path, schema versions/fingerprint, input/result/error schemas, delivery/effect/resource metadata, provenance and availability); provider capability trees are open, leaves may be absent, and an existing leaf can be unavailable without becoming structural absence. There is no global ActionContractMap or mandatory full Broker SDK. Evidence: broker.ts:475-620.
- ProtocolModels: Order is a semantic unit and controlled-effect input composed by provider declarations/HOFs. Units versus Notional, amount versus percent, timing and protection remain local validated relations; native MOC/LOC/REL/OPG or other fields survive as exact provider extensions. No provider is required to accept another provider’s leaf, and native atomicity is never inferred from shape. Evidence: UnifiedTradingAccount.ts:603-637, :703-724 and cited IBKR/Alpaca/Longbridge/CCXT sources.
- ProtocolModels: RuntimeHealth is a closed process observation ADT; broker reach, capability availability, authorization and transaction admission are separate. Health observations never grant dispatch permission. Evidence: broker.ts:366-426.
- ProtocolModels: Pull results are finite data projections and push streams have explicit frame/lifecycle/cursor/backpressure contracts. Complete/Partial/Unavailable and freshness/finality remain explicit; data reads and caches do not use prepare/approve/compensate or per-frame transaction WAL. Evidence: broker.ts:322-364, :428-450.
- ProtocolModels: JournalWriter/events/attempts are authority only for controlled effects; Git/history/manager and market-data outputs are rebuildable projections. DispatchStarted is durable before remote mutation, and response/storage loss remains Unknown/RecoveryRequired. Evidence: TradingGit.ts:141-185, :160-180, :171-180.
- ProtocolModels: InstrumentId/InstrumentDescriptor/ScopedOrderRef and PositionObservation are normalized identities/facts; native Contract/Order/Decimal stay adapter-local. A string aliceId, symbol or branded string alone cannot prove equality. Evidence: contract-ext.ts:4-22, :25-31 and broker.ts:10-12.
- ProtocolModels: Protocol failures are route/leaf/action-associated ADTs with redacted evidence and typed recovery (ProtocolViolation, QueryFailure, CapabilityFailure, BrokerRejection, DispatchUnknown, StorageUnavailable); WireBrokerError and Error.message are not a universal contract. Evidence: broker.ts:44-79 and errors.ts:10-18.
- Identity: InstrumentIdentityContract: InstrumentId is only a nominal type; adapters construct it from an evidence-backed venue/listing/native-key tuple, persist a uniqueness-checked alias mapping scoped by venue/listing and by account only where the identity is account-bound, and surface unresolved or conflicting mappings. Display symbol, `aliceId`, conId, and SDK Contract are not interchangeable.
- Identity: ScopeContract: public Candle/News/Instrument/catalog facts use explicit `Public` scope and never receive a fabricated account or subaccount; account positions, account-bound search targets, and executable order facts carry an explicit `AccountScope`. Read/keyless capability is not promoted to transaction authority.
- Identity: NativeSentinelContract: IBKR UNSET_DECIMAL/UNSET_DOUBLE/UNSET_INTEGER handling remains adapter-local; OrderSpec, OrderSnapshot, protocol, journal, and projections use explicit absent/typed values and never SDK objects or sentinel numbers.
- Identity: PositionObservationContract: broker-reported pair, incomplete known component, or derived valuation must preserve multiplier, currency, InstrumentId, AccountScope, freshness, and observation provenance; one-sided upstream valuation is retained as Incomplete and only a selected Prepare whose effect explicitly requires complete valuation rejects it.
- Identity: CatalogSearchContract: normalizer, ranker, account-query fan-out, and protocol must share deterministic score/tie/source-precedence/dedup/page/truncation/source-failure semantics; duplicate canonical IDs require equality evidence and partial-source failure cannot be silently resolved.
- Identity: TransactionEntryContract: HTTP/UI form routes, TradingGit projection, transaction-kernel, journal-store, and durable-scheduler must cut over together from executeOneShotOrder to Draft/Prepare/Approve/Queue; Git commit/push is not broker execution authority.
- Identity: NativeInstrumentContract: the currently observed IBKR SecType values and structural rules remain in brokers/ibkr codecs, while the UTA-facing Instrument descriptor carries evidence-backed identity/context and precise provider extensions. Other providers may expose their own native kinds; only exact, declared mappings yield shared semantics or execution capability, and absence is reported as capability unavailable rather than by a universal handler or closed global taxonomy.
- Catalog: Fixed outer metadata: each provider declaration exposes protocol version, stable capability identity/command path, schema version/fingerprint, exact input/result/domain-error schemas, delivery, effect category, permissions/resources, provenance and scoped availability evidence. Provider trees and native extensions remain open; structural absence is preserved.
- Catalog: Schema/HOF source of truth: provider declarations compose exact input/output/error schemas and semantic units without a central closed action table or handwritten Cartesian order variants. Provider-local registration/layer functions may use any language, SDK or process.
- Catalog: Scope semantics: AccountScope is required for account-owned facts and controlled trading effects; public Candle/Instrument/News/search readers use Public/data scope or their exact provider-declared scope. The Catalog never fabricates a default account or subaccount.
- Catalog: Pack provenance: src/core/broker-packs.ts remains the manifest/pointer/package-identity gate. Installed release precedence is retained; broken installed content does not silently fall through to workspace or Mock. Descriptor decoding is separate from provider execution.
- Catalog: Identity: AccountId, AccountScope, ConnectionGeneration and LegacyUtaIdAlias/IdentityBinding remain durable account concerns. Preset labels, engine tags, credential hashes and display symbols never substitute for observed scope or stable identity.
- Catalog: Environment and availability: mode/port/network labels are TradingEnvironmentHint only. Authenticated provider evidence and current resource/permission state produce availability; unknown or mismatched evidence does not become writable capability.
- Catalog: Data/effect boundary: Candle/Instrument/News/NewsGroup pulls are finite results and pushes are resource-scoped streams with explicit cursor, end, error and gap semantics. Data readers, caches and streams do not use order approval, compensation, locks or per-frame WAL.
- Catalog: Controlled effect boundary: only a provider-declared trading/effect leaf is wrapped by prepare/approve/dispatch/recovery. Existing scope/unit validation, durable intent, WAL/CAS/lease, dispatch identity, reconcile-before-retry and Unknown handling remain there; native idempotency, atomicity and reversibility require provider evidence.
- Catalog: Credential/sealed storage: src/core/config.ts:704-746 remains the owner-only sealed configuration boundary. SecretRefs cross into provider effects, while secret material stays out of protocol payloads, descriptor metadata, plans, digests, journals and logs.
- Catalog: Instrument/search: SearchPattern preserves source symbol and rule version; only observed venue listings create canonical Instrument associations. Completeness is Complete/Partial/Unavailable, never guessed from a heuristic or skipped provider failure.
- Catalog: FX: multi-currency provider leaves declare an FxRequirement; an effect-provided, provenance-bearing FxObservation is required only for those leaves. Currency-independent data/read leaves remain available without an FX service.
- Catalog: Simulator: SimulatorInstanceId and AccountScope are durable identity; simulated market/order state may remain ephemeral. Reset/restart yields explicit generation/recovery evidence and never fabricates a fill or remints identity.
- Catalog: Wire and CLI: public/HTTP/CLI projections are derived from the same capability tree. Decode unknown once, preserve exact leaf schemas, distinguish pull output from push frames, and do not treat schema success as readiness or authorization.
- Catalog: CCXT tools and other callers consume declared provider capability ports, not brokerEngine reflection. Availability and completeness are provider-specific and structured.
- Catalog: Verification: K12 scenarios prove declaration-derived schema/type/metadata/CLI changes, structural absence, boundary rejection, pull/push lifecycle, provider output validation and controlled-effect recovery without claiming native guarantees that remain unobserved.

**具体替代与修正**

- 用固定的 CapabilityDescriptor 外壳绑定 identity/path、schema slots、delivery、effect/resources、provenance 与 availability；provider tree 保持开放，unsupported leaf 保持结构性缺失。
- 把 AccountScope、ProviderInstance、ConnectionGeneration、AccountId、SubAccountId、InstrumentId、Principal、DispatchIdentity 分成不可互换的 identity，并只对账户事实/受控效果要求 scope。
- 把 Pull 的 Complete|Partial|Unavailable 与 Push 的 item-error/gap/snapshot-end、Completed|Failed|Cancelled 分开；普通 live query 保留 asOf/coverage/provenance，不把全量 frame 写成交易 WAL。
- 把 Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation,AdmissionContract&gt; 的 recipe、receipt/control-result、stage-error、admission R/P 与 execution R/P 保持同一关联；受控发送前写入 durable intent/attempt。
- 让 fresh Start transition 产生一次性 process-bound DispatchGrant；duplicate/query Start 只返回 AlreadyStarted，持久化 authorization/plan evidence 永远不等于 grant。
- 为 no-reply、expiry、delivery-unavailable 冻结 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision；timeout 与 response 使用同一 control CAS，永不自动执行 fallback。
- 把 `LegacyUtaIdAlias` 限制为已有有效 ID 的离线 import mapping；把旧 Git/字符串错误/IBKR sentinel/descriptor callback 迁移到 provider-local codecs 与历史 resolver。
- 用 RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 的完整、分域、版本化 digest 绑定 definition/command/plan；未验证 provider idempotency、atomicity、finality、absence 与 recovery 保持 evidence gap。
- 对 legacy Git row 执行 positive no-callback 分类；marker 缺失不构成 NoStart，缺 native/attempt identity 的 post-push 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，禁止 native replay。

**副作用与状态归属**

- 公共 schema/wire/CLI 由同一声明派生；外部 provider 可为 in-process SDK 或 supervised foreign process，均以 versioned handshake/descriptor/typed boundary 接入。UTA writer owns durable control/outbox/authority；Alice 仅 owner delivery/admission，不替代 execution authority。

**失败与恢复**

- 所有未决事实保持 empirical-evidence boundary；unknown after send 进入 recovery，不 reprepare；历史 definition removed/revised 仅在 not-started 且 durable retire 后可改用新 revision。

**原生证据边界**

- 本组没有声称已完成 runtime verification；K12 verificationCases 是 future falsifiers，主集成器需运行 schema-derived CLI、foreign process、durable-effect、stream 和 trigger specimens。

**单一权威切换**

- binding/question appendix 用于逐项组装最终书；不得用本章节替代原始 source records，也不得把 provider-specific findings 重写成新的业务实体或统一 action map。

### LCCXT-OVERVIEW：CCXT provider pack 边界与遗留能力容纳方法

[services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bitget.ccxt.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bitget.ccxt.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bybit.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/exchanges/bybit.spec.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- source architecture currently has a legacy CcxtBroker implementing IBroker and routing optional helpers through exchangeOverrides; tests combine real CCXT construction, keyless public reads, local mocks, and venue-specific overrides.
- source data and account paths contain nullable/catch-all conversions, permissive empty/zero/current-time fallbacks, and provider-local sequential routes; these remain migration facts, not hidden guarantees.
- assigned CCXT source does not read exchange.has; future availability sampling must inspect a versioned exchange instance rather than infer support from method presence or registry membership.

**选定的抽象表达**

- 本章节把 CcxtCore 与 CcxtVenues 作为同一个 CCXT provider pack 的迁移边界来容纳，而不是再造 universal CCXT broker interface。每个 capability leaf 在构造时绑定 semantic unit、精确 input/success/failure schema、requirements、delivery、interpretation revision 与 provider identity；pack 只组合声明，不把 legacy CcxtBroker、exchangeOverrides 或四方法 action map 提升为内核代数。
- A1：Use exact semantic units Order, Candle, Instrument, News/NewsGroup where present; attach AccountScope only where a fact/capability requires it, and keep provider/source identity distinct from canonical identity.
- A2：Use a restricted structural schema algebra. Construction binds Constraint&lt;Value, Configuration, Failure&gt;, deterministic evaluator artifact and digest; extensions lift the same constraint. Foreign runtime documents bind provider instance, capability, revision, semantic/schema digest and schema slot; equal JSON shape is insufficient. Provider vocabulary remains open; never blindly inherit candidate-document enum sets.
- A3：Resource provisioning, permission witness, schema compatibility and native guarantee are separate. Controlled&lt;RecipeAssociation, AdmissionContract&gt; retains receipt/control-result/stage-error associations. withTransaction accepts only an opaque non-public mutation recipe; query/stream invokers cannot accept it.
- A4：Current CCXT leaves are finite Pull. Kernel Coverage is exactly Complete|Partial|Unavailable; unknown value/quality is payload/reason, not a new global coverage variant. Any future Push must represent Start, Update/Correction/Retraction/Gap, SnapshotEnd, recoverable item error and one terminal Completed/Failed/Cancelled; native snapshot-end is not automatically subscription terminal, and crash does not promise last stdout frame.
- A5：Decision/Evolution stay pure. Prepared plan freezes exact historical interpretation, native request form, identity, scope, schema/capability revision and idempotency evidence. Target canonicalization is RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256 with full domain-separated digests, but this shard does not claim that narrow specimens implement it. After DispatchStarted/Unknown, missing interpretation requires RecoveryRequired and never reprepare/current-code dispatch.
- A6：Only declared controlled effects reach the writer/interpreter. A fresh Start transition yields one-use process-bound DispatchGrant; duplicate/query Start returns AlreadyStarted evidence and never a replayable grant; persisted authorization is not a grant. Ack, observation, compensation and Unknown are explicit; data reads do not become transactions or order WAL.
- A7：Deferred invocation has one not-started intent revision and one live activation owner. Pure advance(checkpoint, sourceFact, futureBoundary) yields NoActivation/Candidate/Gap; facts cannot authorize dispatch, and writer atomically commits checkpoint/event/outbox. No-reply, expiry and delivery-unavailable policies are frozen as SuspendControl, CloseWithoutDispatch or EscalateDecision; timeout races response under the same control CAS and never auto-executes.
- A8：Provider vocabulary remains open and venue-local. No global BrokerActionTypeMap, four-method requirement, Cartesian order types, speculative dual-read/shim compatibility phase, or universal ReturnToAgent default is introduced. Migration uses offline parity/import followed by a single-authority cutover.

**保留的可观察契约**

- Preserve the real/keyless CCXT constructor and public-history evidence path, but classify it as PublicReadOnly and keep the CCXT_E2E gate as selection evidence rather than proof of private authority or realtime quality.
- Preserve CcxtBroker/CcxtMarket/legacy DTOs and override registry only at the provider compatibility boundary; the core never stores raw SDK objects as its schema, and no speculative dual-read/shim phase is added without a shipped boundary.
- Preserve exact venue behavior: Bitget Classic six namespace route and merge key, Bybit category sweep and four lookup paths, Hyperliquid last→close reference and derived mark, and default-vs-override distinctions.
- Preserve read-only review and empirical uncertainty. Native availability, idempotency, finality, retention, pagination, and endpoint semantics stay Unknown/requires-provider-evidence until recorded provider observations bind them.
- Preserve source-proven legitimate zero values, verified same-currency FxIdentity, and explicitly policy-approved Estimated display values; remove unknown=1/unknown=0 fabrication rather than deleting every default or every 1:1 policy.

**具体替代与修正**

- 按章节把 120 个 expectedId 映射到 13 个详细 accommodation sections，并在 binding appendix 中逐一给出 preserve 或 adjust-prior-candidate 裁决。
- 将 all source/input boundaries 解码为精确 schema/Result variants；移除 unknown value/quality 被 zero 或 local now 冒充的 fallback、global action map 与 coupled method gate，但保留 schema 明确的合法零值、same-currency identity 和 policy-approved display estimate。
- 把 account, permission, writer effect, observation, data cache, control journal 与 deferred invocation 分离；ordinary live data 可按 asOf/coverage 读取，不为每个事实写 full-feed WAL；只持久化 explicit capture、control evidence 与 activation checkpoint。
- Controlled effect 先走 admission/authorization 与 writer CAS；只有新鲜 Start 才产生一次性 DispatchGrant。No-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable 必须在注册时冻结为 SuspendControl、CloseWithoutDispatch 或 EscalateDecision。
- 把 44 个原始问题字符串逐字保留，并根据 closure 维持 requires-provider-evidence 或 resolved-by-host-contract；不把设计记录升级为 runtime evidence。
- 不添加 speculative dual-read/shim/compatibility phase：先做 offline parity/import，再一次性切换 single authority。
- Restored cross-group contracts are consumed as concrete source constraints and re-expressed by the A1-A8 laws; their historical K labels are not emitted as binding/question rule identifiers.

**副作用与状态归属**

- Connection interpreter owns endpoint, credentials reference, sandbox/demo guards, proxy and load/refresh network effects; credential values remain outside this artifact and are supplied through approved secret/reference boundaries.
- Provider leaf interpreter owns native request encoding, route sequencing, response decoding, provider error evidence and source timestamps. Writer owns only declared controlled effects and atomic journal/outbox/checkpoint writes.
- Catalog/data/account observations may be read live with asOf/coverage and may be cached or durably recorded with explicit capture/provenance, but they are not order WAL and do not authorize dispatch. Ordinary frame throughput does not share account/order locks.
- A7 owner owns one live activation and its durable checkpoint; RecoveryRequired/OutcomeUnknown retains original bytes, identities, and ownership until observation/reconciliation resolves it. DispatchGrant is process-bound and one-use, not durable authorization.

**失败与恢复**

- Unknown, unavailable, malformed, no-account, permission denied, stale, route failure and native protocol violations remain distinct domain failures where the source gives enough evidence; Kernel Coverage remains only Complete|Partial|Unavailable.
- A crash or broken pipe after dispatch does not imply a terminal frame or absence; preserve prepared bytes and dispatch-start uncertainty, retain the conflict lock, and reconcile through the declared observation capability. Losing a grant/response after commit leads to observation, never replay.
- Provider-specific failures (Bitget namespace rejection, Bybit category failure/conditional-path absence, Hyperliquid quote unavailability) do not trigger a universal fallback or blind resend.
- Control no-reply/expiry/delivery-unavailable is resolved only by its frozen policy; timeout and response compete under the same control CAS, with no auto-exec fallback.

**原生证据边界**

- CcxtCore closure keeps six empirical prerequisites; CcxtVenues keeps 36 empirical prerequisites plus two host/integration resolutions. The questions appendix is the exact retained set of 44 originals.
- No assigned source currently proves exchange.has availability, native id stability, order idempotency, finality/retention, full listing coverage, stream quality, or private permission. A future specimen must bind venue, environment, SDK revision, provider capability revision, scope, request, source timestamps, observedAt and outcome evidence.
- RFC8785/JCS/UTF-8/SHA-256 full domain-separated digest is a selected host target, not evidence that the narrow CCXT specimens already implement it.

**单一权威切换**

- First add provider-bound schema/Constraint definitions and adapters; then migrate public/catalog/data/account leaves; then migrate optional controlled effects and venue-local overrides. Do not make raw CcxtBroker or registry types part of the core algebra.
- For every existing caller, replace implicit defaults with explicit availability/failure variants and preserve native route evidence. PreparedPlanRecord stores exact interpretation/request bytes and selected identity; post-start uncertainty goes to recovery, never current-code reprepare.
- Offline parity/import compares old adapter projections against the declared provider leaves without introducing a speculative dual-read/shim phase; once parity evidence is accepted, perform a single-authority cutover and remove obsolete compatibility ownership.
- The integrated book and specimens consume this chapter only after every assigned map binding and question closure is represented; this artifact itself records no runtime claim beyond the restored source evidence boundary.

### LTX-MIGRATION：启动、authority cutover、simulator fixture 与实证闸门

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/main.ts](../../services/uta/src/main.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/uta-manager.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/uta-manager.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/git/TradingGit.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/setup.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/__test__/e2e/setup.ts) · [services/uta/package.json](../../services/uta/package.json) · [services/uta/tsup.config.ts](../../services/uta/tsup.config.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- UTA startup 先读取 config、restore JSON state、建立 brokers、启动 snapshot/order timers、绑定 loopback HTTP，并以简单 ok/startedAt/UTA count health 提供服务；构造函数 fire-and-forget connect，shutdown 丢失 poller handle 后直接 process.exit。E2E setup 使用 singleton raw broker 初始化，只过滤 paper/sandbox/demo；package/tsup/Docker evidence 尚未包含选定的 SQLite native stack。Simulator 直接操纵进程内 MockBroker；S7 external stimulus 与普通 effect scenario 共用旧 fixture。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Composition root 依次拥有 OwningHome→OpeningDatabase→Migrating→VerifyingJournal→RebuildingExecution→AcquiringConnections→ClassifyingRecovery→Ready；各 provider capability availability、公共 data availability 与 controlled-effect readiness 相互独立。StorageStackStatus 未验证时，controlled UTA 不 Ready/dispatch，也不退回 JSON/alternate driver。测试提供 PollingVerticalSliceFixture：UTA authority SQLite 与独立 DurableMockVenue ledger 分开，声明 effect mutation、finite pull、push stream leaves；runtime fixture 的 pure fold/classify 与真实 crash cuts 分开标示。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 单一本地 UTA home/authority 保留；外部 provider effect endpoint、data facts/streams、telemetry/backup 都是 scoped external roles，不引入必需的 Redis/Postgres/workflow engine。
- paper/sandbox safety、AccountScope/environment/session/entitlement evidence、complete baseline 和 cleanup 仍是 controlled acceptance 的前置条件；public data 可以独立报告 availability。
- Simulator 的 mark/fill/cancel stimuli、InProcessRetainedLedger 和 DurableMockVenue 作为明确的 test-owned seam 保留，但不升级为 native venue guarantees。
- 首次 migration/recovery、read-only projection、backup/restore、corruption、packaging/ABI、single/double owner 等均以具名 status/evidence 表示，不以 manifest/hash/count 代表通过。

**具体替代与修正**

- 启动先验证 declaration/schema/DB/Journals/checkpoints，再扫描非终态 transaction/job/lease/attempt，建立 RecoveryCase/ObservationJob；之后才开放 controlled admission。
- 按 Source/Docker/PackagedDesktop × OS/arch/Node ABI/SQLite/native artifact/provider bridge 执行 storage acceptance；锁定 semver/digest/load/open/migrate/pragma/crash/restore/relocation/corruption/read-only/double-owner evidence。
- shutdown root 保存 scheduler/layer handles，并按 orderly sequence 关闭 admission、drain/interrupt workers、persist jobs、drain writer、close provider layers/DB；不以 process.exit 掩盖 in-flight unknown。
- 验收场景将 S7 external stimulus 与 UTA effect path 分离；effect tests 使用独立 durable venue，data tests 使用已声明的 pull/push 或 observation owner。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Composition root 持有 Layer wiring、supervised fibers、lifecycle 与 readiness；JournalStore 持有受控 authority；provider process 在可信 credential boundary 下持有 native execution/data protocols。
- 测试用 MockVenue 持有其 ledger 与 native test identity；UTA journal 永不将其作为 authority 读写，data caches/streams 也不写入 effect WAL。
- Packaging/home metadata 描述部署而非 rollback/fencing/exactly-once；restore quarantine 与显式 authority cutover 仍由 writer 负责。
- Observability/projection sink 可报告 queue/unknown/freshness，但不能授权、结算或 retry mutations。

**失败与恢复**

- 启动时 StorageFailure/CorruptJournal/MigrationRequired/NativeStackUnverified 会阻断受影响的 controlled authority；无关 public data/lite capability 独立报告 availability。
- Credential/session/baseline/entitlement gap 返回 Blocked/NotApplicable/OperatorRequired；不得因 endpoint reachability、paper label、mock success 或 SDK method presence 而 dispatch。
- Restore/clone 进入 RestoreQuarantine→ObservationOnly；不能靠复制 UUID/sequence 解决 double-owner 或 stale home。
- Fixture setup/teardown failure 会使 vertical slice 失败并保留 journal/venue evidence；不接受 in-memory fake 作为 durable integration proof。
- Legacy import 不得从缺少 DispatchStarted 推断 NoEffectsApplied：旧 TradingGit 只有在 executeOperation 之后才产生/持久化 completed push record。staging/pending 残留同样可能表示 broker callback 已执行，随后 snapshot/persistence 失败，如 E01 所示。缺少 native/attempt identity 的 completed 或 ambiguous post-push record 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired，除非 positive terminal evidence 解析出历史记录；只有明确的 source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback，才允许 no-start retirement，且任何 legacy record 都不得 native replay。

**原生证据边界**

- 当前 startup、e2e setup、manifest 与 simulator 仅证明现有进程行为；本设计切片未执行 native SQLite dependency/version/ABI、durable writer、foreign bridge、真实 provider、AI delivery 或 venue conformance。
- 验证 artifacts 仅证明 pure schema/trigger examples 与 local fixtures；不建立上述 production runtime guarantees。
- TradingGit.ts:119-249 与 E01 证明 callback-before-persistence，但不提供历史 DispatchStarted marker；因此 no-start classification 必须依据 positive source/evidence，而非 marker absence。

**单一权威切换**

- Authority cutover 顺序为：盘点 legacy files/config/external liabilities → 冻结受影响 admission → 携 provenance 迁移/replay → 分类 unknown/recovery，并在任何 no-start retirement 前要求 positive no-callback evidence → 启用新 writer/readers → 验证 projections → 删除 fallback/direct dispatch → 仅在已确认 published external read projection 或历史 import reader 下保留 legacy exports 为只读；无此责任则删除 legacy exports。
- 任何实现都不得删除或改写既有 investigation records；第一个 executable slice 必须锁定 runtime dependencies，并在声称 Ready 前保留 raw migration evidence。
- DispatchStarted 之后，historical resolver 必须精确且 immutable；若 compiler/observer/compensator 不可用，则保持 RecoveryRequired。对 legacy record，缺少新的 DispatchStarted marker 不是 no-start evidence，因为旧 TradingGit 只在 executeOperation 之后持久化 completed push state，且 staging/pending 残留也可能来自 callback 后的 snapshot/persistence failure。只有 positive source/evidence 证明未进入 broker callback，才可进行 NoEffectsApplied/no-start retirement；缺少 native/attempt identity 的 completed 或 ambiguous post-push record 进入 LegacyDispatchIdentityMissing/RecoveryRequired（或仅凭 positive terminal evidence 形成 resolved historical record），并且永不 native replay。

### LVENUE-MOCK-HARNESS：MockBroker：测试 Layer、生命周期与故障注入

**源码文件：** [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.spec.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/MockBroker.ts) · [services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/index.ts](../../services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/mock/index.ts)

**旧行为与来源约束**

- MockBroker class 同时持有 legacy facade、native translation、mutable ledger、queries、simulator controls、CallRecord 与 method/count failure injector；factory/Partial/override 可直接安装 arbitrary state。init/close 只改 promise/call log，restart/worker/lease/remote unknown 不存在。

**选定的抽象表达**

- Mock 不是全局 IBroker conformance，而是 provider-scoped declaration fixtures。`MockLayer` 为 Public/Account/Instrument scopes 提供 typed leaves；若要验证 durable semantics，另建独立 `DurableMockVenue` 与 JournalWriter/CAS/remote ledger。`CallRecord`、FailurePlan、InitialLedger、RemoteObservationFixture 都是 test support，不能冒充 native guarantees。

**保留的可观察契约**

- 保留 deterministic fixture、call trace、failure planning 与 pure reducer 的测试价值。
- 保留每个 scenario 的 explicit scope、identity、seed、revision、source/sequence；不依赖 process-global mutable singleton。
- 保留 Mock 可模拟 accepted/working/fill/cancel/external fact，但每种 outcome 由 typed fixture schema 表达。

**具体替代与修正**

- 将 factory config、Layer resources、fixture state、simulator controls 分离；`fromConfig` 不再构造承载所有 authority 的 class。
- CallRecord 改 typed test observation（method/capability/input digest/time/effect identity），不把 unknown args 或 Date.now 当 authority。
- FailurePlan 用 phase-tagged variants（prepare/admission/DispatchStarted/ack/observe/crash），可模拟 Unknown；关闭 fixture 释放其资源，但不取消 durable effect。
- setter arbitrary positions/orders 改为 versioned InitialLedger/RemoteObservationFixture；只允许经过 schema/reducer 构造 impossible state。
- barrel 迁移到 declarations/layers/fixtures；legacy facade 不与新 tree 并存为双 authority。

**副作用与状态归属**

- Mock public/account reads 与 simulator fact feed 不自动启用 transaction；只有 `DurableMockVenue` mutation leaf 接受 withTransaction recipe。
- 仅 controlled mock effect 使用 UTA writer/journal/CAS/idempotency/recovery；test instrumentation 只观察，fixture resource 不制造 permission witness。
- permission witness 与 injected service R 仍独立，fixture 不能用 resource presence 假造授权。

**失败与恢复**

- fixture load/schema/identity/phase errors typed；simulated crash after DispatchStarted always emits Unknown/recovery evidence。
- data read failure 不触发 compensation；effect recovery 只由 durable remote observation resolve。
- unknown source fact、unscoped account/order、stale expected version 在 handler 前拒绝。

**原生证据边界**

- Mock native idempotency、absence、atomicity、reversibility、stream replay/finality 未证明；mock success 不成为 venue guarantee。
- CallRecord/time, init promise, close resolve and in-memory map are support observations only.

**单一权威切换**

- 先采用 typed fixture layers 驱动现有 behavior tests，再为需要 crash proof 的场景引入 independent durable harness。
- 删除 global class state/legacy barrel/fake success union；将每个 caller 迁移到 declared Mock leaf 或 explicit fixture。
